```kotlin
                                            isRendering = uiState.isDrumLoopRendering,
                                            lastPath = uiState.lastDrumPadPath,
                                            onUpdateLastPath = { viewModel.updateLastDrumPadPath(it) }
                                        )
                                    }
                                    ActivePopup.TONIC_PAD -> {
                                        val singleOctaveText = remember(uiState.tonicOctaveRange) {
                                            val match = Regex("C[0-8]").findAll(uiState.tonicOctaveRange).map { it.value }.toList()
                                            if (match.isNotEmpty()) match.last() else "C4"
                                        }
                                        TonicPadContent(
                                            activeNotes = uiState.activeTonicNotes,
                                            onNoteClick = { viewModel.onTonicNoteClick(it) },
                                            isMultiPadEnabled = uiState.isMultiPadEnabled,
                                            onToggleMultiPad = { viewModel.toggleMultiPad() },
                                            singleOctaveText = singleOctaveText,
                                            onOctaveMinus = { viewModel.onTonicOctaveMinus() },
                                            onOctavePlus = { viewModel.onTonicOctavePlus() },
                                            useFlats = uiState.useFlats,
                                            volume = uiState.audioSlots.getOrNull(9)?.volume ?: 0.8f,
                                            onVolumeChange = { viewModel.setTonicVolume(it) },
                                            reverb = viewModel.audioEngine.channelParams[9].reverb,
                                            onReverbChange = { viewModel.setTonicReverb(it) },
                                            brightness = uiState.tonicBrightness,
                                            onBrightnessChange = { viewModel.setTonicBrightness(it) },
                                            shimmer = uiState.tonicShimmer,
                                            onShimmerChange = { viewModel.setTonicShimmer(it) },
                                            isPinned = false,
                                            onTogglePin = {},
                                            onClose = { viewModel.closePopup() },
                                            isSoundPickerOpen = isTonicSoundPickerOpen,
                                            onToggleSoundPicker = { isTonicSoundPickerOpen = it },
                                            soundfonts = uiState.soundfontFiles,
                                            currentLoadedSf2Name = uiState.audioSlots.getOrNull(9)?.soundFontPath?.substringAfterLast("/") ?: defaultSfName,
                                            loadedSf2Presets = uiState.audioSlots.getOrNull(9)?.presets ?: emptyList(),
                                            onSelectPreset = { viewModel.selectSf2Preset(9, it) },
                                            onSelectSf2File = { viewModel.loadSoundFontForSlot(9, it.path) },
                                            onOpenSoundfontPicker = { viewModel.openSoundfontForSlot(9) },
                                            onDragHeader = null
                                        )
                                    }
                                    ActivePopup.NOTES -> {
                                        NotesDialog(
                                            isOpen = true,
                                            onClose = { viewModel.closePopup() },
                                            detectedChord = detectedChord,
                                            selectedRootKey = uiState.selectedRootKey,
                                            useFlats = uiState.useFlats,
                                            notesDir = viewModel.fileManager.notesDir,
                                            fileManager = viewModel.fileManager
                                        )
                                    }
                                    else -> {}
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))

                // 3. BOTTOM BAR (V2)
                MixerBottomBarV2(
                    masterTrack = uiState.masterTrack,
                    onMasterVolumeChange = { vol -> viewModel.setTrackVolume(0, vol) },
                    onMasterFxClick = { viewModel.openEffectsForTrack(0) },
                    isSnapshotArmMode = uiState.isSnapshotArmMode,
                    onToggleSnapshotArm = { viewModel.toggleSnapshotArm() },
                    activeSnapshotSlot = uiState.activeSnapshotSlot,
                    snapshots = uiState.snapshots,
                    configuredSnapshotSlots = uiState.configuredSnapshotSlots,
                    onSnapshotSlotClick = { key -> viewModel.onSnapshotSlotClick(key) },
                    onAddSnapshot = { name -> viewModel.addSnapshotSlot(name) },
                    onDeleteSnapshot = { key -> viewModel.removeSnapshotSlot(key) },
                    snapshotCustomNames = uiState.snapshotCustomNames,
                    onRenameSnapshotSlot = { key, name ->
                        viewModel.renameSnapshotSlotWithMode(key, name, "crossfade")
                    },
                    isKeyboardActive = isKeyboardVisible,
                    onToggleKeyboard = { viewModel.cycleKeyboardExpansion() },
                    isLayerExpanded = uiState.isKeyboardLayerExpanded,
                    onToggleLayer = { viewModel.toggleKeyboardLayer() },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                )

                // 4. FIXED LAYOUT SLOT FOR RETRACTABLE PIANO
                // The keyboard is an overlay anchored to the bottom, so the column
                // must reserve its real measured height: a fixed estimate left the
                // resting container ~10 dp over the bottom bar.
                // A small breathing gap keeps the bar clear of the keyboard's top edge.
                val keyboardGap = 6.dp
                val targetKeyboardSlotHeight = if (isKeyboardVisible) keyboardRestHeight + keyboardGap else 0.dp
                val keyboardHeight by animateDpAsState(
                    targetValue = targetKeyboardSlotHeight,
                    animationSpec = tween(300, easing = EaseOutExpo),
                    label = "keyboardHeight"
                )
                
                if (keyboardHeight > 0.dp) {
                    Spacer(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .height(keyboardHeight)
                    )
                }
            }

            // Outside tap dismisser & subtle dark background scrim for expanded keyboard layer lines
            if (isKeyboardVisible && uiState.isKeyboardLayerExpanded) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(Color(0x88000000))
                        .zIndex(60f)
                        .clickable(
                            interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                            indication = null
                        ) {
                            viewModel.toggleKeyboardLayer()
                        }
                )
            }

            // 5. RETRACTABLE MULTI-TOUCH VIRTUAL PIANO KEYBOARD (Smooth 380ms transition)
            val activePianoTracks = remember(uiState.tracks, uiState.visibleTracksCount) {
                uiState.tracks.take(uiState.visibleTracksCount.coerceIn(1, 8)).filter { it.isEnabled }
            }
            AnimatedVisibility(
                visible = isKeyboardVisible,
                enter = slideInVertically(
                    initialOffsetY = { it },
                    animationSpec = tween(380, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)
                ) + fadeIn(tween(280)),
                exit = slideOutVertically(
                    targetOffsetY = { it },
                    animationSpec = tween(280, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)
                ) + fadeOut(tween(200)),
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(top = 5.dp)
                    .onSizeChanged { size ->
                        // Latch the resting height only: while the layer lines are folded
                        // the overlay is at its lowest, which is the height the bottom bar
                        // must sit above.
                        if (!uiState.isKeyboardLayerExpanded && size.height > 0) {
                            keyboardRestHeight = with(density) { size.height.toDp() }
                        }
                    }
                    .zIndex(100f)
            ) {
                // Layer lines show the loaded soundfont, not the generic track name.
                val vkbLines = remember(uiState.tracks, uiState.visibleTracksCount) {
                    activePianoTracks.map { t ->
                        KeyboardLine(
                            id = t.id.toString(),
                            name = t.patchName.ifBlank { t.soundfontName.ifBlank { t.name } },
                            color = t.resolvedColor(),
                            low = t.splitNoteMin,
                            high = t.splitNoteMax
                        )
                    }
                }
                val vkbPressed = remember(uiState.pressedKeys) {
                    uiState.pressedKeys.mapNotNull { name ->
                        VkbMidi.ktToMidi(name)?.takeIf { it in VkbMidi.NOTE_MIN..VkbMidi.NOTE_MAX }
                    }.toSet()
                }
                VirtualKeyboardContainer(
                    lines = vkbLines,
                    expanded = uiState.isKeyboardLayerExpanded,
                    pressedNotes = vkbPressed,
                    theme = KeyboardThemes.byId(uiState.vkbTheme),
                    pressStyle = if (uiState.vkbPressStyle == "led") KeyboardPressStyle.Led else KeyboardPressStyle.Color,
                    actions = remember {
                        VirtualKeyboardActions(
                            onExpandedChange = { viewModel.toggleKeyboardLayer() },
                            onLineRangeChange = { id, low, high ->
                                id.toIntOrNull()?.let { viewModel.updateTrackKeyRange(it, low, high) }
                            },
                            onKeyDown = { note -> viewModel.onKeyDown(VkbMidi.midiToKt(note)) },
                            onKeyUp = { note -> viewModel.onKeyUp(VkbMidi.midiToKt(note)) },
                            onPitchBend = { viewModel.setPitchBend(it) }
                        )
                    }
                )
            }


            // Outside touch scrim for quick closing of floating dropdowns
            if (uiState.isMidiPanelOpen || uiState.activePopup == ActivePopup.SCENE) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(Color(0x22000000))
                        .clickable {
                            if (uiState.isMidiPanelOpen) viewModel.closeMidiPanel()
                            if (uiState.activePopup == ActivePopup.SCENE) viewModel.closePopup()
                        }
                )
            }

            // Floating MIDI File Browser Panel
            AnimatedVisibility(
                visible = uiState.isMidiPanelOpen,
                enter = fadeIn(tween(180)) + slideInVertically(initialOffsetY = { 20 }, animationSpec = tween(200)),
                exit = fadeOut(tween(150)) + slideOutVertically(targetOffsetY = { 20 }, animationSpec = tween(150)),
                modifier = Modifier
                    .padding(bottom = 40.dp, start = 220.dp)
                    .align(Alignment.BottomStart)
            ) {
                MidiFloatingPanel(
                    isOpen = uiState.isMidiPanelOpen,
                    isMidiPlaying = uiState.isMidiPlaying,
                    onToggleMidiPlayPause = { viewModel.toggleMidiPlayPause() },
                    midiVolume = uiState.midiVolume,
                    onMidiVolumeChange = { viewModel.setMidiVolume(it) },
                    midiFolders = uiState.midiFolders,
                    activeMidiName = uiState.selectedMidiName,
                    onToggleFolder = { viewModel.toggleMidiFolder(it) },
                    onSelectMidiFile = { viewModel.playMidiFile(it) },
                    onClose = { viewModel.closeMidiPanel() }
                )
            }
                    }
                }
                }



@Composable
fun MixerScreen(
    viewModel: MixerViewModel,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    onRequestManageStoragePermission: () -> Unit = {},
    skipSplash: Boolean = false
) {
    val uiState by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    var isSplashFinished by remember { mutableStateOf(skipSplash) }
    var tsPage by remember { mutableStateOf(TsPage.Track) }
    LaunchedEffect(uiState.activeTrackSettingsId) { tsPage = TsPage.Track }

    val sf2PickerLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenMultipleDocuments()
    ) { uris ->
        if (!uris.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            viewModel.importSoundFontUris(uris)
        }
    }

    val drumPadPickerLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenMultipleDocuments()
    ) { uris ->
        if (!uris.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            viewModel.importDrumPadUris(uris)
        }
    }

    val loopPickerLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenMultipleDocuments()
    ) { uris ->
        if (!uris.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            viewModel.importLoopUris(uris)
        }
    }

    // Real-time zero-latency chord analysis from pressed keys
    val rawChord = remember(uiState.pressedKeys) {
        ChordCalculator.detect(uiState.pressedKeys)
    }
    val detectedChord = remember(rawChord, uiState.useFlats) {
        if (uiState.useFlats && rawChord != null) {
            fun String.toFlats(): String = this
                .replace("C#", "Db")
                .replace("D#", "Eb")
                .replace("F#", "Gb")
                .replace("G#", "Ab")
                .replace("A#", "Bb")
            
            com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components.DetectedChord(
                primaryName = rawChord.primaryName.toFlats(),
                equivalentName = rawChord.equivalentName.toFlats(),
                variantName = rawChord.variantName.toFlats(),
                alternateNames = rawChord.alternateNames.toFlats(),
                alternateName2 = rawChord.alternateName2.toFlats(),
                formula = rawChord.formula,
                notesList = rawChord.notesList.map { it.toFlats() }
            )
        } else rawChord
    }

    val isKeyboardVisible = uiState.keyboardHeightFraction > 0f

    val animatedBottomPadding by animateDpAsState(
        targetValue = if (isKeyboardVisible) 0.dp else 6.dp,
        animationSpec = tween(
            durationMillis = 260,
            easing = FastOutSlowInEasing
        ),
        label = "bottomPaddingAnim"
    )
    val safeBottomPadding = animatedBottomPadding.coerceAtLeast(0.dp)
    val trackScrollState = rememberScrollState()

    // Blur is a RenderEffect: enabling it on the same frame the window opens makes
    // that frame render the whole page through an offscreen pass, which is the
    // stutter seen when tapping Track Settings or the FX button. Settle one frame
    // first, then let the blur take effect.
    val wantsBlur = uiState.activePopup.isFloatingWindow()
    var blurActive by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    LaunchedEffect(wantsBlur) {
        if (wantsBlur) {
            withFrameNanos { }
            blurActive = true
        } else {
            blurActive = false
        }
    }

    // Fullscreen Stage Container (Unpadded for 100% full-bleed overlays like SplashScreen)
    CompositionLocalProvider(LocalHapticsEnabled provides uiState.hapticsEnabled) {
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
            .testTag("mixer_screen_root")
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(bottom = safeBottomPadding)
        ) {
            AnimatedContent(
            targetState = uiState.currentPage,
            transitionSpec = {
                fadeIn(animationSpec = tween(220)) togetherWith fadeOut(animationSpec = tween(220))
            },
            label = "screen_page_switch",
            // Only the page content blurs: popup windows are siblings, so they stay crisp.
            // Velocity settings keeps its previous heavier blur; the listed windows get a light one.
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .windowBackdropBlur(
                    active = blurActive,
                    radius = if (uiState.activePopup == ActivePopup.VELOCITY_SETTINGS) 18.dp else 1.5.dp
                )
        ) { currentPage ->
            when (currentPage) {
                AppScreenPage.PROJECTS, AppScreenPage.SETLISTS -> {
                    SetlistsScreen(
                        state = SetlistsUiState(
                            setlists = uiState.scenes.map { scene ->
                                Setlist(
                                    id = scene.id,
                                    name = scene.name,
                                    patchCount = scene.patchesCount,
                                    color = scene.color.toSetlistColor(),
                                    isPinned = false,
                                    lastUsedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                                )
                            },
                            openSetlistId = uiState.activeSceneId.ifEmpty { null },
                            lastOpenedId = uiState.lastOpenedSetlistId,
                            isLoading = uiState.isSetlistsLoading,
                            query = uiState.setlistsQuery,
                            sort = uiState.setlistsSort,
                            onlyPinned = uiState.setlistsOnlyPinned,
                            prefs = uiState.setlistsPrefs
                        ),
                        actions = object : SetlistsActions {
                            override fun onCancel() { viewModel.navigateBackToMixer() }
                            override fun onOpenSetlist(id: String) { viewModel.openSetlistFromScreen(id) }
                            override fun onCreateSetlist(name: String, mode: CreateMode) { viewModel.createSetlistFromScreen(name, mode) }
                            override fun onRenameSetlist(id: String, name: String) { viewModel.renameSetlistFromScreen(id, name) }
                            override fun onChangeColor(id: String, color: SetlistColor) { viewModel.changeSetlistColor(id, color) }
                            override fun onDuplicateSetlist(id: String) { viewModel.duplicateSetlistFromScreen(id) }
                            override fun onTogglePin(id: String) { viewModel.togglePinSetlist(id) }
                            override fun onDeleteSetlist(id: String) { viewModel.deleteSetlistWithUndo(id) }
                            override fun onUndoDelete() { viewModel.undoDeleteSetlist() }
                            override fun onQueryChange(query: String) { viewModel.setSetlistsQuery(query) }
                            override fun onSortChange(sort: SetlistSort) { viewModel.setSetlistsSort(sort) }
                            override fun onOnlyPinnedChange(only: Boolean) { viewModel.setSetlistsOnlyPinned(only) }
                            override fun onPrefsChange(prefs: SetlistsPrefs) { viewModel.updateSetlistsPrefs(prefs) }
                            override fun onResetPrefs() { viewModel.resetSetlistsPrefs() }
                            override fun onOpenAppSettings() { viewModel.openSettings() }
                        }
                    )
                }
                AppScreenPage.DRUMPAD -> {
                    DrumPadScreen(
                        viewModel = viewModel,
                        uiState = uiState,
                        onImportFiles = { tab ->
                            if (tab == "Loops") loopPickerLauncher.launch(arrayOf("audio/*", "*/*"))
                            else drumPadPickerLauncher.launch(arrayOf("audio/*", "*/*"))
                        },
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                    )
                }
                AppScreenPage.SHEETS -> {
                    SheetsRoot(
                        repo = SheetsRepository(viewModel.fileManager.sheetsDir),
                        bottomInset = safeBottomPadding,
                        onBackToMixer = { viewModel.navigateBackToMixer() }
                    )
                }
                AppScreenPage.MIXER -> {
                    MixerMainPageContent(
                        uiState = uiState,
                        viewModel = viewModel,
                        safeBottomPadding = safeBottomPadding,
                        detectedChord = detectedChord,
                        isKeyboardVisible = isKeyboardVisible,
                        trackScrollState = trackScrollState,
                        onImportDrumPadAudio = { drumPadPickerLauncher.launch(arrayOf("audio/*", "*/*")) }
                    )
                }
                AppScreenPage.SETTINGS -> {
                val settingsState = SettingsState(
                    tab = uiState.settingsTab,
                    query = uiState.settingsQuery,
                    bufferSize = uiState.audioBufferSize,
                    maxPolyphony = uiState.polyphony,
                    headroom = uiState.headroom,
                    autoFit = uiState.isFaderAutoFit,
                    hue = uiState.themeHue,
                    accentSaturation = uiState.themeAccentSaturation,
                    backgroundTone = uiState.themeBgSaturation,
                    backgroundLightness = uiState.themeBgLightness,
                    vkbTheme = uiState.vkbTheme,
                    vkbPressStyle = uiState.vkbPressStyle,
                    audioEngine = uiState.audioEngine,
                    fluidSynthGain = uiState.fluidSynthGain,
                    hapticsEnabled = uiState.hapticsEnabled,
                    reducedMotion = uiState.reducedMotion,
                    antiJitter = uiState.antiJitter,
                    jitterWindowMs = uiState.jitterWindowMs,
                    keepScreenOn = uiState.keepScreenOn,
                    notation = if (uiState.useFlats) Notation.Flats else Notation.Sharps,
                    midiMappingOpen = uiState.midiMappingOpen,
                    midiMappings = uiState.midiMappings,
                    learningActionType = uiState.learningActionType,
                    lastMidiSummary = uiState.lastMidiSummary,
                    midiDevices = uiState.midiDevices
                )
                val settingsActions = object : SettingsActions {
                    override fun onBack() { viewModel.navigateBackToMixer() }
                    override fun onTabSelected(tab: SettingsTab) { viewModel.onSettingsTabSelected(tab) }
                    override fun onQueryChange(query: String) { viewModel.onSettingsQueryChanged(query) }
                    override fun onBufferSizeChange(size: Int) { viewModel.setAudioBufferSize(size) }
                    override fun onMaxPolyphonyChange(voices: Int) { viewModel.setPolyphony(voices) }
                    override fun onHeadroomChange(value: Float) { viewModel.setHeadroom(value) }
                    override fun onAutoFitChange(enabled: Boolean) { viewModel.setFaderAutoFit(enabled) }
                    override fun onHueChange(value: Float) { viewModel.setThemeHue(value) }
                    override fun onAccentSaturationChange(value: Float) { viewModel.setThemeAccentSaturation(value) }
                    override fun onBackgroundToneChange(value: Float) { viewModel.setThemeBgSaturation(value) }
                    override fun onBackgroundLightnessChange(value: Float) { viewModel.setThemeBgLightness(value) }
                    override fun onResetColors() {
                        viewModel.resetThemeToDefault()
                        viewModel.setVkbTheme("classic")
                        viewModel.setVkbPressStyle("color")
                    }
                    override fun onVkbThemeChange(themeId: String) { viewModel.setVkbTheme(themeId) }
                    override fun onVkbPressStyleChange(style: String) { viewModel.setVkbPressStyle(style) }
                    override fun onAntiJitterChange(enabled: Boolean) { viewModel.setAntiJitter(enabled) }
                    override fun onJitterWindowChange(ms: Int) { viewModel.setJitterWindowMs(ms) }
                    override fun onStartMidiLearn(action: MidiActionType) { viewModel.startMidiLearn(action) }
                    override fun onCancelMidiLearn() { viewModel.cancelMidiLearn() }
                    override fun onUnmapMidiAction(action: MidiActionType) { viewModel.unmapMidiAction(action) }
                    override fun onToggleMidiMappingEnabled(action: MidiActionType) { viewModel.toggleMidiMappingEnabled(action) }
                    override fun onUpdateManualMidiMapping(action: MidiActionType, type: MidiControlType, channel: Int, number: Int) {
                        viewModel.updateMidiMappingManual(action, type, channel, number)
                    }
                    override fun onSetMidiMappingMode(action: MidiActionType, mode: MidiControlMode) {
                        viewModel.setMidiMappingMode(action, mode)
                    }
                    override fun onResetMidiMappings() { viewModel.resetMidiMappingsToDefaults() }
                    override fun onClearMidiMappings() { viewModel.clearAllMidiMappings() }
                    override fun onToggleMidiDevice(deviceId: String) { viewModel.toggleMidiDevice(deviceId) }
                    override fun onOpenMidiMapping() { viewModel.openMidiMappingPage() }
                    override fun onCloseMidiMapping() { viewModel.closeMidiMappingPage() }
                    override fun onNotationChange(notation: Notation) { viewModel.toggleUseFlats() }
                    override fun onKeepScreenOnChange(enabled: Boolean) { viewModel.setKeepScreenOn(enabled) }
                    override fun onAudioEngineChange(engine: String) { viewModel.setAudioEngine(engine) }
                    override fun onFluidSynthGainChange(value: Float) { viewModel.setFluidSynthGain(value) }
                    override fun onHapticsChange(enabled: Boolean) { viewModel.setHapticsEnabled(enabled) }
                    override fun onReducedMotionChange(enabled: Boolean) { viewModel.setReducedMotion(enabled) }
                    override fun onOpenLanguage() { viewModel.openLanguageDialog() }
                    override fun onOpenAppSettings() { viewModel.openSettings() }
                }

                SettingsScreen(
                    state = settingsState,
                    actions = settingsActions,
                    background = Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(AppColors.BgTop, AppColors.BgBottom))
                )
            }
        }
    }

        when (uiState.activePopup) {
            ActivePopup.EFFECTS -> {
                // The Æther FX window is the only Effects surface. The legacy
                // EffectsDialog is gone: FxOverlay renders FxWindowHost, the
                // ported shell (rack, effect window, add panel).
                val slotIdx = if (uiState.activeEffectTrackId == 0) null else uiState.activeEffectTrackId - 1
                val sfTrack = slotIdx?.let { uiState.tracks.getOrNull(it) }
                com.soundstage.mixer.ui.fx.FxOverlay(
                    trackId = uiState.activeEffectTrackId,
                    soundfontName = sfTrack?.soundfontName.orEmpty(),
                    program = sfTrack?.program ?: 0,
                    onClose = { viewModel.closePopup() },
                    onChooseSoundfont = {
                        if (uiState.activeEffectTrackId in 1..8) {
                            viewModel.openSoundfontForSlot(uiState.activeEffectTrackId - 1)
                        }
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().zIndex(130f),
                )
            }
            ActivePopup.SOUNDFONT -> {
                val slot = uiState.audioSlots.getOrNull(uiState.activeSoundfontSlotId)
                val activePresets = slot?.presets ?: emptyList()
                val activePresetId = slot?.preset ?: 0
                // tracks a 8 elements (0..7) : les slots 8 (Drum) et 9 (Pad) n'y ont pas
                // d'entree, getOrNull renvoie null. Le nom fiable est soundFontPath (ecrit
                // pour tous les slots), comme le fait deja DrumPadScreen.
                val activeSfName = if (uiState.activeSoundfontSlotId in 0..7) {
                    uiState.tracks.getOrNull(uiState.activeSoundfontSlotId)?.soundfontName.orEmpty()
                } else {
                    slot?.soundFontPath?.substringAfterLast("/").orEmpty()
                }
                val activeBank = slot?.bank ?: 0

                val variant = when (uiState.activeSoundfontSlotId) {
                    8 -> SoundfontVariant.Drum
                    9 -> SoundfontVariant.Pad
                    else -> SoundfontVariant.Track
                }

                val loadedFileId = activeSfName.ifEmpty { null }

                val availableBanks = remember(activePresets) {
                    activePresets.map { it.bankNumber }.distinct().sorted()
                }

                val sfWindowState = SoundfontWindowState(
                    isOpen = true,
                    variant = variant,
                    loadedFileId = loadedFileId,
                    loadedFileName = activeSfName,
                    loadedPresets = activePresets,
                    loadedBank = activeBank,
                    loadedPresetId = activePresetId,
                    loadedBanks = availableBanks,
                    files = uiState.realSoundfonts.map { item ->
                        val parsed = uiState.sfParsedPresets[item.path]
                        SfRow.File(
                            key = item.name,
                            name = item.name,
                            sizeBytes = item.size,
                            formattedSize = item.formattedSize,
                            isLoaded = item.name == activeSfName,
                            presetCount = parsed?.size ?: 0,
                        )
                    },
                    favorites = uiState.sfFavorites,
                    overrides = uiState.sfCategoryOverrides,
                    parsedPresets = uiState.sfParsedPresets.mapValues { (_, v) ->
                        v.map { SoundfontPreset(it.preset, it.displayName, it.bank) }
                    },
                    parsingFiles = uiState.sfParsingFiles,
                    loadingFileId = null,
                    loadingProgress = null,
                    importingName = null,
                    importingProgress = null,
                )

                SoundfontWindow(
                    state = sfWindowState,
                    actions = object : SfWindowActions {
                        override fun onClose() { viewModel.closePopup() }

                        override fun onSelectPreset(row: SfRow.Preset) {
                            viewModel.selectSf2Preset(
                                SoundfontPreset(row.presetId, row.name, row.bankNumber)
                            )
                        }

                        override fun onLoadFile(fileId: String) {
                            val item = uiState.realSoundfonts.firstOrNull { it.name == fileId } ?: return
                            viewModel.loadSoundfontFromStorage(item)
                        }

                        override fun onCancelLoad() {}

                        override fun onToggleFavorite(key: String) {
                            viewModel.toggleSfFavorite(key)
                        }

                        override fun onMoveToCategory(key: String, categoryId: String) {
                            viewModel.moveSfToCategory(key, categoryId)
                        }

                        override fun onImportFile() {
                            sf2PickerLauncher.launch(arrayOf("*/*"))
                        }

                        override fun onDeleteFile(fileId: String) {
                            val item = uiState.realSoundfonts.firstOrNull { it.name == fileId } ?: return
                            viewModel.deleteSoundFontFile(item)
                        }

                        override fun onRequestParse(fileId: String) {
                            val item = uiState.realSoundfonts.firstOrNull { it.name == fileId } ?: return
                            viewModel.parseSfInBackground(item.path)
                        }
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .zIndex(120f)
                )
            }
            ActivePopup.TRACK_SETTINGS -> {
                val targetTrack = uiState.tracks.find { it.id == uiState.activeTrackSettingsId }
                if (targetTrack != null) {
                    // Dimming scrim: taps outside the window dismiss it, and it swallows
                    // every touch so nothing behind reacts.
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxSize()
                            .background(Color(0x66000000))
                            .zIndex(119f)
                            .clickable(
                                interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                                indication = null
                            ) { viewModel.closeTrackSettings() }
                    )
                    val tsScreen = tsPage
                    val tsActions = remember(targetTrack.id) {
                        TrackSettingsActions(
                            onNavigate = { tsPage = it },
                            onClose = { viewModel.closeTrackSettings() },
                            onVelocityChange = { viewModel.updateTrackVelocityConfig(targetTrack.id, TsVelocity.toEngine(it)) },
                            onMidiDevice = { viewModel.updateTrackMidiDevice(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onMidiChannel = { viewModel.updateTrackMidiChannel(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onNoteRange = { lo, hi -> viewModel.updateTrackKeyRange(targetTrack.id, lo, hi) },
                            onTranspose = { viewModel.setTrackTranspose(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onOctave = { viewModel.setTrackOctave(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onPitchBendRange = { viewModel.setTrackPitchBendRange(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onDefaultVolume = { viewModel.setTrackDefaultVolume(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onDefaultPan = { viewModel.setTrackDefaultPan(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onSustain = { viewModel.setTrackSustain(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onAftertouch = { viewModel.setTrackAftertouch(targetTrack.id, it) },
                            onProgramChange = { viewModel.setTrackProgramChange(targetTrack.id, it) }
                        )
                    }
                    TrackSettingsWindow(
                        state = TrackSettingsState(
                            trackName = "Track ${targetTrack.id}",
                            soundName = if (targetTrack.patchName.isNotBlank()) targetTrack.patchName else if (targetTrack.soundfontName.isNotBlank()) targetTrack.soundfontName else "Default GM",
                            color = targetTrack.resolvedColor(),
                            velocity = TsVelocity.toUi(targetTrack.velocityConfig),
                            devices = uiState.midiDevices.map { TsDeviceItem(id = it.id, name = it.name, subtitle = if (it.isConnected) "Connected" else "Offline") },
                            midiDeviceId = targetTrack.selectedMidiDeviceId ?: "all",
                            midiChannel = targetTrack.midiChannel,
                            noteLow = targetTrack.splitNoteMin,
                            noteHigh = targetTrack.splitNoteMax,
                            transpose = targetTrack.transpose,
                            octave = targetTrack.octave,
                            pitchBendRange = targetTrack.pitchBendRange,
                            defaultVolume = targetTrack.defaultVolume,
                            defaultPan = targetTrack.defaultPan,
                            sustain = targetTrack.sustain,
                            aftertouch = targetTrack.aftertouch,
                            programChange = targetTrack.programChange
                        ),
                        screen = tsScreen,
                        actions = tsActions,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.Center)
                            .size(600.dp, 370.dp)
                            .zIndex(120f)
                    )
                }
            }
            ActivePopup.VELOCITY_SETTINGS -> {
                val targetTrack = uiState.tracks.find { it.id == uiState.activeTrackSettingsId }
                if (targetTrack != null) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxSize()
                            .background(Color(0x66000000))
                            .zIndex(119f)
                            .clickable(
                                interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                                indication = null
                            ) { viewModel.closeTrackSettings() }
                    )
                    VelocitySettingsDialog(
                        trackNumber = targetTrack.id,
                        soundName = if (targetTrack.patchName.isNotBlank()) targetTrack.patchName else if (targetTrack.soundfontName.isNotBlank()) targetTrack.soundfontName else "Default GM",
                        trackColor = targetTrack.resolvedColor(),
                        config = targetTrack.velocityConfig,
                        onConfigChange = { newConfig ->
                            viewModel.updateTrackVelocityConfig(targetTrack.id, newConfig)
                        },
                        onBack = {
                            viewModel.openTrackSettings(targetTrack.id)
                        },
                        onDismiss = {
                            viewModel.closeTrackSettings()
                        }
                    )
                }
            }
            else -> {}
        }


        // Floating Sheet Window (Spotify style, 0 contour, free drag + magnetic snap, double-tap dismiss)
        if (uiState.floatingSheet != null && uiState.currentPage == AppScreenPage.MIXER) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .zIndex(85f)
            ) {
                FloatingSheetWindow(
                    sheet = uiState.floatingSheet,
                    scale = uiState.floatingSheetScale,
                    onScaleChange = { viewModel.updateFloatingSheetScale(it) },
                    onClose = { viewModel.closeFloatingSheet() }
                )
            }
        }

        // Patches Sliding Side Drawer (Exact sliding drawer from right matching Settings)
        if (uiState.activePopup == ActivePopup.SCENE) {
            PatchesOverlay(
                state = PatchesUiState(
                    patches = uiState.patches.map { p ->
                        Patch(
                            id = p.id,
                            name = p.name,
                            snapshotCount = p.snapshotCount,
                        )
                    },
                    activePatchId = uiState.activePatchId,
                ),
                actions = object : PatchesActions {
                    override fun onClose() { viewModel.closePopup() }
                    override fun onOpenSetlists() {
                        viewModel.closePopup()
                        viewModel.navigateToProjectsHome()
                    }
                    override fun onSelectPatch(id: String) { viewModel.selectPatch(id) }
                    override fun onToggleActive(id: String) { viewModel.selectPatch(id) }
                    override fun onRenamePatch(id: String) {}
                    override fun onRenamePatchConfirmed(id: String, name: String) { viewModel.renamePatch(id, name) }
                    override fun onDeletePatch(id: String) { viewModel.deletePatch(id) }
                    override fun onUndoDeletePatch() { viewModel.undoDeletePatch() }
                    override fun onCreatePatch(name: String, duplicateFrom: String?) {
                        viewModel.createNewPatch(name, duplicateFrom == null)
                    }
                },
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .zIndex(120f)
            )
        }

        // Material 3 Storage Permission Explanation Dialog
        if (uiState.showStoragePermissionDialog) {
            AlertDialog(
                onDismissRequest = { viewModel.setStoragePermissionDialogVisible(false) },
                title = {
                    Text(
                        text = "SoundStage Storage Access",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                },
                text = {
                    Text(
                        text = "To detect your custom SoundFonts (.sf2), audio loops, and presets located in the external /SoundStage folder, the application requires full file access permission.\n\nWithout this permission, only built-in application asset folders will be scanned.",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                },
                confirmButton = {
                    Button(
                        onClick = {
                            viewModel.setStoragePermissionDialogVisible(false)
                            onRequestManageStoragePermission()
                        }
                    ) {
                        Text("Grant Permission")
                    }
                },
                dismissButton = {
                    TextButton(
                        onClick = { viewModel.setStoragePermissionDialogVisible(false) }
                    ) {
                        Text("Later")
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        if (uiState.showLanguageDialog) {
            androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog(
                onDismissRequest = { viewModel.closeLanguageDialog() },
                title = {
                    Text(
                        text = "Language",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                },
                text = {
                    Column(
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                    ) {
                        listOf("English", "Français", "Español").forEach { label ->
                            val selected = uiState.selectedLanguage == label
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                    .background(
                                        if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.15f)
                                        else Color.Transparent
                                    )
                                    .clickable {
                                        viewModel.setSelectedLanguage(label)
                                        viewModel.closeLanguageDialog()
                                    }
                                    .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = label,
                                    color = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                                            else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                confirmButton = {
                    TextButton(onClick = { viewModel.closeLanguageDialog() }) {
                        Text("Close")
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        // Close inner padded box
        }

        // Startup Splash Screen Animation (100% Edge-to-Edge Fullscreen Overlay)
        if (!isSplashFinished) {
            LiveKeysSplashScreen(
                onFinished = { isSplashFinished = true },
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .zIndex(999f)
            )
        }
    }
    }
}

private fun androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color.toSetlistColor(): SetlistColor {
    val candidates = SetlistColor.values()
    return candidates.minByOrNull { c ->
        val dr = (red - c.base.red) * (red - c.base.red)
        val dg = (green - c.base.green) * (green - c.base.green)
        val db = (blue - c.base.blue) * (blue - c.base.blue)
        dr + dg + db
    } ?: SetlistColor.Blue
}
```

```kotlin
package com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components

import androidx.compose.animation.core.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.BoxScope
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

// Studio palette of refined, organic, non-neon harmonic tones
val StudioBubblePalette = listOf(
    Color(0xFF5B92E5), // Soft Studio Blue
    Color(0xFF818CF8), // Pastel Periwinkle
    Color(0xFF9F8FEF), // Delicate Soft Lavender
    Color(0xFFD47A9E), // Muted Dusky Rose
    Color(0xFFD98A6C), // Warm Amber Dusk Glow
    Color(0xFF38B2AC), // Soft Mineral Teal
    Color(0xFF4A90E2)  // Atmospheric Sky Azure
)

/**
 * Shared Dynamic Ambient Background with Floating Luminous Bubbles.
 * Exactly identical across Mixer, Setlists, and DrumPad pages.
 */
@Composable
fun AmbientStudioBackground(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit = {}
) {
    val studioBg = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background

    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "ambient_studio_glow_orb")
    val animPhaseX by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = (2 * Math.PI).toFloat(),
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(durationMillis = 52000, easing = LinearEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
        ),
        label = "glow_x"
    )
    val animPhaseY by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = (2 * Math.PI).toFloat(),
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(durationMillis = 68000, easing = LinearEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
        ),
        label = "glow_y"
    )
    val animPhaseRadius by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.90f,
        targetValue = 1.10f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(durationMillis = 28000, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "glow_radius_pulse"
    )
    val animColorPhase by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = StudioBubblePalette.size.toFloat(),
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(durationMillis = 84000, easing = LinearEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
        ),
        label = "glow_color_phase"
    )

    Box(modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            drawRect(color = studioBg)

            val cx = size.width * (0.50f + 0.35f * kotlin.math.sin(animPhaseX))
            val cy = size.height * (0.50f + 0.30f * kotlin.math.cos(animPhaseY))
            val baseRadius = (size.width * 0.35f).coerceIn(160.dp.toPx(), 320.dp.toPx())
            val currentOrbRadius = baseRadius * animPhaseRadius

            fun sampleBubbleColor(phaseOffset: Float): Color {
                val count = StudioBubblePalette.size
                val norm = ((animColorPhase + phaseOffset) % count + count) % count
                val idx1 = norm.toInt()
                val idx2 = (idx1 + 1) % count
                val frac = norm - idx1
                return androidx.compose.ui.graphics.lerp(StudioBubblePalette[idx1], StudioBubblePalette[idx2], frac)
            }

            val primaryOrbColor = sampleBubbleColor(0f)
            val satelliteOrbColor = sampleBubbleColor(2.35f)
            val tertiaryOrbColor = sampleBubbleColor(4.70f)

            // Layer 1: Primary Floating Ambient Glow Orb (smooth, subtle, organic luminous bubble)
            drawCircle(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        primaryOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.12f),
                        primaryOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.05f),
                        primaryOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.01f),
                        Color.Transparent
                    ),
                    center = Offset(cx, cy),
                    radius = currentOrbRadius * 1.4f
                ),
                center = Offset(cx, cy),
                radius = currentOrbRadius * 1.4f
            )

            // Primary Gentle Soft Core
            drawCircle(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        primaryOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.16f),
                        primaryOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.07f),
                        Color.Transparent
                    ),
                    center = Offset(cx, cy),
                    radius = currentOrbRadius * 0.65f
                ),
                center = Offset(cx, cy),
                radius = currentOrbRadius * 0.65f
            )

            // Layer 2: Secondary Floating Satellite Glow Orb drifting counter-phase
            val satX = size.width * (0.50f - 0.34f * kotlin.math.sin(animPhaseY * 0.85f))
            val satY = size.height * (0.50f - 0.28f * kotlin.math.cos(animPhaseX * 0.75f))
            val satRadius = baseRadius * 0.78f

            drawCircle(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        satelliteOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.11f),
                        satelliteOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.04f),
                        Color.Transparent
                    ),
                    center = Offset(satX, satY),
                    radius = satRadius
                ),
                center = Offset(satX, satY),
                radius = satRadius
            )

            // Layer 3: Tertiary Delicate Floating Accent Orb drifting slowly
            val tertX = size.width * (0.50f + 0.32f * kotlin.math.cos(animPhaseX * 0.60f + 1.2f))
            val tertY = size.height * (0.50f - 0.30f * kotlin.math.sin(animPhaseY * 0.65f + 0.9f))
            val tertRadius = baseRadius * 0.58f

            drawCircle(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        tertiaryOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.09f),
                        tertiaryOrbColor.copy(alpha = 0.03f),
                        Color.Transparent
                    ),
                    center = Offset(tertX, tertY),
                    radius = tertRadius
                ),
                center = Offset(tertX, tertY),
                radius = tertRadius
            )
        }

        content()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        listOf(0, 2, 10) to Triple("7sus2(no5)", "7sus2", "1 - 2 - b7"),
        listOf(0, 5, 10) to Triple("7sus4(no5)", "7sus", "1 - 4 - b7"),

        // --- 9. Two-note Dyads / Power Chords ---
        listOf(0, 7) to Triple("5", "P5", "1 - 5"),
        listOf(0, 4) to Triple("(no5)", "3rd", "1 - 3"),
        listOf(0, 3) to Triple("m(no5)", "m3rd", "1 - b3"),
        listOf(0, 5) to Triple("sus4(no5)", "4th", "1 - 4"),
        listOf(0, 2) to Triple("sus2(no5)", "2nd", "1 - 2")
    )

    fun parsePitchClass(noteStr: String): Int? {
        val clean = noteStr.trim().uppercase()
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return null
        val letter = when {
            clean.startsWith("C#") || clean.startsWith("DB") -> "C#"
            clean.startsWith("D#") || clean.startsWith("EB") -> "D#"
            clean.startsWith("F#") || clean.startsWith("GB") -> "F#"
            clean.startsWith("G#") || clean.startsWith("AB") -> "G#"
            clean.startsWith("A#") || clean.startsWith("BB") -> "A#"
            clean.startsWith("C") -> "C"
            clean.startsWith("D") -> "D"
            clean.startsWith("E") -> "E"
            clean.startsWith("F") -> "F"
            clean.startsWith("G") -> "G"
            clean.startsWith("A") -> "A"
            clean.startsWith("B") -> "B"
            else -> return null
        }
        val idx = NOTE_NAMES.indexOf(letter)
        return if (idx >= 0) idx else null
    }

    /**
     * Detects chord from polyphonic collection of notes.
     * Computes BOTH:
     * - Primary Name (e.g. Slash / Bass representation or direct name like F/D)
     * - Equivalent Name (e.g. Functional root chord like Dm7)
     */
    fun detect(notes: Collection<String>): DetectedChord? {
        if (notes.isEmpty()) return null

        val pitchClassesWithOctave = notes.mapNotNull { noteStr ->
            val pc = parsePitchClass(noteStr) ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val octave = noteStr.filter { it.isDigit() }.toIntOrNull() ?: 4
            val midi = octave * 12 + pc
            Triple(pc, midi, noteStr)
        }.sortedBy { it.second }

        if (pitchClassesWithOctave.isEmpty()) return null

        val uniquePitchClasses = pitchClassesWithOctave.map { it.first }.distinct()
        val lowestPitchClass = pitchClassesWithOctave.first().first
        val lowestNoteName = NOTE_NAMES[lowestPitchClass]

        // 1 Single Note
        if (uniquePitchClasses.size == 1) {
            val rootName = NOTE_NAMES[uniquePitchClasses.first()]
            return DetectedChord(
                primaryName = rootName,
                equivalentName = "",
                variantName = "",
                formula = "1",
                notesList = listOf(rootName)
            )
        }

        // Test potential chord roots and collect candidate interpretations
        val candidateChords = mutableListOf<Triple<Int, String, String>>() // (rootPc, chordName, formula)

        for (rootPc in uniquePitchClasses) {
            val rootName = NOTE_NAMES[rootPc]
            val intervals = uniquePitchClasses.map { (it - rootPc + 12) % 12 }.sorted()

            CHORD_DEFINITIONS[intervals]?.let { (suffix, _, formula) ->
                candidateChords.add(Triple(rootPc, "$rootName$suffix", formula))
            }
        }

        val notesFormatted = uniquePitchClasses.map { NOTE_NAMES[it] }.joinToString(" · ")

        if (candidateChords.isNotEmpty()) {
            // Find root-based chord matching the lowest bass note if possible
            val bassCandidate = candidateChords.firstOrNull { it.first == lowestPitchClass }
            // Find inverted candidate (where root != lowest bass)
            val nonBassCandidate = candidateChords.firstOrNull { it.first != lowestPitchClass }

            val primaryName: String
            val equivalentName: String
            val variantName: String

            if (nonBassCandidate != null && bassCandidate != null && nonBassCandidate.first != bassCandidate.first) {
                // Inverted or polychord voicing: e.g. bass D with F major triad -> Dm7 vs F/D
                primaryName = bassCandidate.second
                equivalentName = "${nonBassCandidate.second}/$lowestNoteName"
                variantName = nonBassCandidate.second
            } else if (bassCandidate != null) {
                primaryName = bassCandidate.second
                // Genuine music-theory pro alternate notation / substitution
                equivalentName = when {
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("maj7") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("maj7", "Δ7")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m7") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("m7", "-7")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("7") && !bassCandidate.second.endsWith("maj7") && !bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m7") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("7", "dom7")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m7b5") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("m7b5", "ø7")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("dim7") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("dim7", "°7")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("dim") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("dim", "°")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("aug") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("aug", "+")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("maj9") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("maj9", "Δ9")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m9") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("m9", "-9")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("9") && !bassCandidate.second.endsWith("maj9") && !bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m9") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("9", "dom9")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("maj11") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("maj11", "Δ11")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m11") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("m11", "-11")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("maj13") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("maj13", "Δ13")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m13") -> bassCandidate.second.replace("m13", "-13")
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("sus4") -> "${NOTE_NAMES[(lowestPitchClass + 5) % 12]}sus2/$lowestNoteName"
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("sus2") -> "${NOTE_NAMES[(lowestPitchClass + 7) % 12]}sus4/$lowestNoteName"
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("6") -> "${NOTE_NAMES[(lowestPitchClass + 9) % 12]}m7/$lowestNoteName"
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m6") -> "${NOTE_NAMES[(lowestPitchClass + 9) % 12]}m7b5/$lowestNoteName"
                    bassCandidate.second.endsWith("m") -> "${bassCandidate.second} Min"
                    bassCandidate.second == lowestNoteName -> "$lowestNoteName Maj"
                    else -> ""
                }
                variantName = if (equivalentName.isNotEmpty()) equivalentName else bassCandidate.third
            } else {
                // Inverted slash chord (lowest bass is an inversion note)
                val topCandidate = candidateChords.first()
                primaryName = "${topCandidate.second}/$lowestNoteName"
                equivalentName = topCandidate.second
                variantName = topCandidate.second
            }

            return DetectedChord(
                primaryName = primaryName,
                equivalentName = equivalentName,
                variantName = variantName,
                formula = notesFormatted,
                notesList = uniquePitchClasses.map { NOTE_NAMES[it] }
            )
        }

        // Voicing approximation for 3+ notes
        if (uniquePitchClasses.size >= 3) {
            val rootName = NOTE_NAMES[lowestPitchClass]
            val intervals = uniquePitchClasses.map { (it - lowestPitchClass + 12) % 12 }.sorted()

            val hasMaj3 = intervals.contains(4)
            val hasMin3 = intervals.contains(3)
            val hasPerf5 = intervals.contains(7)
            val hasDom7 = intervals.contains(10)
            val hasMaj7 = intervals.contains(11)
            val has9th = intervals.contains(2)
            val has11th = intervals.contains(5)
            val has13th = intervals.contains(9)

            val inferredSuffix = when {
                hasMaj3 && hasDom7 && has13th -> "13"
                hasMaj3 && hasMaj7 && has13th -> "maj13"
                hasMin3 && hasDom7 && has11th -> "m11"
                hasMaj3 && hasDom7 && has9th -> "9"
                hasMaj3 && hasMaj7 && has9th -> "maj9"
                hasMin3 && hasDom7 && has9th -> "m9"
                hasMaj3 && hasPerf5 && hasMaj7 -> "maj7"
                hasMaj3 && hasPerf5 && hasDom7 -> "7"
                hasMin3 && hasPerf5 && hasDom7 -> "m7"
                hasMaj3 && hasPerf5 -> ""
                hasMin3 && hasPerf5 -> "m"
                else -> ""
            }

            if (inferredSuffix.isNotEmpty()) {
                val notesFormatted = uniquePitchClasses.map { NOTE_NAMES[it] }.joinToString(" · ")
                return DetectedChord(
                    primaryName = "$rootName$inferredSuffix",
                    equivalentName = when (inferredSuffix) {
                        "maj7" -> "${rootName}Δ7"
                        "m7" -> "$rootName-7"
                        "7" -> "$rootName dom7"
                        else -> ""
                    },
                    variantName = "",
                    formula = notesFormatted,
                    notesList = uniquePitchClasses.map { NOTE_NAMES[it] }
                )
            }
        }

        // Clean fallback: root note without fake "Harmonie" or "Cluster"
        val rootName = NOTE_NAMES[lowestPitchClass]
        val clusterStr = uniquePitchClasses.map { NOTE_NAMES[it] }.joinToString(" · ")
        return DetectedChord(
            primaryName = rootName,
            equivalentName = "",
            variantName = "",
            formula = clusterStr,
            notesList = uniquePitchClasses.map { NOTE_NAMES[it] }
        )
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components

/**
 * Display-side chord model, split the way MixerPreview.jsx draws it:
 * a big root, a smaller quality, an optional slash bass, the "ALSO" chips,
 * the note chips and the inversion label.
 *
 * The JSX canvas is 891 x 411 px and matches 891 x 411 dp, so its fontSize
 * values are used as-is (1 canvas px = 1 dp). See AGENTS.md.
 */
data class ChordDisplay(
    val root: String,
    val quality: String,
    val bass: String?,
    val also: List<String>,
    val notes: List<String>,
    val inversion: String
) {
    /** Length of the full chord symbol, used by the JSX to pick the root size. */
    val symbolLength: Int get() = (root + quality + (bass?.let { "/$it" } ?: "")).length

    /**
     * Root size, stepped down as the symbol grows. The fixed 28/24 split of the
     * JSX let long symbols (e.g. F♯m7/G♯) run past their box and collide with
     * the note chips, so the size now follows the real length.
     */
    val rootFontSp: Float get() = when {
        symbolLength > 9 -> 17f
        symbolLength > 7 -> 20f
        symbolLength > 5 -> 24f
        else -> 28f
    }

    companion object {
        private val ROOT_RE = Regex("^([A-G][#b♯♭]?)(.*)$")

        /** JSX `note()`: sharp sign rendered as the musical ♯ glyph. */
        private fun pretty(note: String): String = note.replace("#", "♯")

        /** Short labels: nothing at root position, then 1st / 2nd / 3rd. */
        private val INVERSION_LABELS = listOf("", "1st", "2nd", "3rd")

        fun from(chord: DetectedChord?): ChordDisplay? {
            if (chord == null) return null
            val symbol = chord.primaryName
            if (symbol.isBlank()) return null

            val slash = symbol.indexOf('/')
            val head = if (slash >= 0) symbol.substring(0, slash) else symbol
            val bassRaw = if (slash >= 0) symbol.substring(slash + 1) else null

            val m = ROOT_RE.find(head)
            val root = pretty(m?.groupValues?.get(1).orEmpty().ifBlank { head })
            val quality = m?.groupValues?.get(2).orEmpty()

            val notes = chord.notesList.map { pretty(it) }
            val bass = bassRaw?.let { pretty(it) }

            val also = buildList {
                listOfNotNull(chord.equivalentName, chord.alternateNames, chord.alternateName2)
                    .map { it.trim() }
                    .filter { it.isNotEmpty() && it != symbol && it != chord.primaryName }
                    .forEach { if (!contains(it)) add(it) }
            }.take(3)

            val inversion = when {
                bass == null -> INVERSION_LABELS[0]
                else -> {
                    val idx = notes.indexOfFirst { it == bass }
                    INVERSION_LABELS.getOrNull(if (idx <= 0) 1 else idx)
                        ?: "${idx}th inversion"
                }
            }

            return ChordDisplay(root, quality, bass, also, notes, inversion)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyRow
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.CircleShape
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Slider
import androidx.compose.material3.SliderDefaults
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextAlign
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextOverflow
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.soundstage.mixer.model.TrackChannel
import com.soundstage.mixer.ui.theme.*

/**
 * Compact Horizontal Fader Strip used when Virtual Piano Keyboard is expanded on screen.
 * Seamlessly exposes Volume Slider, M/S, Pan, Meter, and Track Name in a compact format.
 */
@Composable
fun CompactHorizontalFaderStrip(
    track: TrackChannel,
    onVolumeChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    onPowerToggle: () -> Unit = {},
    onPanChange: (Float) -> Unit = {},
    onMuteClick: () -> Unit = {},
    onSoloClick: () -> Unit = {},
    onTrackNameClick: () -> Unit = {},
    onFxClick: () -> Unit = {},
    onTrackSettingsClick: () -> Unit = {},
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val isMaster = track.isMaster
    val isEnabled = track.isEnabled
    val vibrantLedColor = track.resolvedColor()

    val audioActivity = if (isEnabled) maxOf(track.peakMeterL, track.peakMeterR).coerceIn(0f, 1f) else 0f
    val auraAlpha = (0.25f + audioActivity * 0.60f).coerceIn(0.25f, 0.85f)

    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .width(228.dp)
            .height(58.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
            .background(
                Brush.horizontalGradient(
                    0.0f to Color.Transparent,
                    0.7f to vibrantLedColor.copy(alpha = auraAlpha * 0.25f),
                    1.0f to vibrantLedColor.copy(alpha = auraAlpha * 0.55f)
                )
            )
            .border(1.dp, if (isMaster) Color(0x6622D3EE) else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline.copy(alpha = 0.25f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            .testTag("compact_track_${track.id}"),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(7.dp)
    ) {
        // Track ID & Name Column
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .width(62.dp)
                .clickable { if (!isMaster) onTrackNameClick() }
        ) {
            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
            ) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(17.dp)
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(if (isEnabled) vibrantLedColor else Color(0xFF64748B)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = if (isMaster) "M" else "${track.id}",
                        fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        color = Color.Black,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                        lineHeight = 10.sp,
                        style = androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(
                            platformStyle = androidx.compose.ui.text.PlatformTextStyle(
                                includeFontPadding = false
                            )
                        )
                    )
                }
                Text(
                    text = if (isMaster) "MASTER" else "Track ${track.id}",
                    fontSize = 9.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = if (isEnabled) TextPrimary else TextDim2,
                    maxLines = 1
                )
            }

            val patchText = if (isMaster) "Main Out" else track.patchName.ifEmpty { track.soundfontName.ifEmpty { "-" } }
            Text(
                text = patchText,
                fontSize = 8.sp,
                color = TextDim,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
            )
        }

        // Horizontal Volume Slider & VU Meter
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
        ) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "${(track.volume * 100).toInt()}%",
                    fontSize = 8.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = vibrantLedColor
                )

                // Mini Stereo VU Meter
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .width(18.dp)
                            .height(4.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                            .background(Color(0xFF0F172A))
                    ) {
                        if (track.peakMeterL > 0.05f) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxHeight()
                                    .fillMaxWidth(track.peakMeterL.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                                    .background(vibrantLedColor)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .width(18.dp)
                            .height(4.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                            .background(Color(0xFF0F172A))
                    ) {
                        if (track.peakMeterR > 0.05f) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxHeight()
                                    .fillMaxWidth(track.peakMeterR.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                                    .background(vibrantLedColor)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Slider(
                value = track.volume,
                onValueChange = onVolumeChange,
                enabled = isEnabled,
                colors = SliderDefaults.colors(
                    thumbColor = Color.White,
                    activeTrackColor = vibrantLedColor,
                    inactiveTrackColor = Color(0x33FFFFFF)
                ),
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(24.dp)
            )
        }

        // Mute & Solo Buttons
        if (!isMaster) {
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(24.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                        .background(if (track.isSolo) SoloAmber else Color(0x1AFFFFFF))
                        .clickable { onSoloClick() },
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "S",
                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        color = if (track.isSolo) Color.White else TextDim
                    )
                }
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(24.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                        .background(if (track.isMuted) MuteRed else Color(0x1AFFFFFF))
                        .clickable { onMuteClick() },
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "M",
                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        color = if (track.isMuted) Color.White else TextDim
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Compact Rack of horizontal fader channels shown when virtual piano keyboard is visible.
 */
@Composable
fun CompactHorizontalFadersRack(
    tracks: List<TrackChannel>,
    masterTrack: TrackChannel,
    onVolumeChange: (Int, Float) -> Unit,
    onPowerToggle: (Int) -> Unit,
    onPanChange: (Int, Float) -> Unit,
    onMuteClick: (Int) -> Unit,
    onSoloClick: (Int) -> Unit,
    onTrackNameClick: (Int) -> Unit,
    onFxClick: (Int) -> Unit,
    onTrackSettingsClick: (Int) -> Unit = {},
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    LazyRow(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        items(tracks, key = { it.id }) { track ->
            CompactHorizontalFaderStrip(
                track = track,
                onVolumeChange = { onVolumeChange(track.id, it) },
                onPowerToggle = { onPowerToggle(track.id) },
                onPanChange = { onPanChange(track.id, it) },
                onMuteClick = { onMuteClick(track.id) },
                onSoloClick = { onSoloClick(track.id) },
                onTrackNameClick = { onTrackNameClick(track.id) },
                onFxClick = { onFxClick(track.id) },
                onTrackSettingsClick = { onTrackSettingsClick(track.id) }
            )
        }
    }
}
```
