/* ═══════════════════════════ PURE LOGIC ═══════════════════════════ */

/**
 * Boundary adapter between the app's note-name storage ("C#4") and the MIDI numbers
 * this UI works with. Kept here so the keyboard file stays self-contained.
 */
object VkbMidi {
    const val NOTE_MIN = 24
    const val NOTE_MAX = 108

    private val names = listOf("C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B")
    private val regex = "([A-Ga-g]#?)(-?\\d+)".toRegex()

    fun midiToKt(midi: Int): String {
        val m = midi.coerceIn(0, 127)
        return "${names[m % 12]}${m / 12 - 1}"
    }

    fun ktToMidi(name: String): Int? {
        val match = regex.matchEntire(name.trim()) ?: return null
        val semitone = when (match.groupValues[1].uppercase()) {
            "C" -> 0; "C#" -> 1
            "D" -> 2; "D#" -> 3
            "E" -> 4
            "F" -> 5; "F#" -> 6
            "G" -> 7; "G#" -> 8
            "A" -> 9; "A#" -> 10
            "B" -> 11
            else -> return null
        }
        val octave = match.groupValues[2].toIntOrNull() ?: return null
        return (octave + 1) * 12 + semitone
    }
}

object KeyboardLogic {
    const val NOTE_MIN = 24     // C1
    const val NOTE_MAX = 108    // C8

    private val blackPitchClasses = setOf(1, 3, 6, 8, 10)
    val notes: List<Int> = (NOTE_MIN..NOTE_MAX).toList()
    fun isBlack(note: Int) = (note % 12) in blackPitchClasses
    val whites: List<Int> = notes.filter { !isBlack(it) }
    val blacks: List<Int> = notes.filter { isBlack(it) }
    val whiteCount: Int = whites.size                       // 50

    private val whiteIndex: Map<Int, Int> = whites.withIndex().associate { it.value to it.index }
    private val whitesBefore: Map<Int, Int> = notes.associateWith { n -> whites.count { it < n } }

    fun whiteIndexOf(note: Int): Int = whiteIndex[note] ?: -1
    fun whitesBeforeOf(note: Int): Int = whitesBefore[note] ?: 0

    /** Horizontal center of a key, as a fraction (0..1) of the keyboard width. */
    fun centerFraction(note: Int): Float =
        if (isBlack(note)) whitesBeforeOf(note) / whiteCount.toFloat()
        else (whiteIndexOf(note) + 0.5f) / whiteCount

    fun barLeftFraction(low: Int): Float = centerFraction(low) - 0.5f / whiteCount
    fun barRightFraction(high: Int): Float = centerFraction(high) + 0.5f / whiteCount

    fun nearestNote(fraction: Float): Int = notes.minByOrNull { abs(centerFraction(it) - fraction) } ?: NOTE_MIN

    /** New low limit while dragging the LOW handle. totalDx = finger travel since the drag started. */
    fun draggedLow(origLow: Int, high: Int, totalDx: Float, widthPx: Float, insetPx: Float): Int {
        val ww = widthPx / whiteCount
        val handleX = barLeftFraction(origLow) * widthPx + insetPx + totalDx
        val target = nearestNote((handleX - insetPx + ww / 2f) / widthPx)
        return target.coerceIn(NOTE_MIN, high - 1)
    }

    /** New high limit while dragging the HIGH handle. */
    fun draggedHigh(low: Int, origHigh: Int, totalDx: Float, widthPx: Float, insetPx: Float): Int {
        val ww = widthPx / whiteCount
        val handleX = barRightFraction(origHigh) * widthPx - insetPx + totalDx
        val target = nearestNote((handleX + insetPx - ww / 2f) / widthPx)
        return target.coerceIn(low + 1, NOTE_MAX)
    }

    /** Slides the whole range, keeping its width. */
    fun shifted(origLow: Int, origHigh: Int, totalDx: Float, widthPx: Float): Pair<Int, Int> {
        val width = origHigh - origLow
        val pxPerSemitone = widthPx / (NOTE_MAX - NOTE_MIN)
        val low = (origLow + (totalDx / pxPerSemitone).roundToInt()).coerceIn(NOTE_MIN, NOTE_MAX - width)
        return low to (low + width)
    }

    /** Hit test: black keys first (upper part), then white keys. */
    fun noteAt(x: Float, y: Float, widthPx: Float, heightPx: Float, blackHeightPx: Float): Int? {
        if (x < 0f || x > widthPx || y < 0f || y > heightPx) return null
        val ww = widthPx / whiteCount
        val bw = ww * 0.6f
        if (y <= blackHeightPx) {
            for (m in blacks) {
                val c = whitesBeforeOf(m) * ww
                if (x >= c - bw / 2f && x <= c + bw / 2f) return m
            }
        }
        return whites[(x / ww).toInt().coerceIn(0, whiteCount - 1)]
    }

    private val names = arrayOf("C", "C♯", "D", "D♯", "E", "F", "F♯", "G", "G♯", "A", "A♯", "B")
    fun noteName(note: Int): String = names[note % 12] + (note / 12 - 1)
}

/* ═══════════════════════════ DIMENSIONS ═══════════════════════════ */

private val KeysHeight = 50.dp
private val BlackHeight = 31.dp
private val RestLineH = 2.6.dp
private val OpenLineH = 29.dp
private val RestGap = 0.5.dp
private val OpenGap = 3.2.dp
private val RestZone = 5.dp
private val OpenZone = 25.dp
private val PitchRestH = 46.dp
private val PitchOpenH = 74.dp
private val HandleInset = 12.dp

/* ═══════════════════════════ CONTAINER ═══════════════════════════ */

@Composable
fun VirtualKeyboardContainer(
    lines: List<KeyboardLine>,
    expanded: Boolean,
    pressedNotes: Set<Int>,
    theme: KeyboardTheme,
    pressStyle: KeyboardPressStyle,
    actions: VirtualKeyboardActions,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    chrome: KeyboardChrome = KeyboardChrome()
) {
    // one staggered spring per line: they unfold in order, and fold back in reverse order
    val progress = lines.indices.map { rememberLineProgress(expanded, it, lines.size) }
    val p0 = (progress.firstOrNull() ?: if (expanded) 1f else 0f)
    val p0c = p0.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    var draggingId by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var tick by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }

    // folds back by itself after 5 quiet seconds (any touch inside the container restarts the delay)
    LaunchedEffect(expanded, draggingId, tick) {
        if (expanded && draggingId == null) {
            delay(5000)
            actions.onExpandedChange(false)
        }
    }

    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
    Row(
        modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .shadow(lerp(4.dp, 14.dp, p0c), shape, ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color.Black)
            .clip(shape)
            .background(chrome.frame) // OPAQUE and fixed: the container does not follow the theme
            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.07f), shape)
            .pointerInput(Unit) {
                awaitPointerEventScope {
                    while (true) {
                        awaitPointerEvent(PointerEventPass.Initial)
                        tick++
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(start = 6.dp, end = 6.dp, top = 6.dp, bottom = 5.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom
    ) {
        PitchBendStrip(
            height = lerp(PitchRestH, PitchOpenH, p0c),
            theme = theme,
            chrome = chrome,
            onValue = actions.onPitchBend
        )

        val density = LocalDensity.current
        BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            val widthPx = with(density) { maxWidth.toPx() }
            Column {
                LinesArea(
                    lines = lines,
                    progress = progress,
                    expanded = expanded,
                    widthPx = widthPx,
                    draggingId = draggingId,
                    onDragging = { id, on -> draggingId = if (on) id else if (draggingId == id) null else draggingId },
                    actions = actions
                )
                Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(KeysHeight)) {
                    KeyboardKeys(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                        theme = theme,
                        pressStyle = pressStyle,
                        pressedNotes = pressedNotes,
                        onKeyDown = actions.onKeyDown,
                        onKeyUp = actions.onKeyUp
                    )
                    // selection halo: only while a line is being moved, flat color, no outline
                    lines.forEach { line ->
                        key(line.id) {
                            val a by animateFloatAsState(if (draggingId == line.id) 1f else 0f, tween(160), label = "halo")
                            if (a > 0.01f) {
                                val l = KeyboardLogic.barLeftFraction(line.low) * widthPx
                                val r = KeyboardLogic.barRightFraction(line.high) * widthPx
                                Box(
                                    Modifier
                                        .offset { IntOffset(l.roundToInt(), 0) }
                                        .width(with(density) { (r - l).toDp() })
                                        .fillMaxHeight()
                                        .background(line.color.copy(alpha = 0.4f * a), RoundedCornerShape(3.dp))
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun rememberLineProgress(expanded: Boolean, index: Int, count: Int): Float {
    val anim = remember { Animatable(if (expanded) 1f else 0f) }
    LaunchedEffect(expanded) {
        delay(if (expanded) index * 45L else (count - 1 - index) * 30L)
        anim.animateTo(if (expanded) 1f else 0f, spring(dampingRatio = 0.62f, stiffness = 360f))
    }
    return anim.value
}

/* ═══════════════════════════ LINES ═══════════════════════════ */

@Composable
private fun LinesArea(
    lines: List<KeyboardLine>,
    progress: List<Float>,
    expanded: Boolean,
    widthPx: Float,
    draggingId: String?,
    onDragging: (String, Boolean) -> Unit,
    actions: VirtualKeyboardActions
) {
    val p0 = (progress.firstOrNull() ?: 0f)
    val p0c = p0.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val tickAlpha = 0.5f + 0.5f * p0c
    Box(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(top = lerp(3.dp, 2.dp, p0c))
            .drawBehind {
                // octave marks, behind the lines (left edge of every C)
                val ww = size.width / KeyboardLogic.whiteCount
                KeyboardLogic.whites.filter { it % 12 == 0 }.forEach { m ->
                    val x = KeyboardLogic.whiteIndexOf(m) * ww
                    drawLine(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f * tickAlpha), Offset(x, 0f), Offset(x, size.height), 1.dp.toPx())
                }
            }
            .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null, enabled = !expanded) {
                actions.onExpandedChange(true)
            }
    ) {
        Column {
            lines.forEachIndexed { i, line ->
                if (i > 0) Spacer(Modifier.height(lerp(RestGap, OpenGap, progress[i].coerceIn(0f, 1.2f))))
                key(line.id) {
                    LayerLine(
                        line = line,
                        p = progress[i],
                        expanded = expanded,
                        widthPx = widthPx,
                        active = draggingId == line.id,
                        onDragging = { on -> onDragging(line.id, on) },
                        onRange = { lo, hi -> actions.onLineRangeChange(line.id, lo, hi) }
                    )
                }
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(lerp(RestZone, OpenZone, p0.coerceIn(0f, 1.2f))))
        }
        // grip: tap to fold
        Box(
            Modifier
                .align(Alignment.TopCenter)
                .offset(y = (-5).dp)
                .size(width = 44.dp, height = 12.dp)
                .alpha(p0c)
                .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null, enabled = expanded) {
                    actions.onExpandedChange(false)
                },
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            Box(Modifier.size(width = 30.dp, height = 3.5.dp).background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.28f), RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun LayerLine(
    line: KeyboardLine,
    p: Float,
    expanded: Boolean,
    widthPx: Float,
    active: Boolean,
    onDragging: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onRange: (Int, Int) -> Unit
) {
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val current by rememberUpdatedState(line)
    val insetPx = with(density) { HandleInset.toPx() }
    val h = lerp(RestLineH, OpenLineH, p).coerceAtLeast(1.dp)
    val radius = lerp(2.dp, 10.dp, p.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
    val l = KeyboardLogic.barLeftFraction(line.low) * widthPx
    val r = KeyboardLogic.barRightFraction(line.high) * widthPx
    val chipAlpha = ((p - 0.6f) / 0.4f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val handleScale = ((p - 0.55f) / 0.45f).coerceIn(0f, 1.15f)
    val lift by animateFloatAsState(if (active) -1f else 0f, tween(150), label = "lift")
    val origin = remember { IntArray(2) } // low / high at the start of a handle drag

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(h)) {
        // the bar: flat track color, no gradient. Drag the body to slide the whole range.
        Box(
            Modifier
                .offset { IntOffset(l.roundToInt(), (lift * 1.dp.toPx()).roundToInt()) }
                .width(with(density) { (r - l).toDp() })
                .fillMaxHeight()
                .background(line.color, RoundedCornerShape(radius))
                .pointerInput(expanded, widthPx) {
                    if (!expanded) return@pointerInput
                    var total = 0f
                    var oLow = 0
                    var oHigh = 0
                    detectDragGestures(
                        onDragStart = { total = 0f; oLow = current.low; oHigh = current.high; onDragging(true) },
                        onDrag = { change, drag ->
                            change.consume()
                            total += drag.x
                            val (nl, nh) = KeyboardLogic.shifted(oLow, oHigh, total, widthPx)
                            onRange(nl, nh)
                        },
                        onDragEnd = { onDragging(false) },
                        onDragCancel = { onDragging(false) }
                    )
                }
        ) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxSize().alpha(chipAlpha),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                NoteChip(KeyboardLogic.noteName(line.low))
                Text(
                    line.name,
                    Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
                    color = Color.White, fontSize = 12.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    maxLines = 1, softWrap = false
                )
                NoteChip(KeyboardLogic.noteName(line.high))
            }
        }
        // handles: white disc with a dark dot, inset 12 dp from each end of the bar
        LineHandle(
            centerX = l + insetPx, heightDp = h, scale = handleScale, active = active, expanded = expanded, widthPx = widthPx,
            onDragStart = { origin[0] = current.low; origin[1] = current.high; onDragging(true) },
            onDragEnd = { onDragging(false) },
            onDrag = { total -> onRange(KeyboardLogic.draggedLow(origin[0], current.high, total, widthPx, insetPx), current.high) }
        )
        LineHandle(
            centerX = r - insetPx, heightDp = h, scale = handleScale, active = active, expanded = expanded, widthPx = widthPx,
            onDragStart = { origin[0] = current.low; origin[1] = current.high; onDragging(true) },
            onDragEnd = { onDragging(false) },
            onDrag = { total -> onRange(current.low, KeyboardLogic.draggedHigh(current.low, origin[1], total, widthPx, insetPx)) }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun NoteChip(text: String) {
    Box(
        Modifier.background(Color(0xFF0A0E16).copy(alpha = 0.82f), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp)).padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 1.dp)
    ) {
        Text(text, color = Color.White, fontSize = 10.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, maxLines = 1)
    }
}

@Composable
private fun LineHandle(
    centerX: Float,
    heightDp: Dp,
    scale: Float,
    active: Boolean,
    expanded: Boolean,
    widthPx: Float,
    onDragStart: () -> Unit,
    onDragEnd: () -> Unit,
    onDrag: (totalDx: Float) -> Unit
) {
    Box(
        Modifier
            .offset {
                IntOffset(
                    (centerX - 11.dp.toPx()).roundToInt(),
                    ((heightDp.toPx() - 22.dp.toPx()) / 2f).roundToInt()
                )
            }
            .size(22.dp)
            .scale(scale)
            .alpha(scale.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
            .pointerInput(expanded, widthPx) {
                if (!expanded) return@pointerInput
                var total = 0f
                detectDragGestures(
                    onDragStart = { total = 0f; onDragStart() },
                    onDrag = { change, drag -> change.consume(); total += drag.x; onDrag(total) },
                    onDragEnd = onDragEnd,
                    onDragCancel = onDragEnd
                )
            },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier.size(if (active) 14.dp else 12.dp).background(Color.White, CircleShape),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) { Box(Modifier.size(5.dp).background(Color(0xFF0F1726), CircleShape)) }
    }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════ PITCH BEND ═══════════════════════════ */

@Composable
private fun PitchBendStrip(height: Dp, theme: KeyboardTheme, chrome: KeyboardChrome, onValue: (Float) -> Unit) {
    val v = remember { Animatable(0f) }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)
    fun setFromY(y: Float, h: Float) {
        val value = (1f - (y / h) * 2f).coerceIn(-1f, 1f)
        scope.launch { v.snapTo(value); onValue(value) }
    }
    fun release() {
        scope.launch { v.animateTo(0f, spring(dampingRatio = 0.45f, stiffness = 380f)) { onValue(value) } }
    }
    Canvas(
        Modifier
            .width(34.dp)
            .height(height)
            .clip(shape)
            .background(chrome.well)
            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.06f), shape)
            .pointerInput(Unit) {
                detectVerticalDragGestures(
                    onDragStart = { setFromY(it.y, size.height.toFloat()) },
                    onVerticalDrag = { change, _ -> change.consume(); setFromY(change.position.y, size.height.toFloat()) },
                    onDragEnd = { release() },
                    onDragCancel = { release() }
                )
            }
    ) {
        val pad = 11.dp.toPx()
        val travel = size.height / 2f - pad
        val cx = size.width / 2f
        val cy = size.height / 2f - v.value * travel
        // inner shadow of the well
        drawRect(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.45f), Color.Transparent), endY = 14.dp.toPx()))
        // rail
        drawRoundRect(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f), Offset(cx - 1.dp.toPx(), pad), Size(2.dp.toPx(), size.height - pad * 2), CornerRadius(1.dp.toPx()))
        // fill from the center to the handle, in the theme color
        drawRoundRect(
            theme.press,
            Offset(cx - 1.dp.toPx(), minOf(cy, size.height / 2f)),
            Size(2.dp.toPx(), abs(size.height / 2f - cy)),
            CornerRadius(1.dp.toPx())
        )
        // handle: white bar, 24 × 11 dp
        val hw = 24.dp.toPx(); val hh = 11.dp.toPx()
        val top = cy - hh / 2f
        drawRoundRect(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.4f), Offset(cx - hw / 2f, top + 2.dp.toPx()), Size(hw, hh), CornerRadius(6.dp.toPx()))
        drawRoundRect(
            Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color.White, Color(0xFFCED3DE)), startY = top, endY = top + hh),
            Offset(cx - hw / 2f, top), Size(hw, hh), CornerRadius(6.dp.toPx())
        )
        drawLine(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.25f), Offset(cx - hw / 2f + 5.dp.toPx(), cy), Offset(cx + hw / 2f - 5.dp.toPx(), cy), 1.dp.toPx())
    }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════ KEYBOARD (NeoTune-style relief) ═══════════════════════════ */

@Composable
fun KeyboardKeys(
    modifier: Modifier,
    theme: KeyboardTheme,
    pressStyle: KeyboardPressStyle,
    pressedNotes: Set<Int>,
    onKeyDown: (Int) -> Unit,
    onKeyUp: (Int) -> Unit
) {
    val measurer = rememberTextMeasurer()
    val labelStyle = remember(theme.label) {
        TextStyle(color = theme.label.copy(alpha = 0.9f), fontSize = 7.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)
    }
    val labels = remember(theme.label) {
        KeyboardLogic.notes.filter { it % 12 == 0 }.associateWith { measurer.measure(KeyboardLogic.noteName(it), labelStyle) }
    }
    val blackHeightPx = with(LocalDensity.current) { BlackHeight.toPx() }
    val led = pressStyle == KeyboardPressStyle.Led
    val downCb by rememberUpdatedState(onKeyDown)
    val upCb by rememberUpdatedState(onKeyUp)

    Canvas(
        modifier.pointerInput(blackHeightPx) {
            // every finger tracks its own key: chords and glissandi work, a key is released only when no finger holds it
            val held = mutableMapOf<PointerId, Int>()
            awaitPointerEventScope {
                while (true) {
                    val event = awaitPointerEvent()
                    event.changes.forEach { ch ->
                        val prev = held[ch.id]
                        if (ch.pressed) {
                            val note = KeyboardLogic.noteAt(ch.position.x, ch.position.y, size.width.toFloat(), size.height.toFloat(), blackHeightPx)
                            if (note != prev) {
                                if (note == null) held.remove(ch.id) else held[ch.id] = note
                                if (prev != null && held.values.none { it == prev }) upCb(prev)
                                if (note != null && held.values.count { it == note } == 1) downCb(note)
                            }
                            ch.consume()
                        } else if (prev != null) {
                            held.remove(ch.id)
                            if (held.values.none { it == prev }) upCb(prev)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
            .drawWithCache {
                val geo = cacheGeometry(size.width)
                val brushes = cacheBrushes(theme, size.height)
                onDrawBehind {
            val w = size.width
            val kh = size.height
            val ww = w / KeyboardLogic.whiteCount
            val bw = ww * 0.6f
            val bh = BlackHeight.toPx()
            val px = 1.dp.toPx()

            // LED style: a short glow behind every pressed key
            if (led) {
                pressedNotes.forEach { m ->
                    if (KeyboardLogic.isBlack(m)) {
                        val l = KeyboardLogic.whitesBeforeOf(m) * ww - bw / 2f
                        drawRoundRect(theme.pressBlack.copy(alpha = 0.28f), Offset(l - 2 * px, -2 * px), Size(bw + 4 * px, bh + 4 * px), CornerRadius(4 * px))
                        drawRoundRect(theme.pressBlack.copy(alpha = 0.14f), Offset(l - 4 * px, -4 * px), Size(bw + 8 * px, bh + 8 * px), CornerRadius(6 * px))
                    } else {
                        val x = KeyboardLogic.whiteIndexOf(m) * ww
                        drawRoundRect(theme.press.copy(alpha = 0.28f), Offset(x - 2 * px, -2 * px), Size(ww + 4 * px, kh + 4 * px), CornerRadius(5 * px))
                        drawRoundRect(theme.press.copy(alpha = 0.14f), Offset(x - 4 * px, -4 * px), Size(ww + 8 * px, kh + 8 * px), CornerRadius(7 * px))
                    }
                }
            }

            // white keys
            geo.whites.forEachIndexed { idx, g ->
                val m = g.note
                val on = m in pressedNotes
                val dy = if (on) px else 0f
                val x = g.x + 0.45f * px
                val kw = ww - 0.9f * px
                val r = CornerRadius(2.6f * px)
                drawRoundRect(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f), Offset(x, dy + px), Size(kw, kh), r)
                if (on) {
                    drawRoundRect(theme.press, Offset(x, dy), Size(kw, kh), r)
                    drawRoundRect(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.14f), Offset(x, dy), Size(kw, 7 * px), r)
                } else {
                    drawRoundRect(brushes.white, Offset(x, 0f), Size(kw, kh), r)
                }
                drawRoundRect(theme.edge.copy(alpha = 0.55f), Offset(x, dy), Size(kw, kh), r, style = Stroke(0.6f * px))
                drawRoundRect(
                    Color.White.copy(alpha = if (on) 0.35f else theme.highlight),
                    Offset(x + 0.9f * px, dy + 0.9f * px), Size(kw - 1.8f * px, 2 * px), CornerRadius(px)
                )
                drawRoundRect(
                    Color.Black.copy(alpha = if (on) 0.1f else 0.06f),
                    Offset(x + px, dy + kh - 7 * px), Size(kw - 2 * px, 6 * px), CornerRadius(2 * px)
                )
                labels[m]?.let { lay ->
                    drawText(lay, topLeft = Offset(x + (kw - lay.size.width) / 2f, dy + kh - 9 * px - lay.size.height))
                }
            }

            // black keys, with a soft cast shadow on the white keys
            geo.blacks.forEach { g ->
                val m = g.note
                val on = m in pressedNotes
                val dy = if (on) 0.8f * px else 0f
                val l = g.x
                val r = CornerRadius(2.2f * px)
                drawRoundRect(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.18f), Offset(l - px, dy + 3 * px), Size(bw + 2 * px, bh), CornerRadius(3 * px))
                drawRoundRect(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.3f), Offset(l, dy + 1.8f * px), Size(bw, bh), r)
                if (on) {
                    drawRoundRect(theme.pressBlack, Offset(l, dy), Size(bw, bh), r)
                } else {
                    drawRoundRect(brushes.black, Offset(l, dy), Size(bw, bh), r)
                }
                drawRoundRect(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.55f), Offset(l, dy), Size(bw, bh), r, style = Stroke(0.6f * px))
                drawRoundRect(
                    Color.White.copy(alpha = if (on) 0.28f else 0.15f),
                    Offset(l + 1.2f * px, dy + 1.2f * px), Size(bw - 2.4f * px, 2.2f * px), CornerRadius(px)
                )
                val fy = dy + bh - 9 * px
                drawRoundRect(
                    brushes.blackFront, Offset(l + 0.8f * px, fy), Size(bw - 1.6f * px, 8.2f * px), CornerRadius(1.6f * px)
                )
                drawLine(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f), Offset(l + 0.9f * px, dy + 3 * px), Offset(l + 0.9f * px, dy + bh - 4 * px), 0.8f * px)
            }
                }
            }
    ) { }
}
/* Key geometry + gradients are built once per size/theme change, inside drawWithCache. */
private data class VkbKeyGeo(val note: Int, val x: Float)
private data class VkbGeometry(val whites: List<VkbKeyGeo>, val blacks: List<VkbKeyGeo>)
private data class VkbBrushes(val white: Brush, val black: Brush, val blackFront: Brush)

private fun cacheGeometry(w: Float): VkbGeometry {
    val ww = w / KeyboardLogic.whiteCount
    val bw = ww * 0.6f
    val whites = KeyboardLogic.whites.mapIndexed { idx, m -> VkbKeyGeo(m, idx * ww) }
    val blacks = KeyboardLogic.blacks.map { m -> VkbKeyGeo(m, KeyboardLogic.whitesBeforeOf(m) * ww - bw / 2f) }
    return VkbGeometry(whites, blacks)
}

private fun cacheBrushes(theme: KeyboardTheme, kh: Float): VkbBrushes = VkbBrushes(
    white = Brush.verticalGradient(0f to theme.whiteTop, 0.72f to theme.whiteMid, 1f to theme.whiteBottom, startY = 0f, endY = kh),
    black = Brush.verticalGradient(0f to theme.blackTop, 0.55f to theme.blackMid, 1f to theme.blackBottom, startY = 0f, endY = 31f),
    blackFront = Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0f), Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.13f)), startY = 0f, endY = 8.2f)
)

/* ═══════════════════════════ THEME PICKER (Settings → UI section) ═══════════════════════════ */

@Composable
fun KeyboardThemeSwatch(
    theme: KeyboardTheme,
    selected: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    chrome: KeyboardChrome,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
    Column(
        modifier
            .clip(shape)
            .background(if (selected) chrome.accent.copy(alpha = 0.12f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.04f))
            .border(1.dp, if (selected) chrome.accent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), shape)
            .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null, onClick = onClick)
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 7.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)
    ) {
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(38.dp)) {
            val px = 1.dp.toPx()
            drawRoundRect(chrome.frame, cornerRadius = CornerRadius(6 * px)) // the frame is the same for every theme
            val pad = 4 * px
            val kw = (size.width - pad * 2) / 4f
            for (k in 0 until 4) {
                val x = pad + k * kw
                drawRoundRect(
                    if (k == 1) theme.press else theme.whiteMid,
                    Offset(x + 0.5f * px, pad), Size(kw - px, size.height - pad * 2), CornerRadius(2 * px)
                )
            }
            listOf(0, 1, 3).forEach { k ->
                val c = pad + (k + 1) * kw
                drawRoundRect(theme.blackMid, Offset(c - kw * 0.3f, pad), Size(kw * 0.6f, (size.height - pad * 2) * 0.58f), CornerRadius(1.5f * px))
            }
        }
        Text(theme.name, color = Color(0xFFC9D2E2), fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 1)
    }
}

@Composable
private fun PressStyleSegment(value: KeyboardPressStyle, onChange: (KeyboardPressStyle) -> Unit, chrome: KeyboardChrome) {
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(11.dp)
    Row(Modifier.clip(shape).background(Color(0xFF0E131C)).padding(3.dp)) {
        listOf(KeyboardPressStyle.Color to "Color", KeyboardPressStyle.Led to "LED").forEach { (style, label) ->
            val on = style == value
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .background(if (on) chrome.accent.copy(alpha = 0.22f) else Color.Transparent)
                    .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onChange(style) }
                    .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Text(label, color = if (on) chrome.accent else Color(0xFF8690A4), fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components

import android.os.Build
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.blur
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

/**
 * Light blur applied to the page behind a floating window, so the window itself stays crisp.
 * The window must be a sibling of the blurred content, never a child, or it would blur itself.
 *
 * RenderEffect needs API 31; below that the scrim alone keeps the window readable.
 * Radius matches the JSX previews (2 to 3 px at the 1:1 canvas scale).
 */
fun Modifier.windowBackdropBlur(active: Boolean, radius: Dp = 2.5.dp): Modifier =
    if (active && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) blur(radius) else this

import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// DpManager — fenêtre 4 onglets
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@Composable
fun DpManager(
    open: Boolean,
    tab: String,
    onTabChange: (String) -> Unit,
    openTarget: Int?,
    pads: List<DrumPadItem>,
    drumSamples: List<StorageItem>,
    loops: List<StorageItem>,
    kits: List<DrumKitData>,
    activeKitName: String,
    scenes: List<Any>,
    onLoadKit: (String) -> Unit,
    onDeleteKit: (String) -> Unit,
    onSaveCurrentAsKit: (String) -> Unit,
    onAssign: (padIndex: Int, sample: StorageItem) -> Unit,
    onAssignLoop: (padIndex: Int, sample: StorageItem) -> Unit,
    onImportFiles: (tab: String) -> Unit = {},
    onLoadScene: (Any) -> Unit,
    onClose: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    if (!open) return

    var search by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var showSaveKitField by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var newKitName by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var selection by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf<String>()) }
    // Target pad for the assignment grid. Seeded from the pad the window was
    // opened from, then adjustable from the bar itself.
    var assignTarget by remember(openTarget) { mutableStateOf(openTarget) }

    // Both sample and loop tabs can assign onto a DrumPad; the target pad comes
    // from the assignment bar, so the tab only decides which file list is shown.
    val assigning = (tab == "DrumPad" || tab == "Loops") && assignTarget != null
    val filteredSamples = drumSamples.filter { search.isEmpty() || it.name.contains(search, true) }
    val filteredLoops = loops.filter { search.isEmpty() || it.name.contains(search, true) }
    val filteredKits = kits.filter { search.isEmpty() || it.name.contains(search, true) }

    BoxWithConstraints(modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val windowW = min(maxWidth * 0.92f, 660.dp)
        val windowH = min(maxHeight * 0.88f, 372.dp)
        val sidebarW = (windowW * 0.23f).coerceIn(100.dp, 154.dp)

        // Backdrop
        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(Color(0x9E06090E))
                .clickable(
                    interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                    indication = null
                ) { onClose() }
        )

        // Window
        Column(
            Modifier
                .size(width = windowW, height = windowH)
                .align(Alignment.Center)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF232C3E), Color(0xFF1A2230))))
                .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f), RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                .clickable(
                    interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                    indication = null
                ) { /* consume */ }
                .padding(12.dp)
        ) {
            // ─── Header ───
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(42.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .weight(1f)
                        .fillMaxHeight()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                        .background(Color(0xB30F141D))
                        .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart
                ) {
                    BasicTextField(
                        value = search,
                        onValueChange = { search = it },
                        singleLine = true,
                        textStyle = TextStyle(
                            color = Color(0xFFE9EDF5),
                            fontSize = 13.sp,
                            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
                        ),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        decorationBox = { inner ->
                            if (search.isEmpty()) Text(
                                "Search ${tab.lowercase()}",
                                color = Color(0xFF8690A4),
                                fontSize = 13.sp
                            )
                            inner()
                        }
                    )
                }
                if (tab == "DrumPad" || tab == "Loops") {
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .size(42.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF9DBDEB), Color(0xFF7FA3DD))))
                            .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onImportFiles(tab) },
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text("+", color = Color(0xFF0F1726), fontSize = 19.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
                    }
                }
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .size(42.dp)
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.07f))
                        .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f), CircleShape)
                        .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onClose() },
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text("✕", color = Color(0xFFE9EDF5), fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))

            // ─── Body ───
            Row(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
                // Sidebar
                Column(
                    Modifier
                        .width(sidebarW)
                        .fillMaxHeight()
                        .padding(end = 12.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        "BROWSER",
                        color = Color(0xFF7B859A),
                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        letterSpacing = 1.3.sp
                    )
                    listOf("Kits", "DrumPad", "Loops", "Scenes").forEach { key ->
                        val active = tab == key
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .height(30.dp)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                .background(
                                    if (active) DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.14f)
                                    else Color(0xFF0F141D).copy(alpha = 0.6f)
                                )
                                .border(
                                    1.dp,
                                    if (active) DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.55f)
                                    else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f),
                                    RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)
                                )
                                .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) {
                                    onTabChange(key)
                                    selection = emptySet()
                                    showSaveKitField = false
                                }
                                .padding(start = 12.dp),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                key,
                                color = if (active) DpColors.ACCENT else Color(0xFF9AA5BA),
                                fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Content
                Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight()) {
                    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                        Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
                            when (tab) {
                                "Kits" -> KitsContent(
                                    kits = filteredKits,
                                    activeKitName = activeKitName,
                                    showSaveField = showSaveKitField,
                                    newKitName = newKitName,
                                    onNewKitName = { newKitName = it },
                                    onStartSave = { showSaveKitField = true; newKitName = "" },
                                    onCancelSave = { showSaveKitField = false; newKitName = "" },
                                    onConfirmSave = {
                                        if (newKitName.isNotBlank()) {
                                            onSaveCurrentAsKit(newKitName.trim())
                                            showSaveKitField = false
                                            newKitName = ""
                                        }
                                    },
                                    onLoad = onLoadKit,
                                    onDelete = onDeleteKit,
                                )
                                "DrumPad" -> StorageListContent(
                                    items = filteredSamples,
                                    assigning = assigning,
                                    selection = selection,
                                    pads = pads,
                                    onItemClick = { sample ->
                                        if (assigning && assignTarget != null) {
                                            onAssign(assignTarget!!, sample)
                                        } else {
                                            selection = if (selection.contains(sample.name))
                                                selection - sample.name
                                            else selection + sample.name
                                        }
                                    },
                                    emptyText = "No samples"
                                )
                                "Loops" -> StorageListContent(
                                    items = filteredLoops,
                                    assigning = assigning,
                                    selection = selection,
                                    pads = pads,
                                    onItemClick = { loop ->
                                        if (assigning && assignTarget != null) {
                                            onAssignLoop(assignTarget!!, loop)
                                        } else {
                                            selection = if (selection.contains(loop.name))
                                                selection - loop.name
                                            else selection + loop.name
                                        }
                                    },
                                    emptyText = "No loops"
                                )
                                "Scenes" -> ScenesContent(scenes = scenes, onLoad = onLoadScene)
                            }
                        }
                        if (assigning && assignTarget != null) {
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                            AssignBar(
                                pads = pads,
                                target = assignTarget!!,
                                onSelectTarget = { assignTarget = it },
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(54.dp)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Kits
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@Composable
private fun KitsContent(
    kits: List<DrumKitData>,
    activeKitName: String,
    showSaveField: Boolean,
    newKitName: String,
    onNewKitName: (String) -> Unit,
    onStartSave: () -> Unit,
    onCancelSave: () -> Unit,
    onConfirmSave: () -> Unit,
    onLoad: (String) -> Unit,
    onDelete: (String) -> Unit,
) {
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        LazyColumn(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
            items(kits, key = { it.name }) { kit ->
                val active = kit.name == activeKitName
                Row(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(52.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                        .background(
                            Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(
                                Color.White.copy(alpha = if (active) 0.12f else 0.065f),
                                Color.White.copy(alpha = if (active) 0.07f else 0.03f)
                            ))
                        )
                        .border(
                            1.dp,
                            if (active) Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.17f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.06f),
                            RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                        )
                        .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onLoad(kit.name) }
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text(
                            kit.name,
                            color = Color(0xFFE9EDF5),
                            fontSize = 14.5.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                            maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(5.dp))
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
                            for (i in 0 until 8) {
                                val hasSample = kit.padSamples.getOrNull(i) != null
                                Box(
                                    Modifier
                                        .width(14.dp)
                                        .height(4.dp)
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                                        .background(
                                            if (hasSample) DpPalette.at(i)
                                            else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f)
                                        )
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (active) {
                        Text(
                            "ACTIVE",
                            color = Color(0xFFC7CFDD),
                            fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                            letterSpacing = 1.1.sp,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                        )
                    } else {
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .size(24.dp)
                                .clip(CircleShape)
                                .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onDelete(kit.name) },
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Text("✕", color = Color(0xFF6F7A90), fontSize = 12.sp)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
        if (showSaveField) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(40.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
            ) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .weight(1f)
                        .fillMaxHeight()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                        .background(Color(0xFF0F141D))
                        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart
                ) {
                    BasicTextField(
                        value = newKitName,
                        onValueChange = onNewKitName,
                        singleLine = true,
                        textStyle = TextStyle(color = Color(0xFFE9EDF5), fontSize = 13.sp),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        decorationBox = { inner ->
                            if (newKitName.isEmpty()) Text(
                                "Kit name…",
                                color = Color(0xFF6F7A90),
                                fontSize = 13.sp
                            )
                            inner()
                        }
                    )
                }
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .height(34.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                        .background(DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.20f))
                        .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onConfirmSave() }
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text("Save", color = DpColors.ACCENT, fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
                }
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .height(34.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                        .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
                        .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onCancelSave() }
                        .padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text("Cancel", color = Color(0xFFC7CFDD), fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        } else {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(40.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                    .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.04f))
                    .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.15f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                    .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onStartSave() },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Text(
                    "+ Save current pads as a kit",
                    color = Color(0xFF9AA5BA),
                    fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Storage list (samples + loops)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@Composable
private fun StorageListContent(
    items: List<StorageItem>,
    assigning: Boolean,
    selection: Set<String>,
    pads: List<DrumPadItem>,
    onItemClick: (StorageItem) -> Unit,
    emptyText: String,
) {
    if (items.isEmpty()) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
            Text(emptyText, color = Color(0xFF6F7A90), fontSize = 13.sp)
        }
        return
    }
    LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
        items(items, key = { it.name }) { s ->
            val on = selection.contains(s.name)
            val usedBy = pads.firstOrNull { it.sampleFileName == s.name }?.id
            // Long-press previews the sample (JSX: 360 ms hold shows a 4-bar
            // activity indicator; release or tap elsewhere cancels it).
            var previewing by remember(s.name) { mutableStateOf(false) }
            val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
            Row(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(40.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                    .background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(
                            Color.White.copy(alpha = if (on) 0.16f else 0.065f),
                            Color.White.copy(alpha = if (on) 0.08f else 0.03f)
                        ))
                    )
                    .border(
                        1.dp,
                        if (on) DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.45f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.06f),
                        RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                    )
                    .pointerInput(s.name) {
                        detectTapGestures(
                            onPress = {
                                val job = scope.launch {
                                    delay(360)
                                    previewing = true
                                }
                                tryAwaitRelease()
                                job.cancel()
                                previewing = false
                            },
                            onTap = { onItemClick(s) },
                        )
                    }
                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
            ) {
                if (!assigning) {
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .size(18.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                            .background(if (on) DpColors.ACCENT else Color.Transparent)
                            .border(
                                1.5.dp,
                                if (on) Color.Transparent else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.22f),
                                RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)
                            ),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        if (on) Text(
                            "✓",
                            color = Color(0xFF0F1726),
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                }
                Text(
                    s.name,
                    color = Color(0xFFE9EDF5),
                    fontSize = 14.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                if (previewing) DpPreviewBars()
                if (usedBy != null && !assigning) {
                    Text(
                        "P$usedBy",
                        color = Color(0xFFB5BFD3),
                        fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                            .padding(horizontal = 7.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                    )
                }
                if (s.formattedSize.isNotEmpty()) {
                    Text(
                        s.formattedSize,
                        color = Color(0xFF7B859A),
                        fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Four-bar activity indicator shown while a sample row is long-pressed
 * (JSX `samples` row: bars of 2.5x14 dp, scaleY .35 -> 1, 0.5 + 0.12s per bar).
 * Only composed while the preview is active, so it costs nothing at rest.
 */
@Composable
private fun DpPreviewBars() {
    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "sfPreview")
    val bar0 by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.35f, targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(500, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing), RepeatMode.Reverse),
        label = "sfPreviewBar0")
    val bar1 by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.35f, targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(620, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing), RepeatMode.Reverse),
        label = "sfPreviewBar1")
    val bar2 by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.35f, targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(740, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing), RepeatMode.Reverse),
        label = "sfPreviewBar2")
    val bar3 by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.35f, targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(860, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing), RepeatMode.Reverse),
        label = "sfPreviewBar3")
    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom) {
        listOf(bar0, bar1, bar2, bar3).forEach { sc ->
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .width(2.5.dp)
                    .height(14.dp)
                    .graphicsLayer {
                        scaleY = sc
                        transformOrigin = TransformOrigin(0.5f, 1f)
                    }
                    .background(DpColors.ACCENT, RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
            )
        }
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Scenes
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@Composable
private fun ScenesContent(
    scenes: List<Any>,
    onLoad: (Any) -> Unit,
) {
    if (scenes.isEmpty()) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
            Text(
                "Scenes available in next update",
                color = Color(0xFF6F7A90),
                fontSize = 13.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
            )
        }
        return
    }
    LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
        items(scenes.size) { idx ->
            val scene = scenes[idx]
            Row(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(52.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                    .background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(
                            Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.065f),
                            Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.03f)
                        ))
                    )
                    .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.06f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                    .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onLoad(scene) }
                    .padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
            ) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .size(34.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                        .background(DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.16f)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text("♫", color = DpColors.ACCENT, fontSize = 16.sp)
                }
                Text(
                    (scene as? com.soundstage.mixer.model.ScenePreset)?.name ?: "Scene ${idx + 1}",
                    color = Color(0xFFE9EDF5),
                    fontSize = 14.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                Text(
                    "LOAD",
                    color = Color(0xFFC7CFDD),
                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Assign bar (one cell per DrumPad; 8 or 16 depending on the active grid)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@Composable
private fun AssignBar(
    pads: List<DrumPadItem>,
    target: Int,
    onSelectTarget: (Int) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    // Follow the active grid size (8 or 16): the real pad list holds 24 entries,
    // so keying off `pads.size` squeezed 24 cells into one row.
    val count = if (pads.size <= 8) 8 else 16
    Row(
        modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF2A3447), Color(0xFF1E2736))))
            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .padding(6.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (count > 8) 3.dp else 5.dp)
    ) {
        for (i in 0 until count) {
            val pad = pads.getOrNull(i)
            // Identity comes from the pad itself; the index is only a fallback.
            val padId = pad?.id ?: (i + 1)
            val isTarget = padId == target
            val color = DpPalette.at(i)
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .weight(1f)
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(if (count > 8) 8.dp else 11.dp))
                    .background(
                        Brush.linearGradient(listOf(
                            color.copy(alpha = if (isTarget) 0.53f else 0.19f),
                            Color(0xFF1F2739)
                        ))
                    )
                    .border(
                        if (isTarget) 1.5.dp else 0.dp,
                        if (isTarget) color else Color.Transparent,
                        RoundedCornerShape(if (count > 8) 8.dp else 11.dp)
                    )
                    .padding(horizontal = if (count > 8) 3.dp else 5.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                    .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onSelectTarget(padId) }
            ) {
                Column {
                    Text(
                        "D$padId",
                        color = if (isTarget) Color.White else Color(0xFF8E99AE),
                        fontSize = if (count > 8) 8.5.sp else 9.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                        maxLines = 1
                    )
                    Text(
                        pad?.label ?: "+",
                        color = if (pad != null) Color(0xFFE9EDF5) else Color(0xFF566075),
                        fontSize = if (count > 8) 8.5.sp else 10.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fun DpTopBar(

    metroOn: Boolean,
    onOpenMetro: () -> Unit,
    onOpenSettings: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    pageSelector: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
    // Loop-patch chip, only on the LiveLooper page: the reference puts it in the

) {
    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()

            Text("←", color = DpColors.SOFT, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

            Text("DrumPad", color = DpColors.SOFT, fontSize = 13.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        }

        // Metro pill

        }
    }

@Composable
private fun BpmStepButton(symbol: String, delta: Int, onBpmChange: (Int) -> Unit) {
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var rampJob by remember { mutableStateOf<Job?>(null) }
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .size(28.dp)
            .clip(CircleShape)
            .background(Color(0xFF202839))
            .pointerInput(delta) {
                awaitEachGesture {
                    awaitFirstDown(requireUnconsumed = false)
                    onBpmChange(delta)
                    rampJob = scope.launch {
                        delay(420L)
                        var step = 260L
                        while (isActive) {
                            onBpmChange(delta)
                            delay(step)
                            step = (step * 0.85f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(28L)
                        }
                    }
                    try {
                        while (true) {
                            val ev = awaitPointerEvent()
                            if (ev.changes.all { !it.pressed }) break
                        }
                    } finally {
                        rampJob?.cancel()
                        rampJob = null
                    }
                }
            },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
        Text(
            symbol,
            color = DpColors.SOFT,
            fontSize = 15.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun DpMetronomeOverlay(
    state: MetroState,
    onChange: (MetroState) -> Unit,
    onClose: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    Box(modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        DpSideSheet(title = "Metronome", onClose = onClose, width = 320.dp) {
            // ON / OFF toggle
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .size(9.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(if (state.on) Color(0xFF6EE7B7) else Color(0xFF4B5563))
                    )
                    Text(
                        if (state.on) "ON" else "OFF",
                        color = if (state.on) Color(0xFF6EE7B7) else DpColors.MUTE,
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
                    )
                }
                DpToggle(checked = state.on, onChange = { onChange(state.copy(on = it)) })
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))

            // SIGNATURE 5x2
            DpSectionLabel("SIGNATURE")
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                METRO_SIGNATURES.chunked(5).forEach { row ->
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                        row.forEach { sig ->
                            DpChipCell(
                                text = sig,
                                selected = state.sig == sig,
                                onClick = { onChange(state.copy(sig = sig)) },
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                            )
                        }
                        repeat(5 - row.size) { Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f)) }
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))

            // SUBDIVISION
            DpSectionLabel("SUBDIVISION")
            DpSeg(
                options = METRO_SUBDIVISIONS.map { it to if (it == "Triplet") "Triplet" else it },
                selected = state.sub,
                onChange = { onChange(state.copy(sub = it)) },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )

            Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))

            // SOUND 3x2
            DpSectionLabel("SOUND")
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                METRO_SOUNDS.chunked(3).forEach { row ->
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                        row.forEach { s ->
                            DpChipCell(
                                text = s,
                                selected = state.sound == s,
                                onClick = { onChange(state.copy(sound = s)) },
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                            )
                        }
                        repeat(3 - row.size) { Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f)) }
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))

            // VOLUME
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
                Text(
                    "VOLUME",
                    color = Color(0xFF7B859A),
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    letterSpacing = 1.2.sp,
                )
                DpSlider(
                    value = state.volume / 100f,
                    onChange = { onChange(state.copy(volume = (it * 100).toInt().coerceIn(0, 100))) },
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                Text(
                    "${state.volume}%",
                    color = Color(0xFFC7CFDD),
                    fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    modifier = Modifier.width(38.dp)
                )
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))

            // Toggles
            DpToggleRow("Accent beat 1", state.accent1) { onChange(state.copy(accent1 = it)) }
            DpToggleRow("Accent beats 1 & 3", state.accent13) { onChange(state.copy(accent13 = it)) }
            DpToggleRow("Visual flash", state.visualFlash) { onChange(state.copy(visualFlash = it)) }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))

            // Count-in
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(30.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
                Text(
                    "Count-in before REC",
                    color = Color(0xFFDCE2EE),
                    fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                DpSeg(
                    options = listOf("off" to "Off", "1 bar" to "1 bar", "2 bars" to "2 bars"),
                    selected = state.countIn,
                    onChange = { onChange(state.copy(countIn = it)) },
                    modifier = Modifier.width(140.dp),
                    height = 20.dp,
                )
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))

            // Tap tempo
            val tapRef = remember { TapTempoRef() }
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(32.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                    .background(DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.14f))
                    .border(1.dp, DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                    .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) {
                        val computed = tapRef.tap(System.currentTimeMillis())
                        if (computed != null) onChange(state.copy(tapBpm = computed))
                    },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = if (state.tapBpm > 0) "Tap Tempo · ${state.tapBpm} BPM" else "Tap Tempo",
                    color = DpColors.ACCENT,
                    fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

private class TapTempoRef {
    private var last: Long = 0L
    private val times = mutableListOf<Long>()
    fun tap(now: Long): Int? {
        if (now - last > 2500L) times.clear()
        times.add(now)
        last = now
        if (times.size > 5) times.removeAt(0)
        if (times.size < 2) return null
        var sum = 0L
        for (i in 1 until times.size) sum += times[i] - times[i - 1]
        val avg = sum.toDouble() / (times.size - 1)
        return (60000.0 / avg).toInt().coerceIn(40, 240)
    }
}

                    fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                DpSeg(
                    options = listOf(8 to "8", 16 to "16"),
                    selected = if (padCount == 16) 16 else 8,
                    onChange = { onPadCountChange(it) },
                    modifier = Modifier.width(80.dp),
                    height = 20.dp,
                )
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))

            DpSectionLabel("PERFORMANCE")
            DpToggleRow("Preload samples", preload, onPreloadChange)
            DpToggleRow("Haptics on pads", hapticPads, onHapticPadsChange)
            DpToggleRow("Haptics on loops", hapticLoops, onHapticLoopsChange)

            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))

            DpSectionLabel("DEFAULT LOOP")
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(30.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
                Text(
                    "Quantize",
                    color = Color(0xFFDCE2EE),
                    fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                DpSeg(
                    options = listOf("1/16" to "1/16", "free" to "Free"),
                    selected = quantize,
                    onChange = onQuantizeChange,
                    modifier = Modifier.width(110.dp),
                    height = 20.dp,
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun FxRow(
    name: String,
    on: Boolean,
    amount: Float,
    onToggle: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onAmount: (Float) -> Unit,
) {
    Row(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(38.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
    ) {
        // Custom small toggle 40x22
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(width = 40.dp, height = 22.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(11.dp))
                .background(if (on) DpColors.WARM else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.14f))
                .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onToggle(!on) },
        ) {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .align(if (on) Alignment.CenterEnd else Alignment.CenterStart)
                    .padding(2.dp)
                    .size(18.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (on) Color(0xFF1A1F2B) else Color(0xFFC7CFDD))
            )

            color = Color(0xFFE9EDF5),
            fontSize = 13.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            modifier = Modifier.width(82.dp)

        // Bar slider
        FxSlider(
            value = amount.coerceIn(0f, 1f),
            onColor = if (on) DpColors.WARM else DpColors.ACCENT,
            onChange = onAmount,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
        )
        Text(
            "${(amount * 100).toInt()}",
            color = Color(0xFF9AA5BA),
            fontSize = 11.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            modifier = Modifier.width(30.dp)

@Composable
private fun FxSlider(
    value: Float,
    onColor: Color,
    onChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    BoxWithConstraintsCompat(
        modifier = modifier.height(22.dp),
    ) { maxWidthPx ->
        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                .background(Color(0xFF0F141D))
                .pointerInput(Unit) {
                    awaitEachGesture {
                        val down = awaitFirstDown(requireUnconsumed = false)
                        val w = size.width.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f)
                        onChange((down.position.x / w).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                        while (true) {
                            val ev = awaitPointerEvent()
                            val ch = ev.changes.firstOrNull { it.id == down.id } ?: break
                            if (!ch.pressed) break
                            onChange((ch.position.x / w).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                            ch.consume()
                        }
                    }
                }
        ) {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .fillMaxWidth(value.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                    .background(
                        Brush.horizontalGradient(
                            listOf(onColor.copy(alpha = 0.4f), onColor)
                        )
                    )
            )
        }
    }
}
