// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Ring burst model (partagé Pad + NoteKey conceptuel — ici Pad uniquement)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
private data class RingBurst(val id: Long, val center: Offset)

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// DpPad — fidèle au JSX <Pad>
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@Composable
fun DpPad(
    index: Int,
    pad: DrumPadItem,
    color: Color,
    mode: String,
    runner: Boolean,
    flash: Boolean,
    ghost: Boolean,
    onDown: (Int) -> Unit,
    onUp: (Int) -> Unit,
    onVolumeChange: (Int, Int) -> Unit,
    appear: Boolean,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val isEmpty = pad.sampleFileName.isEmpty()
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    // ─── Local UI state ───
    var down by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var spec by remember { mutableStateOf(Offset(0.30f, 0.20f)) } // flood center normalisé 0..1
    var bursts by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<RingBurst>()) }
    var volOverlay by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var displayVol by remember { mutableStateOf((pad.volume * 100).toInt()) }
    var entryProgress by remember { mutableStateOf(if (appear) 0f else 1f) }

    // Sync display vol when pad.volume changes
    LaunchedEffect(pad.volume) { displayVol = (pad.volume * 100).toInt() }

    // Entry animation
    LaunchedEffect(appear) {
        if (appear) {
            kotlinx.coroutines.delay(index * 34L)
            entryProgress = 1f
        } else entryProgress = 1f
    }

    // Press scale
    val pressScale by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (down && !volOverlay) 0.978f else 1f,
        animationSpec = spring(dampingRatio = 0.6f, stiffness = 500f),
        label = "padScale"
    )

    // Flood alpha (JSX: lit ? .04s in : .5s out)
    val floodAlpha by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (flash && !isEmpty) 0.95f else 0f,
        animationSpec = if (flash) tween(40) else tween(500, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
        label = "floodAlpha"
    )

    // Entry alpha
    val entryAlpha = entryProgress

    // ─── Background gradient (JSX exact) ───
    val bgBrush = if (isEmpty) {
        Brush.linearGradient(
            colors = listOf(Color(0xFF1D2537), Color(0xFF141A28)),
            start = Offset.Zero,
            end = Offset.Infinite
        )
    } else {
        Brush.linearGradient(
            colors = listOf(
                color.copy(alpha = 0.25f),
                Color(0xFF1F2739),
                Color(0xFF151B2A)
            ),
            start = Offset.Zero,
            end = Offset.Infinite
        )
    }

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .graphicsLayer {
                scaleX = pressScale * (0.94f + 0.06f * entryAlpha)
                scaleY = pressScale * (0.94f + 0.06f * entryAlpha)
                alpha = entryAlpha
                translationY = (1f - entryAlpha) * 12f
            }
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(18.dp))
            .background(bgBrush)
            .noiseOverlay(0.07f)
            .pointerInput(pad.id) {
                // Swipe-volume via awaitEachGesture (up = augmenter)
                awaitEachGesture {
                    val firstDown = awaitFirstDown(requireUnconsumed = false)
                    val startY = firstDown.position.y
                    val startVol = pad.volume * 100f
                    var isVol = false
                    var currentVol = startVol
                    var lastDy = 0f

                    down = true
                    onDown(pad.id)
                    spec = Offset(
                        (firstDown.position.x / size.width.toFloat()).coerceIn(0.05f, 0.95f),
                        (firstDown.position.y / size.height.toFloat()).coerceIn(0.05f, 0.95f)
                    )
                    val id = System.nanoTime()
                    bursts = bursts + RingBurst(id, firstDown.position)
                    scope.launch {
                        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(700)
                        bursts = bursts.filterNot { it.id == id }
                    }

                    while (true) {
                        val ev = awaitPointerEvent()
                        val ch = ev.changes.firstOrNull { it.id == firstDown.id } ?: break
                        if (!ch.pressed) break
                        val dy = ch.position.y - startY
                        lastDy = abs(dy)
                        if (!isVol && lastDy > 8f * density) {
                            isVol = true
                            volOverlay = true
                            displayVol = (startVol).toInt()
                        }
                        if (isVol) {
                            currentVol = (startVol - dy / (size.height.toFloat() * 0.55f) * 100f)
                                .coerceIn(0f, 100f)
                            displayVol = currentVol.toInt()
                            onVolumeChange(pad.id, displayVol)
                            ch.consume()
                        }
                    }

                    down = false
                    if (isVol) {
                        scope.launch {
                            kotlinx.coroutines.delay(520)
                            volOverlay = false
                        }
                    } else {
                        onUp(pad.id)
                    }
                }
            }
    ) {
        // Highlight radial top-left (JSX: radial-gradient 120% 90% at 18% 0%)
        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(
                    Brush.radialGradient(
                        colors = listOf(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.11f), Color.Transparent),
                        center = Offset(0f, 0f),
                        radius = 2000f
                    )
                )
        )

        // Flood radial depuis touch (screen)
        if (floodAlpha > 0.01f) {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .drawBehind {
                        drawRect(
                            brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                                colors = listOf(
                                    color,
                                    color.copy(alpha = 0.60f),
                                    color.copy(alpha = 0.25f),
                                    Color.Transparent
                                ),
                                center = Offset(size.width * spec.x, size.height * spec.y),
                                radius = 3000f
                            ),
                            alpha = floodAlpha
                        )
                    }
            )
        }

        // Ghost radial (event loopé récent)
        if (ghost) {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .drawBehind {
                        drawRect(
                            brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                                colors = listOf(
                                    DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.26f),
                                    Color.Transparent
                                ),
                                center = Offset(size.width * 0.5f, size.height * 0.45f),
                                radius = 2500f
                            )
                        )
                    }
            )
        }

        // Ring bursts (Canvas)
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            val now = System.nanoTime()
            bursts.forEach { b ->
                // animation simple : rayon grossit, alpha diminue
                val ageMs = ((System.nanoTime() - b.id) / 1_000_000L).toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 700f)
                val progress = ageMs / 700f
                val scaleFactor = 0.35f + 2.35f * progress
                val r = 70.dp.toPx() * scaleFactor
                val alpha = (1f - progress) * 0.55f
                drawCircle(
                    brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                        colors = listOf(color.copy(alpha = alpha), Color.Transparent),
                        center = b.center,
                        radius = r
                    ),
                    radius = r,
                    center = b.center
                )
            }
        }

        // Noise overlay (déjà via modifier, mais on garde un léger local pour cohérence)
        // (déjà appliqué)

        // Content
        if (volOverlay) {
            DpVolumeOverlay(
                value = displayVol,
                color = color,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
            )
        } else {
            Column(
                Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(start = 12.dp, end = 12.dp, top = 10.dp, bottom = 9.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = if (isEmpty) "+ Assign" else pad.label,
                        color = if (isEmpty) Color(0xFF6F7A90) else Color(0xFFF1F4FA),
                        fontSize = 13.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                    )
                    if (mode == "edit") {
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .size(22.dp)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(11.dp))
                                .background(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f)),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Text("›", color = Color(0xFFB5BFD3), fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        }
                    }
                }
                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "D${index + 1}${if (pad.isLoopMode && !isEmpty) " · loop" else ""}",
                        color = if (flash && !isEmpty) Color.White else Color(0xFF8E99AE),
                        fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
                    )
                    if (!isEmpty) {
                        Text(
                            text = "${(pad.volume * 100).toInt()}%",
                            color = if (flash) Color.White else Color(0xFF8E99AE),
                            fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // LED ring (bord) si runner
        if (runner) {
            DpLedRing(
                color = color,
                mode = "run",
                durMs = 2000,
                radius = 18.dp,
                strokeWidth = 2.dp,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
            )
        }
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// DpLoopCase — fidèle au JSX <LoopCase>
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@Composable
fun DpLoopCase(
    index: Int,
    case: LooperEngine.Case,
    nowNs: Long,
    beatsPerBar: Int,
    barDurationNs: Long,
    onTap: () -> Unit,
    onLongPress: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val state = case.state
    val stateColor: Color = when (state) {
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Recording, LooperEngine.CaseState.Overdubbing -> DpColors.ROSE
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Queued -> DpColors.WARM
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Playing -> DpColors.ACCENT
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Stopped -> Color(0xFF7B859A)
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty -> Color(0xFF566075)
    }
    val borderColor = when (state) {
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty -> Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.06f)
        else -> stateColor.copy(alpha = 0.4f)
    }

    // Phase / barNow. While recording, `bars` is still the default 1: the real
    // length only lands in the case once the loop closes, so derive it from the
    // chosen length mode (or from elapsed time in auto mode).
    val bars = if (state == LooperEngine.CaseState.Recording) {
        case.lengthMode.toIntOrNull()?.coerceAtLeast(1) ?: case.bars.coerceAtLeast(1)
    } else case.bars.coerceAtLeast(1)
    val loopMs = (bars.toLong() * barDurationNs).coerceAtLeast(1L)
    var headPhase: Float? = null
    var barNow = 0
    when (state) {
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Playing, LooperEngine.CaseState.Overdubbing -> {
            if (case.startAtNs > 0L && nowNs >= case.startAtNs) {
                val elapsed = nowNs - case.startAtNs
                val ph = (elapsed.toFloat() / loopMs.toFloat()) % 1f
                headPhase = ph
                barNow = (ph * bars).toInt() + 1
            }
        }
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Recording -> {
            // Recording is anchored on recStartNs; startAtNs is only set once the
            // loop starts playing, so using it here left the head frozen.
            val anchorNs = if (case.recStartNs > 0L) case.recStartNs else case.startAtNs
            if (anchorNs > 0L && nowNs >= anchorNs) {
                val el = (nowNs - anchorNs).toFloat() / barDurationNs.toFloat()
                val denom = bars.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f)
                headPhase = (el % denom) / denom
                barNow = el.toInt() + 1
            }
        }
        else -> {}
    }

    // State label / icon
    val stateLabel: String = when (state) {
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Recording -> "REC"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Queued -> "QUEUED"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Playing -> "PLAY"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Overdubbing -> "OVERDUB"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Stopped -> "STOPPED"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty -> "EMPTY"
    }
    val statePulse = state == LooperEngine.CaseState.Recording || state == LooperEngine.CaseState.Queued
    val pulseAlpha = if (statePulse) {
        val t = ((System.nanoTime() % 1_000_000_000L) / 1_000_000_000f)
        (0.55f + 0.45f * kotlin.math.abs(kotlin.math.sin(t * PI.toFloat()))).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    } else 1f

    // Center text
    val centerPrimary: String = when (state) {
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty -> "+"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Recording -> "●"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Stopped -> "❚❚"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Queued -> "…"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Playing, LooperEngine.CaseState.Overdubbing -> "$barNow/$bars"
    }
    val centerSub: String = when (state) {
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty -> "tap to arm"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Recording -> "bar $barNow"
        else -> "$bars bar${if (bars == 1) "" else "s"}"
    }

    // Layer count / event dots
    val layers = case.layers
    val layerCount = layers.size
    val maxLayers = 4

    // Beat pulse indicator (very simplified — VM ne pousse pas encore de beat)
    val beatIndex = ((nowNs / (barDurationNs / 4).coerceAtLeast(1L)) % 4).toInt()

    // LedRing mode
    val ledMode = when (state) {
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Recording, LooperEngine.CaseState.Overdubbing -> "solid"
        LooperEngine.CaseState.Queued -> "queued"
        else -> "off"
    }

    // Gesture (tap vs long-press exclusifs via detectTapGestures)
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(19.dp))
            .background(Brush.linearGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF222B3E), Color(0xFF161C2B))))
            .border(1.dp, borderColor, RoundedCornerShape(19.dp))
            .noiseOverlay(0.06f)
            .pointerInput(index) {
                detectTapGestures(
                    onTap = { onTap() },
                    onLongPress = { onLongPress() }
                )
            }
    ) {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
        ) {
            // ─── Cadran (Canvas) ───
            // Sized from the case box instead of fillMaxHeight+aspectRatio: that
            // combination let the dial eat the whole width and squeezed the label
            // column, which is where "EMPTY" got clipped. The dial now takes at most
            // 44 % of the width so the state label always has room to render whole.
            BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxHeight()) {
                val dial = minOf(maxHeight, maxWidth * 0.44f)
                Box(Modifier.size(dial)) {
                Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                    val center = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f)
                    val maxR = size.minDimension / 2f
                    val scale = maxR / 50f

                    // outer ring r=44
                    drawCircle(
                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f),
                        radius = 44f * scale,
                        center = center,
                        style = Stroke(width = 3f * scale)
                    )

                    // bar ticks (une par bar)
                    for (i in 0 until bars) {
                        val angle = (i.toFloat() / bars.toFloat()) * 2f * PI.toFloat() - PI.toFloat() / 2f
                        val r1 = 41.5f * scale
                        val r2 = 47f * scale
                        val x1 = center.x + cos(angle) * r1
                        val y1 = center.y + sin(angle) * r1
                        val x2 = center.x + cos(angle) * r2
                        val y2 = center.y + sin(angle) * r2
                        val highlighted = headPhase != null && barNow == i + 1
                        drawLine(
                            color = if (highlighted) stateColor else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.28f),
                            start = Offset(x1, y1),
                            end = Offset(x2, y2),
                            strokeWidth = 1.6f * scale,
                            cap = StrokeCap.Round
                        )
                    }

                    // layer rings
                    val ringRadii = listOf(38f, 31f, 24f, 17f)
                    ringRadii.forEachIndexed { li, rr ->
                        drawCircle(
                            color = Color.White.copy(alpha = if (li < layerCount) 0.13f else 0.04f),
                            radius = rr * scale,
                            center = center,
                            style = Stroke(width = 1f * scale)
                        )
                    }

                    // event dots (par layer)
                    layers.forEachIndexed { li, layer ->
                        if (li >= ringRadii.size) return@forEachIndexed
                        val r = ringRadii[li] * scale
                        layer.forEach { ev ->
                            val frac = (ev.beatOffset.toFloat() / bars.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                            val a = frac * 2f * PI.toFloat() - PI.toFloat() / 2f
                            val x = center.x + cos(a) * r
                            val y = center.y + sin(a) * r
                            val dotColor = parseHexColorOr(ev.color, stateColor.copy(alpha = 0.95f))
                            drawCircle(dotColor, radius = 2.5f * scale, center = Offset(x, y))
                        }
                    }

                    // head arc + dot
                    val hp = headPhase
                    if (hp != null) {
                        val startFrac = (hp - 0.14f).coerceAtLeast(0f)
                        val startAngle = startFrac * 360f - 90f
                        val sweep = (hp - startFrac) * 360f
                        drawArc(
                            color = stateColor.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
                            startAngle = startAngle,
                            sweepAngle = sweep,
                            useCenter = false,
                            topLeft = Offset(center.x - 44f * scale, center.y - 44f * scale),
                            size = Size(88f * scale, 88f * scale),
                            style = Stroke(width = 3f * scale, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                        )
                        val ha = hp * 2f * PI.toFloat() - PI.toFloat() / 2f
                        val hx = center.x + cos(ha) * 44f * scale
                        val hy = center.y + sin(ha) * 44f * scale
                        drawCircle(color = stateColor, radius = 4.2f * scale, center = Offset(hx, hy))
                    }

                    // center primary + sub (dessinés en texte dans la Box, voir ci-dessous)
                }

                // center text overlay
                Column(
                    Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = centerPrimary,
                        color = Color(0xFFF1F4FA),
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = centerSub,
                        color = Color(0xFF8E99AE),
                        fontSize = 6.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                    )
                }
                }
            }

            // ─── Right panel ───
            Column(
                Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight(),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                // Top : L1 + état pulsé
                Column {
                    Text(
                        text = "L${index + 1}",
                        color = Color(0xFF8E99AD),
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = stateLabel,
                        color = if (state == LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty) Color(0xFF6F7A90) else stateColor.copy(alpha = pulseAlpha),
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        letterSpacing = 0.4.sp,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        softWrap = false,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )
                }

                // Bottom : layer bars + beat dots, as in the JSX LoopCase
                Column {
                    // 4 layer bars; filled layers glow like the reference.
                    Row(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)
                    ) {
                        for (i in 0 until maxLayers) {
                            val filled = i < layerCount
                            Box(
                                Modifier
                                    .weight(1f)
                                    .height(4.dp)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                                    .background(
                                        if (filled) stateColor
                                        else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.09f)
                                    )
                                    .drawBehind {
                                        if (filled) {
                                            drawRoundRect(
                                                color = stateColor.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
                                                cornerRadius = CornerRadius(2.dp.toPx()),
                                                topLeft = Offset(-1.dp.toPx(), -1.dp.toPx()),
                                                size = Size(size.width + 2.dp.toPx(), size.height + 2.dp.toPx()),
                                                style = Stroke(1.5.dp.toPx())
                                            )
                                        }
                                    }
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(5.dp))
                    // Bar-relative beat dots (the transport beat, not per-case), like JSX.
                    Row(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)
                    ) {
                        for (i in 0 until 4) {
                            Box(
                                Modifier
                                    .size(6.dp)
                                    .clip(CircleShape)
                                    .background(
                                        if (state != LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty && beatIndex == i) stateColor
                                        else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f)
                                    )
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // LedRing (bord)
        DpLedRing(
            color = stateColor,
            mode = ledMode,
            durMs = 2000,
            radius = 19.dp,
            strokeWidth = 2.dp,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        )
    }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Utilitaire couleur (event hex → Color)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
private fun parseHexColorOr(hex: String, fallback: Color): Color = try {
    Color(android.graphics.Color.parseColor(hex))
} catch (_: Exception) {
    fallback
}

fun hslToColor(h: Float, s: Float, l: Float, a: Float = 1f): Color {
    val hh = (((h % 360f) + 360f) % 360f) / 60f
    val c = (1f - abs(2f * l - 1f)) * s
    val x = c * (1f - abs(hh % 2f - 1f))
    val m = l - c / 2f
    val (r1, g1, b1) = when {
        hh < 1f -> Triple(c, x, 0f); hh < 2f -> Triple(x, c, 0f)
        hh < 3f -> Triple(0f, c, x); hh < 4f -> Triple(0f, x, c)
        hh < 5f -> Triple(x, 0f, c); else -> Triple(c, 0f, x)
    }
    return Color((r1+m).coerceIn(0f,1f), (g1+m).coerceIn(0f,1f), (b1+m).coerceIn(0f,1f), a.coerceIn(0f,1f))
}

fun vivColor(noteIndex: Int, alpha: Float = 1f): Color {
    return hslToColor(((noteIndex * 30 + 205) % 360).toFloat(), 0.84f, 0.61f, alpha)
}

private object NoiseTexture {
    val bitmap: ImageBitmap by lazy {
        val size = 120
        val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(size, size, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val rnd = Random(42L)
        for (y in 0 until size) for (x in 0 until size) {
            val v = rnd.nextInt(256); bmp.setPixel(x, y, AColor.argb(v, v, v, v))
        }
        bmp.asImageBitmap()
    }
    val brush: Brush = object : ShaderBrush() {
        override fun createShader(size: Size): android.graphics.Shader = ImageShader(bitmap, TileMode.Repeated, TileMode.Repeated)
    }
}

fun Modifier.noiseOverlay(alpha: Float = 0.06f): Modifier = this.drawWithContent {
    drawContent()
    drawRect(brush = NoiseTexture.brush, alpha = alpha, blendMode = BlendMode.Overlay)
}

@Composable
fun DpIcon(name: String, size: Dp = 16.dp, color: Color = Color.White) {
    Canvas(Modifier.size(size)) {
        val w = this.size.width
        val h = this.size.height
        val stroke = Stroke(width = w * 0.12f, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round)
        when (name) {
            "back" -> {
                drawLine(color, Offset(w*0.8f, h*0.5f), Offset(w*0.2f, h*0.5f), strokeWidth = w*0.12f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                drawLine(color, Offset(w*0.2f, h*0.5f), Offset(w*0.4f, h*0.3f), strokeWidth = w*0.12f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                drawLine(color, Offset(w*0.2f, h*0.5f), Offset(w*0.4f, h*0.7f), strokeWidth = w*0.12f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
            }
            "gear" -> {
                drawCircle(color, w*0.15f, center = Offset(w*0.5f, h*0.5f), style = stroke)
                for (i in 0 until 8) {
                    val angle = i * Math.PI / 4
                    val sx = (w*0.35f * cos(angle)).toFloat() + w*0.5f
                    val sy = (h*0.35f * sin(angle)).toFloat() + h*0.5f
                    val ex = (w*0.45f * cos(angle)).toFloat() + w*0.5f
                    val ey = (h*0.45f * sin(angle)).toFloat() + h*0.5f
                    drawLine(color, Offset(sx, sy), Offset(ex, ey), strokeWidth = w*0.1f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                }
            }
            "wave" -> {
                val path = Path().apply {
                    moveTo(w*0.1f, h*0.5f); lineTo(w*0.3f, h*0.5f)
                    lineTo(w*0.4f, h*0.2f); lineTo(w*0.6f, h*0.8f)
                    lineTo(w*0.7f, h*0.5f); lineTo(w*0.9f, h*0.5f)
                }
                drawPath(path, color, style = stroke)
            }
            "folder" -> {
                val path = Path().apply {
                    moveTo(w*0.1f, h*0.8f); lineTo(w*0.1f, h*0.2f)
                    lineTo(w*0.4f, h*0.2f); lineTo(w*0.5f, h*0.35f)
                    lineTo(w*0.9f, h*0.35f); lineTo(w*0.9f, h*0.8f); close()
                }
                drawPath(path, color, style = stroke)
            }
            "x" -> {
                drawLine(color, Offset(w*0.2f, h*0.2f), Offset(w*0.8f, h*0.8f), strokeWidth = w*0.12f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                drawLine(color, Offset(w*0.8f, h*0.2f), Offset(w*0.2f, h*0.8f), strokeWidth = w*0.12f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun DpRoll(value: Any, style: TextStyle) {
    val key = value.toString()
    var prevKey by remember { mutableStateOf(key) }
    val alphaAnim = remember { Animatable(1f) }
    val transAnim = remember { Animatable(0f) }
    LaunchedEffect(key) {
        if (prevKey != key) {
            alphaAnim.snapTo(0f); transAnim.snapTo(12f)
            launch { alphaAnim.animateTo(1f, tween(220, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)) }
            launch { transAnim.animateTo(0f, tween(220, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)) }
            prevKey = key
        }
    }
    Text(key, style = style, modifier = Modifier.graphicsLayer { alpha = alphaAnim.value; translationY = transAnim.value })
}

@Composable
fun <T> DpSeg(options: List<Pair<T, String>>, selected: T, onChange: (T) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, height: Dp = 22.dp, warn: Boolean = false) {
    val idx = options.indexOfFirst { it.first == selected }.coerceAtLeast(0)
    BoxWithConstraints(modifier.height(height + 6.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)).background(Color(0xCC0F141D)).border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)).padding(3.dp)) {
        val segW = maxWidth / options.size
        val offsetX by animateDpAsState(segW * idx, spring(dampingRatio = 0.6f, stiffness = 500f), label = "seg")
        Box(Modifier.offset(x = offsetX).width(segW).fillMaxHeight().shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(9.dp)).clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp)).background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF38445E), Color(0xFF2B3650)))))
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            options.forEach { (k, l) ->
                val isSel = selected == k
                val color = if (!isSel) Color(0xFF8690A4) else if (warn && l == "Edit") DpColors.WARM else Color(0xFFF1F4FA)
                Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight().clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onChange(k) }, contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Text(l, color = color, fontSize = 11.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun DpNoteKey(label: String, oct: Int, idx: Int, on: Boolean, ghost: Boolean, onToggle: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    // The TonicPad grid reads as one vivid sky-blue family, not a rainbow: the hue
    // stays in the sky-blue band and only drifts slightly so notes stay tellable
    // apart without breaking the palette.
    val hue = 203f + (idx % 4) * 6f
    val tintBase = hslToColor(hue, 0.86f, 0.62f)
    val tint98 = hslToColor(hue, 0.86f, 0.62f, 0.98f)
    val tint66 = hslToColor(hue, 0.86f, 0.62f, 0.66f)
    val tint26 = hslToColor(hue, 0.86f, 0.62f, 0.26f)
    var pressed by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val pressScale by animateFloatAsState(if (pressed) 0.955f else 1f, spring(dampingRatio = 0.6f, stiffness = 500f), label = "notePress")
    // A soft glow that rises with the note: the pad lights up instead of only
    // switching colour, which is what makes the grid feel responsive.
    val glow by animateFloatAsState(if (on) 1f else 0f, tween(190), label = "noteGlow")
    val bg = if (on) Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(tint98, tint66)) else Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(tint26, Color(0xFF1B2336)))

    Box(
        modifier = modifier.graphicsLayer { scaleX = pressScale; scaleY = pressScale }
            .shadow(
                elevation = (2f + 6f * glow).dp,
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(13.dp),
                spotColor = tintBase.copy(alpha = 0.75f * glow),
                ambientColor = tintBase.copy(alpha = 0.45f * glow)
            )
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(13.dp)).background(bg)
            .then(if (!on && ghost) Modifier.border(1.5.dp, hslToColor(hue, 0.86f, 0.62f, 0.9f), RoundedCornerShape(13.dp)) else Modifier)
            .noiseOverlay(0.06f).pointerInput(idx) { detectTapGestures(onPress = { pressed = true; onToggle(); tryAwaitRelease(); pressed = false }) },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Text(label, color = if (on) Color.White else tintBase, fontSize = 13.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
        if (on) Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) { Text(oct.toString(), color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.85f), fontSize = 8.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd).padding(6.dp)) }
    }
}

@Composable
fun DpVolumeKnob(value: Float, onChange: (Float) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: Dp = 52.dp, onDoubleTap: Float = 50f, showLabel: Boolean = true) {
    val v = value.coerceIn(0f, 100f)
    var dragStartV by remember { mutableStateOf(0f) }
    
    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp), modifier = modifier) {
        Box(Modifier.size(size).pointerInput(Unit) { detectDragGestures(onDragStart = { dragStartV = v }) { change, dragAmount ->
            change.consume()
            val newV = (dragStartV - dragAmount.y * 0.6f).coerceIn(0f, 100f)
            dragStartV = newV
            onChange(newV)
        } }.pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures(onDoubleTap = { onChange(onDoubleTap) }) }) {
            val angle = -135f + (v / 100f) * 270f
            Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                val c = center; val r = size.toPx() * 0.43f
                drawArc(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), 135f, 270f, false, style = Stroke(3.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round))
                if (v > 0.5f) drawArc(Brush.linearGradient(listOf(DpColors.ACCENT.copy(alpha = 0.45f), DpColors.ACCENT), Offset(c.x - r, c.y - r), Offset(c.x + r, c.y + r)), 135f, 270f * (v / 100f), false, style = Stroke(3.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round))
                drawCircle(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.5f), r * 0.76f, c + Offset(0f, 1.6.dp.toPx()))
                drawCircle(Brush.radialGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF626C90), Color(0xFF2C3550), Color(0xFF141A29)), Offset(c.x - r*0.28f, c.y - r*0.44f), r*1.56f), r * 0.74f, c)
                rotate(angle, c) { drawLine(DpColors.ACCENT, c + Offset(0f, -r * 0.95f), c + Offset(0f, -r * 0.55f), 2.4.dp.toPx(), StrokeCap.Round) }
            }
        }
        if (showLabel) Column {
            Text("VOLUME", color = Color(0xFF7B859A), fontSize = 9.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
            Text("${v.toInt()}%", color = Color(0xFFF1F4FA), fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun DpFxCase(fx: SurfaceFxChain, includeShimmer: Boolean, label: String, onOpen: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val effects = buildList { add(fx.filterOn); add(fx.brightnessOn); add(fx.delayOn); add(fx.reverbOn); if (includeShimmer) add(fx.shimmerOn) }
    val active = effects.count { it }; val anyOn = active > 0
    val bg = if (anyOn) Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF34304A), Color(0xFF262238))) else Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF2A3347), Color(0xFF1F2739)))
    Box(modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)).background(bg).then(if (anyOn) Modifier.border(1.dp, DpColors.WARM.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)) else Modifier).clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onOpen() }.padding(10.dp, 8.dp)) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                Text(label, color = if (anyOn) Color(0xFFF1F4FA) else Color(0xFF9AA5BA), fontSize = 12.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
                Text("$active/${effects.size}", color = if (anyOn) DpColors.WARM else Color(0xFF566075), fontSize = 10.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)
            }
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                effects.forEach { on -> Box(Modifier.weight(1f).height(4.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)).background(if (on) DpColors.WARM else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f))) }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DpLedRing — conic gradient spinnant (JSX `LedRing`)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
@Composable
fun DpLedRing(
    color: Color,
    mode: String,
    durMs: Int = 2000,
    radius: Dp = 18.dp,
    strokeWidth: Dp = 2.5.dp,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    if (mode == "off") return
    val rot by rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "ledSpin").animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f, targetValue = 360f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(durMs, easing = androidx.compose.animation.core.LinearEasing)),
        label = "ledRot"
    )
    val pulse by rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "ledPulse").animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.35f, targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(260, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing), RepeatMode.Reverse),
        label = "ledPulse"
    )
    Canvas(modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val stroke = strokeWidth.toPx()
        val r = size.minDimension / 2f - stroke / 2f
        when (mode) {
            "run" -> {
                rotate(rot) {
                    drawCircle(
                        brush = Brush.sweepGradient(
                            colors = listOf(Color.Transparent, Color.Transparent, color),
                            center = center
                        ),
                        radius = r,
                        style = Stroke(stroke)
                    )
                }
            }
            "queued" -> {
                drawCircle(color = color.copy(alpha = pulse), radius = r, style = Stroke(stroke))
            }
            else -> {
                drawCircle(color = color, radius = r, style = Stroke(stroke))
            }
        }
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DpVolumeOverlay — 14 bars + % (JSX `VolumeOverlay`)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
@Composable
fun DpVolumeOverlay(value: Int, color: Color, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val v = value.coerceIn(0, 100)
    val active = (v * 14f / 100f).toInt()
    Box(
        modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(Color(0xC7060914)),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
            Text(
                "$v%",
                color = Color(0xFFF1F4FA),
                fontSize = 22.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Black,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
            Row(
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom,
                modifier = Modifier.height(30.dp)
            ) {
                for (i in 0 until 14) {
                    val frac = i / 14f
                    val on = i < active
                    val barColor = when {
                        frac > 0.82f -> DpColors.ROSE
                        frac > 0.6f -> DpColors.WARM
                        else -> color
                    }
                    val h = (6 + frac * 22).dp
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .width(4.dp)
                            .height(h)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                            .background(if (on) barColor else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f))
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components.v2

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.border
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.interaction.MutableInteractionSource
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.offset
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.drawWithContent
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.shadow
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.StrokeCap
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextOverflow
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.soundstage.mixer.model.TrackChannel
import com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components.FaderSliderWithVuMeter
import com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components.MicroPanKnob
import com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components.TrackBottomRow

@Composable
fun ChannelStripV2(
    track: TrackChannel, isDimmed: Boolean, accentColor: Color,
    onVolumeChange: (Float) -> Unit, onPanChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    onSoloToggle: () -> Unit, onMuteToggle: () -> Unit,
    onTrackNameClick: () -> Unit, onFxClick: () -> Unit,
    onTrackSettingsClick: () -> Unit, onPowerToggle: () -> Unit,
    onDeleteTrack: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val level = if (isDimmed) 0f else maxOf(track.peakMeterL, track.peakMeterR).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val auraAlpha = (0.17f + level * 0.42f) * (if (isDimmed) 0.3f else 1f)

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            // Drop shadow under every strip case, to lift it off the panel.
            .shadow(7.dp, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp), spotColor = Color(0x8C000000), ambientColor = Color(0x59000000))
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)) // Fix: 14dp au lieu de 18
            .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF232C3D), Color(0xFF191F2B))))
            .border(1.dp, Color(0x0DFFFFFF), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
    ) {
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            drawRect(Brush.radialGradient(
                colors = listOf(accentColor.copy(alpha = auraAlpha), Color.Transparent),
                center = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height * 1.15f),
                radius = size.height * 0.75f))
            drawRect(Brush.verticalGradient(colors = listOf(
                Color.Transparent, Color.Transparent, accentColor.copy(alpha = auraAlpha * 0.55f))))
        }

        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 6.dp)) {
            // Name Plate : 22dp hauteur, font 9.5sp
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(22.dp)
                    // Relief: drop shadow below + a light 1 dp outline, flat fill.
                    .shadow(4.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                        spotColor = Color(0x8C000000), ambientColor = Color(0x40000000))
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .background(Color(0xFF20293A))
                    .border(1.dp, Color(0x1AFFFFFF), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .drawWithContent {
                        drawContent()
                        drawLine(
                            color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f),
                            start = Offset(size.width * 0.07f, 0.5f),
                            end = Offset(size.width * 0.93f, 0.5f),
                            strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx(),
                            cap = StrokeCap.Round
                        )
                        drawLine(
                            color = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
                            start = Offset(size.width * 0.07f, size.height - 0.5f),
                            end = Offset(size.width * 0.93f, size.height - 0.5f),
                            strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx(),
                            cap = StrokeCap.Round
                        )
                    }
                    .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onTrackNameClick() },
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                val name = track.patchName.ifBlank { track.soundfontName.ifBlank { "—" } }
                // JSX: textShadow "0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45)" - rendered by an offset ghost Text.
                Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Text(name, color = Color(0x8C000000),
                        fontSize = if (name.length > 15) 8.5.sp else 9.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        modifier = Modifier.offset(y = 1.5.dp))
                    Text(name, color = if (isDimmed) Color(0xFF8F9AB0) else Color(0xFFF1F4FA),
                        fontSize = if (name.length > 15) 8.5.sp else 9.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                }
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
            
            // Pan + S/M : hauteur 24dp
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(24.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                MicroPanKnob(track.pan, onPanChange, !isDimmed, accentColor, Modifier.size(24.dp))
                KeyBtnV2("S", track.isSolo, false, accentColor, onSoloToggle, Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight())
                KeyBtnV2("M", track.isMuted, true, accentColor, onMuteToggle, Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight())
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
            
            // Fader INCHANGÉ
            // The fader used to be gated on `!isDimmed`, which is true for a muted,
            // solo-dimmed *or* powered-off strip. On those strips the pointer input
            // was dropped entirely, so the thumb could not be moved and its LED sat
            // dark at rest — the "volume thumb falls to the bottom and will not stay"
            // report. Only a powered-off strip is truly un-fadable; a dimmed one is
            // still adjustable, so gate on the power state instead.
            FaderSliderWithVuMeter(
                value = track.volume, peakMeterL = track.peakMeterL, peakMeterR = track.peakMeterR,
                onValueChange = onVolumeChange, isMaster = false, isEnabled = track.isEnabled,
                ledColor = accentColor, showTicks = true,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
            
            // Bottom Row INCHANGÉ
            TrackBottomRow(
                trackColor = accentColor, active = track.isEnabled,
                onFx = onFxClick, onSettings = onTrackSettingsClick,
                onToggle = onPowerToggle, onUnload = onDeleteTrack,
                height = 22.dp, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun KeyBtnV2(
    label: String, isActive: Boolean, isMute: Boolean,
    accentColor: Color, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val bg = when {
        !isActive -> Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF3B4560), Color(0xFF2D364D)))
        isMute    -> Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFFC62828), Color(0xFF8E1B1B)))
        else      -> Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.85f), accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.60f)))
    }
    val fg = when {
        !isActive -> Color(0xFFB8C2D6)
        else      -> Color.White
    }
    val glowColor = when {
        !isActive -> Color.Transparent
        isMute    -> Color(0x70E53935)
        else      -> accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.44f)
    }
    val glowBlur = if (isActive) 10.dp else 0.dp

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            // Shadow first: placed after the background it was drawn on top of the
            // fill, and a solo cycle (elevation 10 -> 0) left the case blank.
            .shadow(glowBlur, RoundedCornerShape(7.dp), spotColor = glowColor, ambientColor = glowColor)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
            .background(bg)
            .border(1.dp, if (isActive) Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.18f) else Color.Transparent, RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
            .clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onClick() },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) { Text(label, color = fg, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold) } // Fix: 11sp
}

                Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                Row(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(36.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                        .background(Color(0xFF0F141D))
                        .padding(3.dp)
                ) {
                    listOf("immediate", "crossfade").forEach { mode ->
                        val sel = recallMode == mode
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .weight(1f)
                                .fillMaxHeight()
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                                .background(if (sel) Color(0xFF38445E) else Color.Transparent)
                                .clickable { recallMode = mode },
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                mode.replaceFirstChar { it.uppercase() },
                                color = if (sel) Color(0xFF8FB2E8) else tG,
                                fontSize = 13.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.height(18.dp))
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .height(38.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                            .background(Color(0x0AFFFFFF))
                            .border(1.dp, Color(0x1FFFFFFF), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                            .clickable { onDismiss() }
                            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            "Cancel",
                            color = Color(0xFFC7CFDD),
                            fontSize = 14.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .height(38.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                            .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(
                                Color(0xFF9DBDEB), Color(0xFF7FA3DD))))
                            .clickable {
                                if (name.isNotBlank()) onSave(name.trim(), recallMode)
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 24.dp),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            "Save",
                            color = Color(0xFF0F1726),
                            fontSize = 14.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

package com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components.v2

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.BoxScope
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color

/**
 * Fond du Mixer V2 :
 *  - Dégradé vertical (haut bleu-slate → bas noir-charbon)
 *  - Vignette lumineuse en haut (blanc 4.5%) et sombre en bas (noir 28%)
 *
 * NOTE : pour un grain fin (noise) fidèle au preview React, fournir
 *        R.drawable.noise_tile (120x120 PNG) et décommenter la ligne
 *        "// Image(...)" ci-dessous.
 */
@Composable
fun MixerBackgroundV2(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit
) {
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(
                Brush.verticalGradient(
                    listOf(
                        Color(0xFF151B27),
                        Color(0xFF111620)
                    )
                )
            )
    ) {
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            // Lumière diffuse en haut (halo blanc)
            drawRect(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.045f), Color.Transparent),
                    center = Offset(size.width / 2f, 0f),
                    radius = size.width * 0.8f
                )
            )
            // Vignette sombre en bas
            drawRect(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.28f), Color.Transparent),
                    center = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height),
                    radius = size.height
                )
            )
        }
        // Optionnel — grain fin (remplacer par ta ressource) :
        // Image(
        //     painter = painterResource(R.drawable.noise_tile),
        //     contentDescription = null,
        //     contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
        //     modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        //     alpha = 0.045f
        // )
        content()
    }
}

import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
