                Row(
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(30.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                ) {
                    DpSeg(
                        options = listOf("pads" to "Pads", "loops" to "Loops"),
                        selected = padMode,
                        onChange = { padMode = it },
                        height = 24.dp,
                        modifier = Modifier.width(120.dp)
                    )
                    if (padMode == "pads") {
                        DpSeg(
                            options = listOf("play" to "Play", "edit" to "Edit"),
                            selected = playEditMode,
                            onChange = { playEditMode = it },
                            height = 24.dp,
                            warn = true,
                            modifier = Modifier.width(100.dp)
                        )
                        SmallChip("${padCount}p", Modifier.height(24.dp)) {
                            viewModel.setPadCount(if (padCount == 8) 16 else 8)
                        }
                        SmallChip("Pads FX", Modifier.height(24.dp)) { padsFxOpen = true }
                    } else {
                        DpSeg(
                            options = listOf(
                                "auto" to "Auto",
                                "1" to "1", "2" to "2",
                                "4" to "4", "8" to "8"
                            ),
                            selected = loopLengthMode,
                            onChange = { loopLengthMode = it; viewModel.setLooperLengthMode(it) },
                            height = 24.dp,
                            modifier = Modifier.width(170.dp)
                        )
                        DpSeg(
                            options = listOf("1/16" to "1/16", "Free" to "Free"),
                            selected = loopQuantize,
                            onChange = {
                                loopQuantize = it
                                viewModel.setLooperQuantize(it == "1/16")
                            },
                            height = 24.dp,
                            modifier = Modifier.width(90.dp)
                        )
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                    if (padMode == "loops") {
                        // JSX TopBar shows a "Swing 54%" pill; tap cycles the presets.
                        val presets = listOf(50, 54, 58, 62, 66)
                        SmallChip("Swing ${uiState.looper.swing}%", Modifier.height(24.dp)) {
                            viewModel.setLooperSwing(
                                presets.firstOrNull { it > uiState.looper.swing } ?: presets.first()
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    BeatDots(beats = beatsPerBar, active = beatIdx)
                    if (anyRec != null && padMode == "pads") {
                        RecBadge()
                    }
                    if (padMode == "loops") {
                        val used = uiState.looper.cases.count { it.state != LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty }
                        val anyStopped = uiState.looper.cases.any { it.state == LooperEngine.CaseState.Stopped }
                        Text("$used/8 used", color = Color(0xFF7B859A), fontSize = 11.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        SmallChip(
                            label = if (anyStopped) "▶ Play all" else "■ Stop all",
                            modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp)
                        ) {
                            if (anyStopped) viewModel.playAllLoops() else viewModel.stopAllLoops()
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Grid
                Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
                    if (padMode == "pads") {
                        PadsGrid(
                            uiState = uiState,
                            padCount = padCount,
                            playEditMode = playEditMode,
                            onDown = { viewModel.onDrumPadPressed(it) },
                            onUp = { viewModel.onDrumPadReleased(it) },
                            onVolumeChange = { padId, vol -> viewModel.setDrumPadVolumeDirect(padId, vol / 100f) },
                            onOpenEditor = { editorPadId = it },
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                        )
                    } else {
                        LoopsGrid(
                            cases = uiState.looper.cases,
                            nowNs = nowNs,
                            beatsPerBar = beatsPerBar,
                            barDurationNs = barDurationNs,
                            onTap = { viewModel.tapLooperCase(it) },
                            onLongPress = { loopMenuIndex = it },
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    } // end !liveLooperPage

    // ═══════════ Overlays ═══════════
    if (metroOpen) {
        DpMetronomeOverlay(
            state = metroState,
            onChange = { next ->
                val wasOn = metroState.on
                metroState = next
                metroOn = next.on
                viewModel.setMetronomeSignature(next.sig)
                viewModel.setTransportSubdivision(next.sub)
                viewModel.setMetronomeSound(next.sound)
                viewModel.setMetronomeVolume(next.volume / 100f)
                viewModel.setMetronomeAccent1(next.accent1)
                viewModel.setMetronomeAccent13(next.accent13)
                viewModel.setMetronomeVisualFlash(next.visualFlash)
                viewModel.setMetronomeCountIn(next.countIn)
                if (next.tapBpm > 0) viewModel.setMetronomeTapBpm(next.tapBpm)
                if (next.on != wasOn) viewModel.toggleMetronome()
            },
            onClose = { metroOpen = false }
        )
    }

    if (settingsOpen) {
        DpDrumPadSettings(
            padCount = padCount,
            onPadCountChange = { viewModel.setPadCount(it) },
            preload = localPreload,
            onPreloadChange = { localPreload = it },
            hapticPads = localHapticPads,
            onHapticPadsChange = { localHapticPads = it },
            hapticLoops = localHapticLoops,
            onHapticLoopsChange = { localHapticLoops = it },
            quantize = loopQuantize,
            onQuantizeChange = {
                loopQuantize = it
                viewModel.setLooperQuantize(it == "1/16")
            },
            onClose = { settingsOpen = false }
        )
    }

    if (tonicFxOpen) {
        DpFxSheet(
            chain = uiState.fxChains.tonic,
            includeShimmer = true,
            label = "TonicPad",
            onChange = { viewModel.setTonicFxChain(it) },
            onClose = { tonicFxOpen = false }
        )
    }

    if (padsFxOpen) {
        DpFxSheet(
            chain = uiState.fxChains.pads,
            includeShimmer = false,
            label = "Pad",
            onChange = { viewModel.setPadsFxChain(it) },
            onClose = { padsFxOpen = false }
        )
    }

    // Loop action menu (JSX: menu on long press). Undo last layer / Double length / Play-Stop / Clear.
    loopMenuIndex?.let { mi ->
        val case = uiState.looper.cases.getOrNull(mi)
        val can = case != null && case.state != LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty
        DpLoopMenu(
            index = mi,
            canUndo = can && case!!.layers.isNotEmpty(),
            canDouble = can && case!!.bars < 8 && case.layers.isNotEmpty(),
            canToggle = can,
            canClear = can,
            canClearAll = uiState.looper.cases.any { it.state != LooperEngine.CaseState.Empty },
            isStopped = case?.state == LooperEngine.CaseState.Stopped,
            onAction = { action ->
                viewModel.longPressLooperCaseAction(mi, action)
                loopMenuIndex = null
            },
            onDismiss = { loopMenuIndex = null }
        )
    }

    if (editorPadId != null) {
        val pad = uiState.drumPads.firstOrNull { it.id == editorPadId }
        if (pad != null) {
            DpPadEditor(
                pad = pad,
                color = DpPalette.at((pad.id - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)),
                onChange = { updated ->
                    viewModel.updateDrumPadCustomization(
                        updated.id, updated.label, updated.colorStyle, updated.isLoopMode
                    )
                },
                onClear = {
                    viewModel.assignDrumSampleOrLoop(pad.id, "", "", isLoop = false)
                    editorPadId = null
                },
                onAssignClick = {
                    managerTab = "DrumPad"
                    managerTarget = pad.id
                    managerOpen = true
                    editorPadId = null
                },
                onClose = { editorPadId = null }
            )
        }
    }

    if (managerOpen) {
        DpManager(
            open = true,
            tab = managerTab,
            onTabChange = { managerTab = it },
            openTarget = managerTarget,
            pads = uiState.drumPads,
            drumSamples = uiState.realDrumPadFiles,
            loops = uiState.realLoopFiles,
            kits = uiState.kits,
            activeKitName = activeKitName,
            scenes = uiState.scenes,
            onLoadKit = { name -> viewModel.loadKit(name) },
            onDeleteKit = { name -> viewModel.deleteKit(name) },
            onSaveCurrentAsKit = { name -> viewModel.saveCurrentPadsAsKit(name) },
            onAssign = { padIndex, sample ->
                viewModel.assignDrumSampleOrLoop(padIndex, sample.name, sample.path, isLoop = false)
            },
            onAssignLoop = { padIndex, loop ->
                viewModel.assignDrumSampleOrLoop(padIndex, loop.name, loop.path, isLoop = true)
            },
            onImportFiles = onImportFiles,
            onLoadScene = { scene ->
                (scene as? ScenePreset)?.let { viewModel.selectScene(it.name) }
            },
            onClose = { managerOpen = false }
        )
    }

    // ═══════════ LiveLooper overlays (patch window, dialogs, toast) ═══════════
    if (liveLooperPage) {
        com.soundstage.mixer.looper.LiveLooperOverlays(
            state = uiState.liveLooperState,
            actions = liveLooperActions,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        )
    }
}

/**
 * Left column shared by the DrumPad and LiveLooper pages: the 3x4 TonicPad grid
 * plus the octave / Multi / Clear row. Extracted so the LiveLooper page can keep
 * the TonicPad visible next to the loop lanes, exactly like the reference, without
 * duplicating the note-key wiring.
 */
@Composable
private fun TonicPadColumn(
    uiState: MixerUiState,
    onNote: (String) -> Unit,
    onOctMinus: () -> Unit,
    onOctPlus: () -> Unit,
    onMulti: () -> Unit,
    onClear: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    Column(modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
            TONIC_NOTES.chunked(3).forEachIndexed { rowIdx, rowNotes ->
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                    rowNotes.forEachIndexed { colIdx, note ->
                        val idx = rowIdx * 3 + colIdx
                        DpNoteKey(
                            label = note, oct = 0, idx = idx,
                            on = uiState.activeTonicNotes.contains(note),
                            ghost = false,
                            onToggle = { onNote(note) },
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight()
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(26.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Box(Modifier.size(24.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).background(Color(0xFF243047)).clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onOctMinus() }, contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Text("−", color = Color(0xFFE3E8F2), fontSize = 13.sp)
            }
            Row(Modifier.width(48.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Text("Oct", color = Color(0xFF7B859A), fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                Spacer(Modifier.width(4.dp))
                Text(parseOctave(uiState.tonicOctaveRange).toString(), color = Color(0xFFF1F4FA), fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace)
            }
            Box(Modifier.size(24.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).background(Color(0xFF243047)).clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onOctPlus() }, contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Text("+", color = Color(0xFFE3E8F2), fontSize = 13.sp)
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))

            Box(Modifier.height(24.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).background(if (uiState.isMultiPadEnabled) Color(0x248FB2E8) else Color.Transparent).border(1.dp, if (uiState.isMultiPadEnabled) Color(0x8C8FB2E8) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onMulti() }.padding(horizontal = 8.dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Text("Multi", color = if (uiState.isMultiPadEnabled) DpColors.ACCENT else Color(0xFF8690A4), fontSize = 10.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
            }
            Box(Modifier.height(24.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)).clickable(interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }, indication = null) { onClear() }.padding(horizontal = 8.dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Text("Clear", color = Color(0xFFC7CFDD), fontSize = 10.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold)
            }
        }
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Grilles
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@Composable
private fun PadsGrid(
    uiState: MixerUiState,
    padCount: Int,
    playEditMode: String,
    onDown: (Int) -> Unit,
    onUp: (Int) -> Unit,
    onVolumeChange: (Int, Int) -> Unit,
    onOpenEditor: (Int) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val cols = 4
    val rows = if (padCount <= 8) 2 else 4
    val pads = uiState.drumPads.take(padCount)
    Column(
        modifier = modifier,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
    ) {
        for (r in 0 until rows) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
            ) {
                for (c in 0 until cols) {
                    val idx = r * cols + c
                    val pad = pads.getOrNull(idx)
                    if (pad == null) {
                        Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight())
                    } else if (playEditMode == "edit") {
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .weight(1f)
                                .fillMaxHeight()
                                .clickable { onOpenEditor(pad.id) }
                        ) {
                            DpPad(
                                index = idx,
                                pad = pad,
                                color = DpPalette.at(idx),
                                mode = "edit",
                                runner = false,
                                flash = false,
                                ghost = false,
                                onDown = {},
                                onUp = {},
                                onVolumeChange = { _, _ -> },
                                appear = false,
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                            )
                        }
                    } else {
                        DpPad(
                            index = idx,
                            pad = pad,
                            color = DpPalette.at(idx),
                            mode = "play",
                            runner = pad.isLoopPlaying,
                            flash = pad.isPressed,
                            ghost = false,
                            onDown = onDown,
                            onUp = onUp,
                            onVolumeChange = onVolumeChange,
                            appear = false,
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight()
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun LoopsGrid(
    cases: List<LooperEngine.Case>,
    nowNs: Long,
    beatsPerBar: Int,
    barDurationNs: Long,
    onTap: (Int) -> Unit,
    onLongPress: (Int) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val cols = 4
    val rows = (cases.size + cols - 1) / cols
    Column(
        modifier = modifier,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
    ) {
        for (r in 0 until rows) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
            ) {
                for (c in 0 until cols) {
                    val idx = r * cols + c
                    val case = cases.getOrNull(idx)
                    if (case == null) {
                        Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight())
                    } else {
                        DpLoopCase(
                            index = idx,
                            case = case,
                            nowNs = nowNs,
                            beatsPerBar = beatsPerBar,
                            barDurationNs = barDurationNs,
                            onTap = { onTap(idx) },
                            onLongPress = { onLongPress(idx) },
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight()
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SmallChip(
    label: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    active: Boolean = false,
    accentColor: Color = DpColors.ACCENT,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
    Box(
        modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
            .background(
                if (active) accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.14f)
                else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f)
            )
            .border(
                1.dp,
                if (active) accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.55f) else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f),
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)
            )
            .clickable { onClick() }
            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Text(
            label,
            color = if (active) accentColor else DpColors.SOFT,
            fontSize = 10.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BeatDots(beats: Int, active: Int) {
    Row(
        Modifier.height(24.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
    ) {
        for (i in 0 until beats) {
            val on = i == active
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .size(7.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (on) DpColors.ACCENT else Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f))
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun RecBadge() {
    Box(
        Modifier
            .height(24.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .background(DpColors.ROSE.copy(alpha = 0.14f))
            .border(1.dp, DpColors.ROSE.copy(alpha = 0.6f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
            Box(Modifier.size(7.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(DpColors.ROSE))

}

@Composable
private fun MiniCard(
    icon: String,
    label: String,
    value: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
    Row(
        modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF2A3347), Color(0xFF1F2739))))
            .clickable { onClick() }
            .padding(horizontal = 9.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
    ) {
        Text(icon, color = DpColors.ACCENT, fontSize = 12.sp)
        Text(label, color = Color(0xFF7B859A), fontSize = 10.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        Text(
            value,
            color = DpColors.SOFT,
            fontSize = 10.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            maxLines = 1,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
        )
    }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Utils
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
private fun parseBeatsPerBar(sig: String): Int {
    return (sig.substringBefore('/').toIntOrNull() ?: 4).coerceIn(1, 32)
}

private fun parseOctave(range: String): Int {
    // Format attendu : "C2-C5" ou "3" ou ""
    val firstDigit = range.firstOrNull { it.isDigit() }
    return firstDigit?.digitToInt() ?: 3
}

import androidx.compose.ui.draw.shadow
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.StrokeCap
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextOverflow
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.soundstage.mixer.model.ScenePreset
import com.soundstage.mixer.ui.components.AmbientStudioBackground

// Snapshot Color Palette
private val SnapshotAccent = Color(0xFF9BC0F8)
private val SnapshotAccentDark = Color(0xFF8FB6F2)
private val SnapshotAccentBorder = Color(0x669BC0F8)
private val CardBorder = Color(0xFF38455E)
private val CardBgBrush = Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF283144), Color(0xFF1D2433)))
private val SelectedCardBrush = Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF3B4863), Color(0xFF2A344A)))

@Composable
fun ProjectsPage(
    projects: List<ScenePreset>,
    onOpenProject: (String) -> Unit,
    onCreateNewProject: (name: String, isBlank: Boolean) -> Unit,
    onDeleteProject: (String) -> Unit,
    onOpenSettings: () -> Unit,
    hasActiveProject: Boolean = false,
    themeHue: Float = 185f,
    themeBgSaturation: Float = 1.60f,
    themeBgLightness: Float = 1.0f,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    var searchQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var selectedSetlistName by remember(projects) {
        mutableStateOf(projects.firstOrNull()?.name ?: "")
    }
    var isNewSetlistDialogOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var newSetlistNameInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var isBlankSetlistMode by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    var pendingDeleteSetlistName by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var sortOrder by remember { mutableStateOf("Recently used") }
    var isSortMenuOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    // Filtered setlists based on search query
    val filteredProjects = remember(projects, searchQuery, sortOrder) {
        val queryFiltered = if (searchQuery.isBlank()) {
            projects
        } else {
            projects.filter { it.name.contains(searchQuery.trim(), ignoreCase = true) }
        }
        when (sortOrder) {
            "Alphabetical" -> queryFiltered.sortedBy { it.name.lowercase() }
            "Date created" -> queryFiltered.sortedByDescending { it.timestamp }
            else -> queryFiltered
        }
    }

    // ================= CREATE NEW SETLIST DIALOG =================
    if (isNewSetlistDialogOpen) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { isNewSetlistDialogOpen = false },
            title = {
                Text(
                    text = if (hasActiveProject && projects.isNotEmpty()) "New or Duplicate Setlist" else "New Setlist",
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 16.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                )
            },
            text = {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "Setlist Name:",
                        color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                        fontSize = 12.sp
                    )
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = newSetlistNameInput,
                        onValueChange = { newSetlistNameInput = it },
                        singleLine = true,
                        placeholder = { Text("Ex: Weekend Worship, Live Sunday...", color = Color(0xFF64748B)) },
                        colors = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
                            focusedTextColor = Color.White,
                            unfocusedTextColor = Color.White,
                            focusedBorderColor = SnapshotAccentBorder,
                            unfocusedBorderColor = Color(0x44FFFFFF),
                            cursorColor = SnapshotAccent
                        ),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )

                    if (hasActiveProject && projects.isNotEmpty()) {
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "Setlist Mode:",
                            color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                        )

                        // Compact side-by-side mode cards (fits landscape screen without truncation)
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                        ) {
                            // Option 1: Blank Setlist
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .weight(1f)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .background(if (isBlankSetlistMode) Color(0xFF1E293B) else Color(0xFF111622))
                                    .border(1.dp, if (isBlankSetlistMode) SnapshotAccentBorder else CardBorder, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .clickable { isBlankSetlistMode = true }
                                    .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                            ) {
                                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                    RadioButton(
                                        selected = isBlankSetlistMode,
                                        onClick = { isBlankSetlistMode = true },
                                        colors = RadioButtonDefaults.colors(selectedColor = SnapshotAccent, unselectedColor = Color(0xFF64748B)),
                                        modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                                    )
                                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                    Column {
                                        Text(
                                            text = "New Blank",
                                            color = Color.White,
                                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                                        )
                                        Text(
                                            text = "Default tracks",
                                            color = Color(0xFF64748B),
                                            fontSize = 10.sp
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            // Option 2: Duplicate Current Setlist
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .weight(1f)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .background(if (!isBlankSetlistMode) Color(0xFF1E293B) else Color(0xFF111622))
                                    .border(1.dp, if (!isBlankSetlistMode) SnapshotAccentBorder else CardBorder, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .clickable { isBlankSetlistMode = false }
                                    .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                            ) {
                                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                    RadioButton(
                                        selected = !isBlankSetlistMode,
                                        onClick = { isBlankSetlistMode = false },
                                        colors = RadioButtonDefaults.colors(selectedColor = SnapshotAccent, unselectedColor = Color(0xFF64748B)),
                                        modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                                    )
                                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                    Column {
                                        Text(
                                            text = "Duplicate Current",
                                            color = Color.White,
                                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                                        )
                                        Text(
                                            text = "Clone tracks & SF2",
                                            color = Color(0xFF64748B),
                                            fontSize = 10.sp
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        Text(
                            text = "Start a fresh setlist with clean tracks ready for performance.",
                            color = Color(0xFF64748B),
                            fontSize = 11.sp
                        )
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = {
                Button(
                    onClick = {
                        val name = newSetlistNameInput.trim().ifEmpty { "Setlist ${projects.size + 1}" }
                        onCreateNewProject(name, if (hasActiveProject && projects.isNotEmpty()) isBlankSetlistMode else true)
                        isNewSetlistDialogOpen = false
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = SnapshotAccent)
                ) {
                    Text("Create & Open", color = Color(0xFF0F172A), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { isNewSetlistDialogOpen = false }) {
                    Text("Cancel", color = Color(0xFF8E95A5))
                }
            },
            containerColor = Color(0xFF161B29),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
        )
    }

    // ================= DELETE CONFIRMATION DIALOG =================
    if (pendingDeleteSetlistName != null) {
        val setName = pendingDeleteSetlistName!!
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { pendingDeleteSetlistName = null },
            title = {
                Text(
                    text = "Delete Setlist?",
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 15.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                )
            },
            text = {
                Text(
                    text = "Are you sure you want to permanently delete « $setName »?",
                    color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                    fontSize = 13.sp
                )
            },
            confirmButton = {
                Button(
                    onClick = {
                        onDeleteProject(setName)
                        pendingDeleteSetlistName = null
                    },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFEF4444)),
                    modifier = Modifier.testTag("btn_confirm_delete_project")
                ) {
                    Text("Delete", color = Color.White, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { pendingDeleteSetlistName = null }) {
                    Text("Cancel", color = Color(0xFF8E95A5))
                }
            },
            containerColor = Color(0xFF161B29),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
        )
    }

    // ================= ROOT CONTAINER: OPEN STUDIO LAYOUT WITH FLOATING GLOW ORB =================
    AmbientStudioBackground(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .testTag("projects_page")
    ) {
        // 2. Open Page Content (No enclosing box border)
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
        ) {
            // TOP SECTION: Header + Divider
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
            ) {
                // 1. TOP HEADER BAR: Search Box + Title "Setlists" + "+ Create New Setlist" + Settings
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                ) {
                    // Left: Compact Search Bar
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .width(220.dp)
                            .height(38.dp)
                            .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color(0x99000000))
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                            .background(
                                Brush.verticalGradient(
                                    listOf(Color(0xFF283144), Color(0xFF1D2433))
                                )
                            )
                            .border(1.dp, CardBorder, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                            .drawWithContent {
                                drawContent()
                                drawLine(
                                    color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f),
                                    start = Offset(4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                    end = Offset(size.width - 4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                    strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx(),
                                    cap = StrokeCap.Round
                                )
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart
                    ) {
                        Row(
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = Icons.Default.Search,
                                contentDescription = "Search",
                                tint = Color(0xFF8E99AF),
                                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                            )
                            if (searchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                                Text(
                                    text = "Search setlists...",
                                    color = Color(0xFF6B7280),
                                    fontSize = 12.sp
                                )
                            }
                            androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField(
                                value = searchQuery,
                                onValueChange = { searchQuery = it },
                                singleLine = true,
                                textStyle = androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle(
                                    color = Color.White,
                                    fontSize = 12.sp
                                ),
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                            )
                        }
                    }

                    // Center: Title "Setlists"
                    Text(
                        text = "Setlists",
                        color = Color.White,
                        fontSize = 18.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )

                    // Right: "+ Create New Setlist" Button + Settings Button immediately to its right
                    Row(
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                    ) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .height(38.dp)
                                .shadow(2.5.dp, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color(0x99000000))
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                .background(
                                    Brush.verticalGradient(
                                        listOf(Color(0xFF9BC0F8), Color(0xFF8FB6F2))
                                    )
                                )
                                .border(1.dp, Color(0x33000000), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                .drawWithContent {
                                    drawContent()
                                    drawLine(
                                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.25f),
                                        start = Offset(4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                        end = Offset(size.width - 4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                        strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx(),
                                        cap = StrokeCap.Round
                                    )
                                }
                                .clickable {
                                    newSetlistNameInput = "Setlist ${projects.size + 1}"
                                    isNewSetlistDialogOpen = true
                                }
                                .padding(horizontal = 14.dp)
                                .testTag("btn_create_setlist_header"),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Row(
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                            ) {
                                Icon(
                                    imageVector = Icons.Default.Add,
                                    contentDescription = "Create",
                                    tint = Color(0xFF101726),
                                    modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                                )
                                Text(
                                    text = "Create New Setlist",
                                    color = Color(0xFF101726),
                                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                )
                            }
                        }

                        // Settings button placed next to Create New Setlist
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(38.dp)
                                .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color(0x99000000))
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                .background(
                                    Brush.verticalGradient(
                                        listOf(Color(0xFF283144), Color(0xFF1D2433))
                                    )
                                )
                                .border(1.dp, CardBorder, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                .drawWithContent {
                                    drawContent()
                                    drawLine(
                                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f),
                                        start = Offset(4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                        end = Offset(size.width - 4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                        strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx(),
                                        cap = StrokeCap.Round
                                    )
                                }
                                .clickable { onOpenSettings() }
                                .testTag("btn_setlist_settings_header"),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = Icons.Default.Settings,
                                contentDescription = "Settings",
                                tint = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                                modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Horizontal separator line below header
                HorizontalDivider(
                    color = CardBorder.copy(alpha = 0.75f),
                    thickness = 1.dp,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                )
            }

            // MIDDLE SECTION: Recently used Carousel + All Setlists List (Extends down to Cancel/Load buttons)
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .weight(1f)
                    .padding(vertical = 2.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
            ) {
                // 2. SECTION: "Recently used Setlists" (Ultra Compact Horizontal Cards Carousel)
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "Recently used Setlists",
                        color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                    )

                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                    ) {
                        if (projects.isEmpty()) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .width(160.dp)
                                    .height(52.dp)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .background(Color(0xB3283144))
                                    .border(1.dp, CardBorder, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .padding(6.dp),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = "No setlists yet.\nTap Create to start.",
                                    color = Color(0xFF6B7280),
                                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                                    textAlign = androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextAlign.Center
                                )
                            }
                        } else {
                            projects.take(6).forEach { project ->
                                val isSelected = project.name == selectedSetlistName
                                RecentlyUsedSetlistCard(
                                    project = project,
                                    isSelected = isSelected,
                                    onSelect = { selectedSetlistName = project.name },
                                    onDelete = { pendingDeleteSetlistName = project.name }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 3. SECTION: "All Setlists" (Full width table list view extending down to Cancel/Load buttons)
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .weight(1f),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)
                ) {
                    // Sub-header with Sort options
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "All Setlists",
                            color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                        )

                        Row(
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = "Sort by",
                                color = Color(0xFF64748B),
                                fontSize = 10.5.sp
                            )

                            Box {
                                Row(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .height(24.dp)
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                                        .background(Color(0xD91B212F))
                                        .border(1.dp, CardBorder, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                                        .clickable { isSortMenuOpen = true }
                                        .padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
                                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = sortOrder,
                                        color = Color.White,
                                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                                    )
                                    Icon(
                                        imageVector = Icons.Default.KeyboardArrowDown,
                                        contentDescription = "Sort Options",
                                        tint = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                                        modifier = Modifier.size(12.dp)
                                    )
                                }

                                DropdownMenu(
                                    expanded = isSortMenuOpen,
                                    onDismissRequest = { isSortMenuOpen = false },
                                    modifier = Modifier.background(Color(0xFF1B212F))
                                ) {
                                    listOf("Recently used", "Alphabetical", "Date created").forEach { order ->
                                        DropdownMenuItem(
                                            text = { Text(order, color = Color.White, fontSize = 12.sp) },
                                            onClick = {
                                                sortOrder = order
                                                isSortMenuOpen = false
                                            }
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            IconButton(
                                onClick = { isSortMenuOpen = true },
                                modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
                            ) {
                                Icon(
                                    imageVector = Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.Sort,
                                    contentDescription = "Sort",
                                    tint = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                                    modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp)
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Scrollable List of Setlists (Translucent backdrop to let glowing orb shine clearly through)
                    LazyColumn(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .weight(1f)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                            .background(Color(0x80111520))
                            .border(1.dp, CardBorder.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(1.dp)
                    ) {
                        if (filteredProjects.isEmpty()) {
                            item {
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .fillMaxWidth()
                                        .padding(20.dp),
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = if (searchQuery.isNotEmpty()) "No setlists matching « $searchQuery »" else "No setlists found.",
                                        color = Color(0xFF6B7280),
                                        fontSize = 12.sp
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            items(filteredProjects, key = { it.id }) { project ->
                                val isSelected = project.name == selectedSetlistName
                                SetlistTableRow(
                                    project = project,
                                    isSelected = isSelected,
                                    onSelect = { selectedSetlistName = project.name },
                                    onDoubleClick = { onOpenProject(project.name) },
                                    onDelete = { pendingDeleteSetlistName = project.name }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // BOTTOM SECTION: Actions (No bottom divider line per user request)
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(top = 2.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End
            ) {
                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
                ) {
                    // Cancel Button
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .height(38.dp)
                            .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color(0x99000000))
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                            .background(
                                Brush.verticalGradient(
                                    listOf(Color(0xFF283144), Color(0xFF1D2433))
                                )
                            )
                            .border(1.dp, CardBorder, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                            .drawWithContent {
                                drawContent()
                                drawLine(
                                    color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.12f),
                                    start = Offset(4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                    end = Offset(size.width - 4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                    strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx(),
                                    cap = StrokeCap.Round
                                )
                            }
                            .clickable {
                                if (projects.isNotEmpty()) {
                                    onOpenProject(selectedSetlistName.ifEmpty { projects.first().name })
                                }
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "Cancel",
                            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                            fontSize = 13.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                        )
                    }

                    // Load Setlist Button (in Glowing Snapshot Soft Blue with dark contrast text)
                    val isEnabled = selectedSetlistName.isNotEmpty()
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .height(38.dp)
                            .shadow(if (isEnabled) 3.dp else 0.dp, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color(0x99000000))
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                            .background(
                                if (isEnabled) Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF9BC0F8), Color(0xFF8FB6F2)))
                                else Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF283144), Color(0xFF1D2433)))
                            )
                            .border(
                                1.dp,
                                if (isEnabled) Color(0x33000000) else CardBorder,
                                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)
                            )
                            .drawWithContent {
                                drawContent()
                                if (isEnabled) {
                                    drawLine(
                                        color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.25f),
                                        start = Offset(4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                        end = Offset(size.width - 4.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                                        strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx(),
                                        cap = StrokeCap.Round
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                            .clickable(enabled = isEnabled) {
                                onOpenProject(selectedSetlistName)
                            }
                            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "Load Setlist",
                            color = if (isEnabled) Color(0xFF101726) else Color(0xFF64748B),
                            fontSize = 13.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun RecentlyUsedSetlistCard(
    project: ScenePreset,
    isSelected: Boolean,
    onSelect: () -> Unit,
    onDelete: () -> Unit
) {
    var isMenuOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .width(190.dp)
            .height(115.dp)
            .shadow(2.dp, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color(0x77000000))
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .background(if (isSelected) SelectedCardBrush else CardBgBrush)
            .border(
                1.5.dp,
                if (isSelected) SnapshotAccentBorder else CardBorder,
                RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
            )
            .drawWithContent {
                drawContent()
                drawLine(
                    color = Color.White.copy(alpha = if (isSelected) 0.18f else 0.10f),
                    start = Offset(6.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                    end = Offset(size.width - 6.dp.toPx(), 1f),
                    strokeWidth = 1.dp.toPx(),
                    cap = StrokeCap.Round
                )
            }
            .clickable { onSelect() }
            .padding(12.dp)
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
        ) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = project.name,
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    maxLines = 2,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )

                Box {
                    IconButton(
                        onClick = { isMenuOpen = true },
                        modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = Icons.Default.MoreVert,
                            contentDescription = "Options",
                            tint = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                        )
                    }

                    DropdownMenu(
                        expanded = isMenuOpen,
                        onDismissRequest = { isMenuOpen = false },
                        modifier = Modifier.background(Color(0xFF1B212F))
                    ) {
                        DropdownMenuItem(
                            text = { Text("Delete", color = Color(0xFFEF4444), fontSize = 12.sp) },
                            onClick = {
                                isMenuOpen = false
                                onDelete()
                            }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                val patchesCount = project.patches.size
                val patchLabel = when (patchesCount) {
                    0 -> "0 Patches"
                    1 -> "1 Patch"
                    else -> "$patchesCount Patches"
                }
                Text(
                    text = patchLabel,
                    color = if (isSelected) SnapshotAccent else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                    fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                )
                Text(
                    text = if (project.timestamp.isNotEmpty()) "Last used: ${project.timestamp}" else "Recently created",
                    color = Color(0xFF64748B),
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun SetlistTableRow(
    project: ScenePreset,
    isSelected: Boolean,
    onSelect: () -> Unit,
    onDoubleClick: () -> Unit,
    onDelete: () -> Unit
) {
    var isMenuOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val patchesCount = project.patches.size
    val patchLabel = when (patchesCount) {
        0 -> "0 Patches"
        1 -> "1 Patch"
        else -> "$patchesCount Patches"
    }

    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(44.dp)
            .background(if (isSelected) Color(0x339BC0F8) else Color.Transparent)
            .clickable { onSelect() }
            .padding(horizontal = 14.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
    ) {
        // Name & Indicator dot
        Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1.5f)
        ) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(7.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (isSelected) SnapshotAccent else Color(0xFF475569))
            )
            Text(
                text = project.name,
                color = if (isSelected) Color.White else Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
                fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
            )
        }

        // Patches Count
        Text(
            text = patchLabel,
            color = if (isSelected) SnapshotAccent else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
            fontSize = 11.sp,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(0.8f)
        )

        // Date Created / Last used
        Text(
            text = if (project.timestamp.isNotEmpty()) "Last used: ${project.timestamp}" else "Active Setlist",
            color = Color(0xFF64748B),
            fontSize = 10.5.sp,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1.2f),
            maxLines = 1,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
        )

        // 3-dots Menu Button
        Box {
            IconButton(
                onClick = { isMenuOpen = true },
                modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp)
            ) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = Icons.Default.MoreVert,
                    contentDescription = "Options",
                    tint = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                )
            }

            DropdownMenu(
                expanded = isMenuOpen,
                onDismissRequest = { isMenuOpen = false },
                modifier = Modifier.background(Color(0xFF1B212F))
            ) {
                DropdownMenuItem(
                    text = { Text("Open", color = Color.White, fontSize = 12.sp) },
                    onClick = {
                        isMenuOpen = false
                        onDoubleClick()
                    }
                )
                DropdownMenuItem(
                    text = { Text("Delete", color = Color(0xFFEF4444), fontSize = 12.sp) },
                    onClick = {
                        isMenuOpen = false
                        onDelete()
                    }
                )
            }
        }
    }

@Composable

    onUpdateSheet: (id: String, title: String, key: String, content: String) -> Unit,
    onDeleteSheet: (id: String) -> Unit,
    notesText: String,
    onNotesChange: (String) -> Unit,
    transpose: Int,
    onTransposeChange: (Int) -> Unit,
    onBackToMixer: () -> Unit,
    onOpenSettings: () -> Unit,
    onOpenFloatingSheet: (SheetItem) -> Unit = {},

        sheets.find { it.id == editingSheetId }

        }
        list

                                    editingSheetId = newS.id
                                },
                                onCreate1564 = {
                                    val newS = SheetItem(
                                        title = "Pop Progression",
                                        key = "G",
                                        content = "[Progression 1-5-6m-4]\n| 1 | 5 | 6m | 4 |\n| 1 | 5 | 6m | 4 |"
                                    )
                                    onCreateSheet(newS.title, newS.key, newS.content)
                                    editingSheetId = newS.id
                                }
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ======================================================================================
// SVG HOME SHEET CARD (Exact layout from aether-keys-sheets-home-v2.svg)
// ======================================================================================
@Composable
private fun SvgHomeSheetCard(
    sheet: SheetItem,
    index: Int,
    globalNotation: NotationSystem,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    onDoubleClick: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    val pageColors = PageThemeColors[Math.abs(sheet.colorIndex % PageThemeColors.size)].second
    val isLightPage = pageColors == Color(0xFFF4ECD8)
    val cardTextColor = if (isLightPage) Color(0xFF1E293B) else Color.White
    val chordTextColor = if (isLightPage) Color(0xFF0F172A) else Color(0xFFF1F5F9)

    var isAnimated by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        delay((index * 40L).coerceAtMost(400L))
        isAnimated = true
    }

    val alpha by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (isAnimated) 1f else 0f,
        animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 260, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
        label = "svg_sheet_card_alpha"
    )

    // Convert chart content to active notation
    val convertedContent = remember(sheet.content, sheet.key, globalNotation) {
        ChordNotationConverter.convertSheetText(
            text = sheet.content,
            songKey = sheet.key,
            targetSystem = globalNotation,
            isMinor = sheet.key.contains("m") && !sheet.key.contains("maj")
        )
    }

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .width(310.dp)
            .fillMaxHeight(0.92f)
            .graphicsLayer { this.alpha = alpha }
            .shadow(6.dp, RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color(0x99000000))
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(24.dp))
            .background(pageColors)
            .drawWithContent {
                drawContent()
                // Top white highlight line (~16%)
                drawLine(
                    color = Color.White.copy(alpha = if (isLightPage) 0.35f else 0.16f),
                    start = Offset(12.dp.toPx(), 1.5f),
                    end = Offset(size.width - 12.dp.toPx(), 1.5f),
                    strokeWidth = 1.5.dp.toPx(),
                    cap = StrokeCap.Round
                )
            }
            .pointerInput(sheet.id) {
                detectTapGestures(
                    onTap = { onClick() },
                    onDoubleTap = { onDoubleClick() }
                )
            }
            .padding(18.dp)
            .testTag("svg_sheet_card_${sheet.id}")
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
        ) {
            // Header: Handwritten Title + Amber Key Chip Badge
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = sheet.title.ifBlank { "Untitled Sheet" },
                    fontSize = 20.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Cursive,
                    color = cardTextColor,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )

                // Amber Square-Rounded Key Badge (#F5A524)
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(32.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                        .background(AmberAccent.copy(alpha = if (isLightPage) 0.35f else 0.26f)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = sheet.key,
                        fontSize = 14.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        color = if (isLightPage) Color(0xFFB45309) else AmberAccent
                    )
                }
            }

            // Body: 2 Lines of Inline Measure Grid in handwritten font (e.g. | 1 | 4 | 1 | 4 - 5 |)
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(vertical = 10.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
                val lines = convertedContent.lines().filter { it.isNotBlank() && !it.trim().startsWith("[") }.take(2)
                if (lines.isEmpty()) {
                    Text(
                        text = "|  1  |  4  |  5  |  1  |\n|  6m |  4  |  5  |  1  |",
                        fontSize = 16.sp,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Cursive,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                        color = chordTextColor.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                        lineHeight = 22.sp
                    )
                } else {
                    lines.forEach { line ->
                        Text(
                            text = line,
                            fontSize = 17.sp,
                            fontFamily = FontFamily.Cursive,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = chordTextColor,
                            maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            // Footer: BPM · 4/4 on left, Date on right
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "${sheet.tempo} BPM · ${sheet.timeSignature}",
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
                    color = if (isLightPage) Color(0xFF64748B) else SlateTextSecondary
                )

                Text(
                    text = "Oct 4",
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
                    color = if (isLightPage) Color(0xFF64748B) else SlateTextSecondary
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

// ======================================================================================
// DOTTED QUICK START CARD "+ New Sheet"
// ======================================================================================
@Composable
private fun SvgQuickStartNewSheetCard(
    onCreateBlank: () -> Unit,

) {

        modifier = Modifier
