                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .background(ChipBg)
                        .border(1.dp, ChipBorder, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .clickable { onCreate1564() }
                        .padding(horizontal = 9.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(text = "1-5-6m-4", fontSize = 11.sp, color = Color.White, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ======================================================================================
// SVG SHEETS EDITOR (aether-keys-sheets-editor.svg)
// Left Panel: Chords / Symbols / Text / Page. Right Panel: Handwritten Word-like Chart Page
// ======================================================================================
@Composable
private fun SvgSheetsEditor(
    sheet: SheetItem,
    globalNotation: NotationSystem,
    onSave: (title: String, key: String, content: String, tempo: Int, timeSig: String) -> Unit,
    onDelete: () -> Unit,
    onBack: () -> Unit
) {
    var title by remember { mutableStateOf(sheet.title) }
    var selectedKeyRoot by remember {
        val root = ChordNotationConverter.extractRoot(sheet.key) ?: "C"
        mutableStateOf(root)
    }
    var isMinorMode by remember {
        mutableStateOf(sheet.key.contains("m") && !sheet.key.contains("maj"))
    }
    val fullKeyName by remember {
        derivedStateOf { if (isMinorMode) "${selectedKeyRoot}m" else selectedKeyRoot }
    }

    var content by remember { mutableStateOf(sheet.content) }
    var currentFontSize by remember { mutableIntStateOf(sheet.fontSize.coerceIn(14, 32)) }
    var selectedFontStyle by remember { mutableStateOf(SheetFontStyle.HAND_ARCHITECT) }
    var selectedPageThemeIndex by remember { mutableIntStateOf(sheet.colorIndex) }
    var selectedInkColor by remember { mutableStateOf(InkColors[0].second) }

    var isLyricsMode by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var activeTab by remember { mutableStateOf(EditorTab.CHORDS) }
    var lastInsertedChord by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var showMoreMenu by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var showTonalityDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val pageColor = PageThemeColors[Math.abs(selectedPageThemeIndex % PageThemeColors.size)].second
    val isLightPage = pageColor == Color(0xFFF4ECD8)
    val documentTextColor = if (isLightPage) Color(0xFF1E293B) else selectedInkColor

    val diatonicChords = remember(selectedKeyRoot, isMinorMode, globalNotation) {
        ChordNotationConverter.getDiatonicChords(selectedKeyRoot, isMinorMode, globalNotation)
    }

    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
    ) {
        // ==============================================================================
        // LEFT PANEL (36%): Full Height Tool Ribbon (Chords, Symbols, Text, Page)
        // ==============================================================================
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxHeight()
                .weight(0.36f)
                .shadow(6.dp, RoundedCornerShape(20.dp), ambientColor = Color.Black, spotColor = Color(0x99000000))
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                .background(Color(0xFF131926))
                .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF1F283B), RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                .padding(14.dp)
                .testTag("svg_editor_left_panel")
        ) {
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
            ) {
                // 1. TOP HEADER ROW: [<-] [Key C] [Chart | Lyrics] [Save] [...]
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                ) {
                    // Back arrow
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .size(36.dp)
                            .clip(CircleShape)
                            .background(ChipBg)
                            .clickable { onBack() }
                            .testTag("btn_editor_back"),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack,
                            contentDescription = "Back",
                            tint = Color.White,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                        )
                    }

                    // Key badge [C]
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .size(36.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                            .background(ChipBg)
                            .border(1.dp, ChipBorder, RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                            .clickable { showTonalityDialog = true }
                            .testTag("btn_editor_key_badge"),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = fullKeyName,
                            fontSize = 14.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = Color.White
                        )
                    }

                    // Segmented [Chart | Lyrics]
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .height(36.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                            .background(ChipBg)
                            .padding(2.dp)
                    ) {
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .height(32.dp)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                                    .background(if (!isLyricsMode) PrimaryBlueBtn else Color.Transparent)
                                    .clickable { isLyricsMode = false }
                                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = "Chart",
                                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                    color = if (!isLyricsMode) PrimaryBlueBtnText else SlateTextSecondary
                                )
                            }
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .height(32.dp)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                                    .background(if (isLyricsMode) PrimaryBlueBtn else Color.Transparent)
                                    .clickable { isLyricsMode = true }
                                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = "Lyrics",
                                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                    color = if (isLyricsMode) PrimaryBlueBtnText else SlateTextSecondary
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Save Button
                    Button(
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = PrimaryBlueBtn),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(9.dp),
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 7.dp),
                        onClick = { onSave(title, fullKeyName, content, sheet.tempo, sheet.timeSignature) },
                        modifier = Modifier.testTag("btn_editor_save")
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "Save",
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = PrimaryBlueBtnText
                        )
                    }

                    // More Menu (...)
                    Box {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(36.dp)
                                .clip(CircleShape)
                                .background(ChipBg)
                                .clickable { showMoreMenu = true },
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = Icons.Default.MoreVert,
                                contentDescription = "More",
                                tint = Color.White,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                            )
                        }

                        DropdownMenu(
                            expanded = showMoreMenu,
                            onDismissRequest = { showMoreMenu = false }
                        ) {
                            DropdownMenuItem(
                                text = { Text("Clear Sheet") },
                                onClick = {
                                    content = ""
                                    showMoreMenu = false
                                }
                            )
                            DropdownMenuItem(
                                text = { Text("Delete Sheet", color = Color(0xFFEF4444)) },
                                onClick = {
                                    showMoreMenu = false
                                    onDelete()
                                }
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 2. RIBBON TABS (Chords, Symbols, Text, Page)
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                ) {
                    EditorTab.values().forEach { tab ->
                        val isSelected = activeTab == tab
                        Column(
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .weight(1f)
                                .clickable { activeTab = tab }
                                .padding(vertical = 4.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = tab.name.lowercase().replaceFirstChar { it.uppercase() },
                                fontSize = 12.sp,
                                fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                                color = if (isSelected) Color.White else SlateTextSecondary
                            )
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth(0.6f)
                                    .height(2.dp)
                                    .background(if (isSelected) PrimaryBlueAccent else Color.Transparent)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                HorizontalDivider(color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f))

                // 3. TAB SPECIFIC CONTENT
                when (activeTab) {
                    EditorTab.CHORDS -> {
                        // CHORDS · NASHVILLE (Degree Keyboard 1 to 7)
                        Text(
                            text = "CHORDS · ${globalNotation.shortName.uppercase()}",
                            fontSize = 10.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = SlateTextSecondary,
                            letterSpacing = 0.5.sp
                        )

                        // Row 1: Tall Pill Keys 1 to 7
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                        ) {
                            val degreeLabels = if (globalNotation == NotationSystem.NASHVILLE) {
                                listOf("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7")
                            } else {
                                diatonicChords.take(7)
                            }

                            degreeLabels.forEach { deg ->
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .weight(1f)
                                        .height(46.dp)
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                        .background(Color(0xFF20293C))
                                        .border(1.dp, ChipBorder, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                        .clickable {
                                            val sep = if (content.isEmpty() || content.endsWith(" ") || content.endsWith("\n") || content.endsWith("| ")) "" else " "
                                            content = "$content$sep$deg"
                                            lastInsertedChord = deg
                                        },
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = deg,
                                        fontSize = 18.sp,
                                        fontFamily = FontFamily.Cursive,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                        color = Color.White
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // Row 2: Accidentals & Modifiers (b, #, / bass, N.C., %)
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                        ) {
                            listOf("b", "#", "/ bass", "N.C.", "%").forEach { mod ->
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .weight(if (mod.length > 2) 1.5f else 1f)
                                        .height(34.dp)
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                        .background(Color(0xFF1A2234))
                                        .border(1.dp, ChipBorder.copy(alpha = 0.6f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                        .clickable {
                                            val active = lastInsertedChord
                                            if (active != null) {
                                                val modified = ChordNotationConverter.applyExtension(active, mod)
                                                if (content.endsWith(active)) {
                                                    content = content.substring(0, content.length - active.length) + modified
                                                } else {
                                                    content = "$content $mod"
                                                }
                                                lastInsertedChord = modified
                                            } else {
                                                content = "$content $mod"
                                            }
                                        },
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        text = mod,
                                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                                        color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1)
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))

                        // EXTENSIONS · ACTIVE CHORD (Row 1 & Row 2)
                        Text(
                            text = "EXTENSIONS · ACTIVE CHORD",
                            fontSize = 10.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = SlateTextSecondary,
                            letterSpacing = 0.5.sp
                        )

                        // Ext Row 1
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                        ) {
                            listOf("m", "7", "maj7", "m7", "sus2", "sus4", "11").forEach { ext ->
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .weight(1f)
                                        .height(30.dp)
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                                        .background(Color(0xFF1E2638))
                                        .border(1.dp, ChipBorder.copy(alpha = 0.6f), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                                        .clickable {
                                            val active = lastInsertedChord
                                            if (active != null) {
                                                val modified = ChordNotationConverter.applyExtension(active, ext)
                                                if (content.endsWith(active)) {
                                                    content = content.substring(0, content.length - active.length) + modified
                                                } else {
                                                    content = "$content$ext"
                                                }
                                                lastInsertedChord = modified
                                            } else {
                                                content = "$content$ext"
                                            }
                                        },
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                ) {
                                    Text(text = ext, fontSize = 11.sp, color = Color(0xFFE2E8F0), fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium)
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // Ext Row 2
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                        ) {
                            listOf("add9", "6", "9", "dim", "aug", "5", "13").forEach { ext ->
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .weight(1f)
                                        .height(30.dp)
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                                        .background(Color(0xFF1E2638))
                                        .border(1.dp, ChipBorder.copy(alpha = 0.6f), RoundedCornerShape(7.dp))
                                        .clickable {
                                            val active = lastInsertedChord
                                            if (active != null) {
                                                val modified = ChordNotationConverter.applyExtension(active, ext)
                                                if (content.endsWith(active)) {
                                                    content = content.substring(0, content.length - active.length) + modified
                                                } else {
                                                    content = "$content$ext"
                                                }
                                                lastInsertedChord = modified
                                            } else {
                                                content = "$content$ext"
                                            }
                                        },
                                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                ) {
                                    Text(text = ext, fontSize = 11.sp, color = Color(0xFFE2E8F0), fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium)
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))

                        // PASSING CHORD SECTION (Split 2, Split 4, Passing 4 - 5)
                        Text(
                            text = "PASSING CHORD",
                            fontSize = 10.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = SlateTextSecondary,
                            letterSpacing = 0.5.sp
                        )

                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                        ) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .weight(1f)
                                    .height(34.dp)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .background(Color(0xFF1E2638))
                                    .clickable { content = "$content | 1 - 5 |" },
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text("Split 2", fontSize = 11.sp, color = Color.White)
                            }

                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .weight(1f)
                                    .height(34.dp)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .background(Color(0xFF1E2638))
                                    .clickable { content = "$content | 1 - 4 - 5 - 1 |" },
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text("Split 4", fontSize = 11.sp, color = Color.White)
                            }

                            // Passing X - Y (Amber outlined button)
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .weight(1.3f)
                                    .height(34.dp)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .background(AmberAccent.copy(alpha = 0.12f))
                                    .border(1.dp, AmberAccent, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .clickable { content = "$content 4 - 5" },
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text("Passing 4 - 5", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = AmberAccent)
                            }
                        }

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))

                        // EDIT TOOLS (6 Icons with labels below: Undo, Redo, Dup bar, Copy line, Transpose, Page)
                        Text(
                            text = "EDIT",
                            fontSize = 10.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = SlateTextSecondary,
                            letterSpacing = 0.5.sp
                        )

                        Row(

                                color = documentTextColor.copy(alpha = 0.35f),

    // TONALITY ROOT & MODE PICKER DIALOG
    if (showTonalityDialog) {

data class Patch(
    val id: String,

)

data class PatchesUiState(
    val patches: List<Patch> = emptyList(),
    val activePatchId: String? = null,
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
)

interface PatchesActions {
    fun onClose() {}
    fun onOpenSetlists() {}
    fun onSelectPatch(id: String) {}
    fun onToggleActive(id: String) {}
    fun onRenamePatch(id: String) {}
    fun onRenamePatchConfirmed(id: String, name: String) {}
    fun onDeletePatch(id: String) {}
    fun onUndoDeletePatch() {}
    fun onCreatePatch(name: String, duplicateFrom: String?) {}
}

object NoOpPatchesActions : PatchesActions

private fun white(a: Float) = Color.White.copy(alpha = a)

private fun patchText(
    size: TextUnit,
    weight: FontWeight = FontWeight.Normal,
    color: Color = PatchColors.Ink,
) = TextStyle(fontSize = size, fontWeight = weight, color = color, fontFeatureSettings = "tnum")

private class PatchHaptics(private val h: HapticFeedback, private val on: Boolean) {
    fun tick() { if (on) h.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.TextHandleMove) }
}

private val DrawerShape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 22.dp, bottomStart = 22.dp)

private fun Modifier.drawerPanel(): Modifier = this
    .shadow(
        14.dp, DrawerShape,
        ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
        spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
    )
    .clip(DrawerShape)
    .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(PatchColors.PanelTop, PatchColors.PanelBottom)))
    .border(1.dp, white(0.10f), DrawerShape)

private fun Modifier.sheetPanel(shape: Shape): Modifier = this
    .shadow(
        14.dp, shape,
        ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
        spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
    )
    .clip(shape)
    .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(PatchColors.PanelTop, PatchColors.PanelBottom)))
    .border(1.dp, white(0.10f), shape)

@Composable
private fun Modifier.patchTap(scaleDown: Float = 0.96f, onTap: () -> Unit): Modifier {
    var pressed by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val s by animateFloatAsState(
        if (pressed) scaleDown else 1f,
        spring(dampingRatio = 0.6f, stiffness = 500f),
        label = "patchTap",
    )
    val tap by rememberUpdatedState(onTap)
    return this
        .graphicsLayer { scaleX = s; scaleY = s }
        .pointerInput(Unit) {
            detectTapGestures(
                onPress = { pressed = true; tryAwaitRelease(); pressed = false },
                onTap = { tap() },
            )
        }
}

@Composable
private fun Modifier.patchRowRise(index: Int): Modifier {
    val p = remember { Animatable(0f) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        if (p.value < 1f) {
            delay((index * 45L).coerceAtMost(500L))
            p.animateTo(1f, tween(380, easing = CubicBezierEasing(0.2f, 0.9f, 0.25f, 1f)))
        }
    }
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        alpha = p.value
        translationX = (1f - p.value) * 14.dp.toPx()
    }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 4. OVERLAY
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

private val DrawerWidth = 420.dp
private val SheetWidth = 460.dp

@Composable
fun PatchesOverlay(
    state: PatchesUiState,
    actions: PatchesActions,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val haptic = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    val haptics = remember(haptic) { PatchHaptics(haptic, true) }

    var visible by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { visible = true }

    var sheetOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var snackName by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var renamingId by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var renameValue by remember { mutableStateOf("") }

    val p by animateFloatAsState(
        if (visible) 1f else 0f,
        tween(380, easing = CubicBezierEasing(0.2f, 0.9f, 0.25f, 1f)),
        label = "drawerSlide",
    )

    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val drawerWidthPx = with(density) { DrawerWidth.toPx() }

    Box(modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        // Backdrop
        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .graphicsLayer { alpha = p }
                .background(PatchColors.Backdrop)
                .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures { actions.onClose() } },
        )

        // Drawer
        Box(
            Modifier
                .align(Alignment.CenterEnd)
                .fillMaxHeight()
                .width(DrawerWidth)
                .graphicsLayer { translationX = (1f - p) * drawerWidthPx }
                .drawerPanel()
                .clickable(
                    indication = null,
                    interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                ) { /* absorb taps in empty areas */ },
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                DrawerHeader(
                    state = state,
                    haptics = haptics,
                    onClose = { actions.onClose() },
                    onOpenSetlists = { actions.onOpenSetlists() }
                )

                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(horizontal = 20.dp)
                        .height(1.dp)
                        .background(white(0.07f)),
                )

                Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
                    if (state.isLoading) {
                        PatchSkeletonList()
                    } else if (state.patches.isEmpty()) {
                        PatchEmptyState()
                    } else {
                        LazyColumn(
                            Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
                            contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 14.dp),
                        ) {
                            itemsIndexed(
                                state.patches,
                                key = { _, p -> p.id },
                            ) { i, patch ->
                                val active = patch.id == state.activePatchId
                                PatchRow(
                                    patch = patch,
                                    index = i,
                                    active = active,
                                    renaming = renamingId == patch.id,
                                    renameValue = if (renamingId == patch.id) renameValue else patch.name,
                                    onRenameValueChange = { renameValue = it },
                                    onRenameConfirm = {
                                        if (renameValue.trim().isNotEmpty()) {
                                            actions.onRenamePatchConfirmed(patch.id, renameValue.trim())
                                        }
                                        renamingId = null
                                    },
                                    onSelect = { haptics.tick(); actions.onSelectPatch(patch.id) },
                                    onToggleActive = { haptics.tick(); actions.onToggleActive(patch.id) },
                                    onRename = { haptics.tick(); renamingId = patch.id; renameValue = patch.name },
                                    onDelete = {
                                        snackName = patch.name
                                        actions.onDeletePatch(patch.id)
                                    },
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                DrawerFooter(haptics = haptics, onNew = { sheetOpen = true })
            }

            snackName?.let { name ->
                LaunchedEffect(name) {
                    delay(5000)
                    snackName = null
                }
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                        .zIndex(10f),
                ) {
                    UndoSnack(
                        name = name,
                        onUndo = {
                            actions.onUndoDeletePatch()
                            snackName = null
                        },
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        if (sheetOpen) {
            val openPatch = state.patches.firstOrNull { it.id == state.activePatchId }
            CreatePatchSheet(
                openPatch = openPatch,
                nextIndex = state.patches.size + 1,
                onClose = { sheetOpen = false },
                onCreate = { name, duplicateFrom ->
                    haptics.tick()
                    sheetOpen = false
                    actions.onCreatePatch(name, duplicateFrom)
                },
            )
        }
    }
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// 4.4 ROW
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    @Composable
    private fun PatchRow(
        patch: Patch,
        index: Int,
        active: Boolean,
        renaming: Boolean,
        renameValue: String,
        onRenameValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
        onRenameConfirm: () -> Unit,
        onSelect: () -> Unit,
        onToggleActive: () -> Unit,
        onRename: () -> Unit,
        onDelete: () -> Unit,
    ) {
        val shape = RoundedCornerShape(13.dp)
        val density = LocalDensity.current
        val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
        val offset = remember { Animatable(0f) }
        var armed by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
        var widthPx by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
        val gapPx = with(density) { 8.dp.toPx() }
        val pillW = max(0f, -offset.value - gapPx)

        val borderColor by animateColorAsState(
            if (active) PatchColors.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.45f) else white(0.09f),
            tween(250),
            label = "rowBorder",
        )

        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .height(56.dp)
                .patchRowRise(index)
                .onSizeChanged { widthPx = it.width },
        ) {
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.CenterEnd)
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .width(with(density) { pillW.toDp() })
                    .alpha(min(1f, pillW / with(density) { 40.dp.toPx() }))
                    .clip(shape)
                    .background(
                        if (armed) Brush.verticalGradient(
                            listOf(Color(0xFFB8465F), Color(0xFFA03D57))
                        ) else Brush.verticalGradient(
                            listOf(Color(0xFF7A2E45), Color(0xFF5E2436))
                        )
                    ),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
            ) {
                if (pillW > with(density) { 34.dp.toPx() }) {
                    val rot by animateFloatAsState(
                        if (armed) -18f else 0f, spring(0.5f, 500f), label = "rot"
                    )
                    val sc by animateFloatAsState(
                        if (armed) 1.18f else 1f, spring(0.5f, 500f), label = "sc"
                    )
                    PatchIcon(
                        PatchIconKind.Trash,
                        Color.White,
                        Modifier
                            .size(19.dp)
                            .graphicsLayer { rotationZ = rot; scaleX = sc; scaleY = sc },
                    )
                }
            }

            Row(
                Modifier
                    .offset { IntOffset(offset.value.roundToInt(), 0) }
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .pointerInput(Unit) {
                        var total = 0f
                        val resist = 22.dp.toPx()
                        detectHorizontalDragGestures(
                            onDragStart = { total = 0f },
                            onDragEnd = {
                                scope.launch {
                                    if (armed) {
                                        offset.animateTo(-widthPx.toFloat(), tween(180))
                                        onDelete()
                                    } else {
                                        offset.animateTo(0f, spring(dampingRatio = 0.7f, stiffness = 400f))
                                    }
                                    armed = false
                                }
                            },
                            onDragCancel = {
                                scope.launch {
                                    offset.animateTo(0f, spring(dampingRatio = 0.7f, stiffness = 400f))
                                }
                                armed = false
                            },
                            onHorizontalDrag = { change, dx ->
                                change.consume()
                                total += dx
                                val d = min(0f, total)
                                val eff = if (d > -resist) d else -resist + (d + resist) * 0.72f
                                scope.launch { offset.snapTo(eff) }
                                val threshold = min(size.width * 0.36f, 200.dp.toPx())
                                val a = eff <= -threshold
                                if (a != armed) armed = a
                            },
                        )
                    }
                    .patchTap(0.985f, onSelect)
                    .shadow(
                        3.dp, shape,
                        ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
                        spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
                    )
                    .clip(shape)
                    .background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(
                            if (active) listOf(white(0.11f), white(0.06f))
                            else listOf(white(0.07f), white(0.035f))
                        )
                    )
                    .border(1.dp, borderColor, shape)
                    .padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
            ) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .size(34.dp)
                        .patchTap(0.90f, onToggleActive)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                        .background(if (active) PatchColors.Accent else white(0.07f)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                ) {
                    PatchIcon(
                        kind = if (active) PatchIconKind.Pause else PatchIconKind.Play,
                        color = if (active) PatchColors.AccentText else PatchColors.Icon,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(13.dp),
                        fill = true,
                    )
                }

                Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    if (renaming) {
                        val fieldShape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)
                        BasicTextField(
                            value = renameValue,
                            onValueChange = { if (it.length <= 40) onRenameValueChange(it) },
                            singleLine = true,
                            textStyle = patchText(14.sp, FontWeight.SemiBold, PatchColors.TitleSoft),
                            cursorBrush = SolidColor(PatchColors.Accent),
                            keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
                            keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(onDone = { onRenameConfirm() }),
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .height(30.dp)
                                .clip(fieldShape)
                                .background(PatchColors.Well)
                                .border(1.dp, PatchColors.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.40f), fieldShape)
                                .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 5.dp),
                        )
                    } else {
                        Text(
                            patch.name,
                            style = patchText(15.sp, FontWeight.Bold),
                            maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        )
                    }
                    Text(
                        "${patch.snapshotCount} ${if (patch.snapshotCount == 1) "Snapshot" else "Snapshots"}",
                        style = patchText(11.5.sp, color = PatchColors.Mute),
                        maxLines = 1,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 2.dp),
                    )
                }

                Row(
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                ) {
                    IconAction(PatchIconKind.Edit, "Rename", onRename)
                    if (active) {
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .padding(start = 4.dp)
                                .size(26.dp)
                                .clip(CircleShape)
                                .background(PatchColors.Accent),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                        ) {
                            PatchIcon(
                                PatchIconKind.Check,
                                PatchColors.AccentText,
                                Modifier.size(13.dp),
                                stroke = 3.dp,
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

@Composable
private fun IconAction(kind: PatchIconKind, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    Box(
        Modifier
            .size(30.dp)
            .patchTap(0.90f, onClick)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
        PatchIcon(kind, PatchColors.IconMute, Modifier.size(15.dp))
    }
}

// 5. CREATE SHEET
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

private enum class CreateMode { Blank, Duplicate }

@Composable
private fun CreatePatchSheet(
    openPatch: Patch?,
    nextIndex: Int,
    onClose: () -> Unit,
    onCreate: (String, String?) -> Unit,
) {
    var name by remember { mutableStateOf("Patch $nextIndex") }
    var mode by remember { mutableStateOf(CreateMode.Blank) }
    val focus = remember { FocusRequester() }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { focus.requestFocus() }

    val valid = name.trim().isNotEmpty() &&
        (mode == CreateMode.Blank || openPatch != null)

    fun submit() {
        if (!valid) return
        val source = if (mode == CreateMode.Duplicate) openPatch?.id else null
        onCreate(name.trim(), source)
    }

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(PatchColors.BackdropSheet)
                .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures { onClose() } },
        )

        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
            Column(
                Modifier
                    .width(SheetWidth)
                    .clickable(
                        indication = null,
                        interactionSource = remember { MutableInteractionSource() },
                    ) { /* absorb clicks inside the sheet */ }
                    .sheetPanel(RoundedCornerShape(22.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 16.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
            ) {
                SheetHeader(onClose = onClose)

                NameField(
                    name = name,
                    onNameChange = { if (it.length <= 40) name = it },
                    focus = focus,
                    onDone = { submit() },
                )

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    PatchTile(
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                        icon = PatchIconKind.Copy,
                        title = "Duplicate",
                        sub = if (openPatch != null) "Copy of ${openPatch.name}" else "No patch open",
                        selected = mode == CreateMode.Duplicate,
                        enabled = openPatch != null,
                        onClick = { mode = CreateMode.Duplicate },
                    )
                    PatchTile(
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                        icon = PatchIconKind.Plus,
                        title = "Blank",
                        sub = "Start with no snapshots",
                        selected = mode == CreateMode.Blank,
                        enabled = true,
                        onClick = { mode = CreateMode.Blank },
                    )
                }

                SheetActions(
                    valid = valid,
                    onCancel = onClose,
                    onCreate = { submit() },
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SheetHeader(onClose: () -> Unit) {
    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
        Text(
            "New patch",
            style = patchText(18.sp, FontWeight.ExtraBold, PatchColors.TitleSoft),

        }

}

@Composable
private fun SheetActions(
    valid: Boolean,
    onCancel: () -> Unit,
    onCreate: () -> Unit,
) {
    Row(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp, Alignment.End),
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .height(38.dp)
                .patchTap(0.96f, onCancel)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                .background(white(0.04f))
                .border(1.dp, white(0.12f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                .padding(horizontal = 20.dp),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            Text("Cancel", style = patchText(14.sp, FontWeight.Bold, Color(0xFFC7CFDD)))
        }

        val shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
        Box(
            Modifier
                .height(38.dp)
                .alpha(if (valid) 1f else 0.50f)
                .patchTap(0.96f) { if (valid) onCreate() }
                .clip(shape)
                .background(
                    if (valid) Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF9DBDEB), PatchColors.AccentDeep))
                    else SolidColor(PatchColors.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.20f))
                )
                .padding(horizontal = 26.dp),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            Text(
                "Create",
                style = patchText(
                    14.sp,
                    FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    if (valid) PatchColors.AccentText else white(0.35f),
                ),
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun PatchTile(
    modifier: Modifier,
    icon: PatchIconKind,
    title: String,
    sub: String,
    selected: Boolean,
    enabled: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
    val border by animateColorAsState(
        if (selected) PatchColors.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.65f) else white(0.08f),
        tween(200),
        label = "tileBorder",
    )
    val iconBg by animateColorAsState(
        if (selected) PatchColors.Accent else white(0.07f),
        tween(200),
        label = "tileIcon",
    )

    Row(
        modifier
            .alpha(if (enabled) 1f else 0.45f)
            .patchTap(0.97f) { if (enabled) onClick() }
            .clip(shape)
            .background(if (selected) white(0.08f) else white(0.04f))
            .border(1.dp, border, shape)
            .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(34.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                .background(iconBg),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            PatchIcon(
                icon,
                if (selected) PatchColors.AccentText else PatchColors.Icon,
                Modifier.size(17.dp),
            )
        }
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(title, style = patchText(15.sp, FontWeight.Bold), maxLines = 1)
            Text(
                sub,
                style = patchText(11.5.sp, color = PatchColors.Mute),
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            )
        }
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(20.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(if (selected) PatchColors.Accent else Color.Transparent)
                .border(1.5.dp, if (selected) Color.Transparent else white(0.20f), CircleShape),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            if (selected) {
                PatchIcon(
                    PatchIconKind.Check,
                    PatchColors.AccentText,
                    Modifier.size(12.dp),
                    stroke = 3.dp,
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun UndoSnack(name: String, onUndo: () -> Unit) {
    val progress = remember { Animatable(1f) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        progress.animateTo(
            0f,
            tween(5000, easing = androidx.compose.animation.core.LinearEasing),
        )
    }
    Box(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 18.dp),
    ) {
        val shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .shadow(
                    12.dp, shape,
                    ambientColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
                    spotColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.30f),
                )
                .clip(shape)
                .background(Color(0xF5222C40))
                .border(1.dp, white(0.10f), shape),
        ) {
            Row(
                Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(18.dp),
            ) {
                Text(
                    "\u201C$name\u201D deleted",
                    style = patchText(13.5.sp, FontWeight.SemiBold),
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false),
                )
                Text(
                    "UNDO",
                    style = TextStyle(
                        fontSize = 13.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        letterSpacing = 1.sp,
                        color = PatchColors.Accent,
                    ),
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .patchTap(0.92f, onUndo)
                        .padding(4.dp),
                )
            }
            Box(
                Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.BottomStart)
                    .fillMaxWidth(progress.value)
                    .height(3.dp)
                    .background(PatchColors.Accent),
            )
        }
    }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6. ICONS
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

private enum class PatchIconKind { Close, Plus, Edit, Trash, Check, Copy, Stack, Play, Pause }

@Composable
private fun PatchIcon(
    kind: PatchIconKind,
    color: Color,
    modifier: Modifier,
    stroke: Dp = 2.dp,
    fill: Boolean = false,
) {
    Canvas(modifier) {
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val sw = stroke.toPx()
        val st = Stroke(sw, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round)
        fun line(x1: Float, y1: Float, x2: Float, y2: Float) =
            drawLine(color, Offset(w * x1, h * y1), Offset(w * x2, h * y2), sw, StrokeCap.Round)

        when (kind) {
            PatchIconKind.Close -> {
                line(0.15f, 0.15f, 0.85f, 0.85f)
                line(0.85f, 0.15f, 0.15f, 0.85f)
            }
            PatchIconKind.Plus -> {
                line(0.5f, 0.1f, 0.5f, 0.9f)
                line(0.1f, 0.5f, 0.9f, 0.5f)
            }
            PatchIconKind.Check -> {
                line(0.2f, 0.52f, 0.42f, 0.74f)
                line(0.42f, 0.74f, 0.82f, 0.28f)
            }
            PatchIconKind.Edit -> {
                val p = Path().apply {
                    moveTo(w * 0.15f, h * 0.85f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.15f, h * 0.65f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.65f, h * 0.15f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.85f, h * 0.35f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.35f, h * 0.85f)
                    close()
                }
                drawPath(p, color, style = st)
                line(0.68f, 0.18f, 0.82f, 0.32f)
            }
            PatchIconKind.Trash -> {
                line(0.15f, 0.25f, 0.85f, 0.25f)
                line(0.38f, 0.25f, 0.38f, 0.10f)
                line(0.38f, 0.10f, 0.62f, 0.10f)
                line(0.62f, 0.10f, 0.62f, 0.25f)
                val p = Path().apply {
                    moveTo(w * 0.25f, h * 0.25f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.30f, h * 0.90f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.70f, h * 0.90f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.75f, h * 0.25f)
                }
                drawPath(p, color, style = st)
                line(0.42f, 0.42f, 0.42f, 0.74f)
                line(0.58f, 0.42f, 0.58f, 0.74f)
            }
            PatchIconKind.Copy -> {
                drawRoundRect(
                    color,
                    Offset(w * 0.34f, h * 0.34f),
                    Size(w * 0.56f, h * 0.56f),
                    CornerRadius(w * 0.10f),
                    style = st,
                )
                val p = Path().apply {
                    moveTo(w * 0.22f, h * 0.66f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.18f, h * 0.66f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.10f, h * 0.58f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.10f, h * 0.18f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.18f, h * 0.10f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.58f, h * 0.10f)
                    lineTo(w * 0.66f, h * 0.18f)
                }
                drawPath(p, color, style = st)
            }
            PatchIconKind.Stack -> {
                drawRoundRect(
                    color, Offset(w * 0.17f, h * 0.25f),
                    Size(w * 0.66f, h * 0.12f), CornerRadius(w * 0.06f),
                    style = st,
                )
                drawRoundRect(
                    color, Offset(w * 0.17f, h * 0.44f),
                    Size(w * 0.66f, h * 0.12f), CornerRadius(w * 0.06f),
                    style = st,
                )
                drawRoundRect(
                    color, Offset(w * 0.17f, h * 0.63f),
                    Size(w * 0.66f, h * 0.12f), CornerRadius(w * 0.06f),
                    style = st,
                )
            }
            PatchIconKind.Play -> {
                if (fill) {
                    val p = Path().apply {
                        moveTo(w * 0.30f, h * 0.20f)
                        lineTo(w * 0.82f, h * 0.50f)
                        lineTo(w * 0.30f, h * 0.80f)
                        close()
                    }
                    drawPath(p, color)
                }
            }
            PatchIconKind.Pause -> {
                if (fill) {
                    drawRoundRect(
                        color,
                        Offset(w * 0.28f, h * 0.22f),
                        Size(w * 0.15f, h * 0.56f),
                        CornerRadius(w * 0.05f),
                    )
                    drawRoundRect(
                        color,
                        Offset(w * 0.57f, h * 0.22f),
                        Size(w * 0.15f, h * 0.56f),
                        CornerRadius(w * 0.05f),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                state = state.copy(activePatchId = if (state.activePatchId == id) null else id)
            }
            override fun onDeletePatch(id: String) {
                state = state.copy(patches = state.patches.filterNot { it.id == id })
            }
            override fun onCreatePatch(name: String, duplicateFrom: String?) {
                val base = state.patches.firstOrNull { it.id == duplicateFrom }
                state = state.copy(
                    patches = listOf(
                        Patch("p" + System.nanoTime(), name, base?.snapshotCount ?: 0)
                    ) + state.patches,
                )
            }
        }
    }
    Box(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Color(0xFF141B27), Color(0xFF0F141D))))
    ) {
        PatchesOverlay(state = state, actions = actions)
    }
}

/** Four tones with the same luminosity and a moderate saturation: none of them dominates. */
enum class SetlistColor(val base: Color, val text: Color) {
    Blue(AppColors.SetlistBlue, Color(0xFFA9C6F0)),
    Amber(AppColors.SetlistAmber, Color(0xFFE6BC73)),
    Rose(AppColors.SetlistRose, Color(0xFFDB8AA3)),
    Sage(AppColors.SetlistSage, Color(0xFFA5BFB1))
}

data class Setlist(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val patchCount: Int,
    val color: SetlistColor,
    val isPinned: Boolean = false,
    /** Epoch millis of the last time the setlist was opened. */
    val lastUsedAt: Long = 0L
)

enum class SetlistSort(val label: String) { Recent("Recent"), Name("Name"), Patches("Patches") }

enum class OpenGesture(val label: String) { Tap("Tap"), DoubleTap("Double tap"), Hold("Hold") }

enum class CreateMode { Blank, Duplicate }

/** Page-level preferences (opened by the gear). Persist them on the app side. */
data class SetlistsPrefs(
    val animatedBackground: Boolean = true,
    val cardAuras: Boolean = true,
    val compactRows: Boolean = false,
    val patchDots: Boolean = true,
    val openWith: OpenGesture = OpenGesture.Tap,
    val pinnedOnTop: Boolean = true,
    val rememberSort: Boolean = true,
    val lockDeletion: Boolean = false,
    val haptics: Boolean = true
)

data class SetlistsUiState(
    val setlists: List<Setlist> = emptyList(),
    /** The setlist currently loaded in the app, or null (first launch / none open). */
    val openSetlistId: String? = null,
    /** The last setlist that was opened (kept even when none is open right now). */
    val lastOpenedId: String? = null,
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val query: String = "",
    val sort: SetlistSort = SetlistSort.Recent,
    val onlyPinned: Boolean = false,
    val prefs: SetlistsPrefs = SetlistsPrefs(),
    /** True when the system asks for reduced motion (e.g. animator duration scale = 0). */
    val reducedMotion: Boolean = false
) {
    /** The global Back button (returns to the mixer) must only be enabled when this is true. */
    val isBackEnabled: Boolean get() = openSetlistId != null
}

/** Every method has an empty default body: wire what you need first. */
interface SetlistsActions {
    fun onCancel() {}
    /** Load the setlist, mark it as open and last opened, update lastUsedAt, return to the mixer. */
    fun onOpenSetlist(id: String) {}
    /** [mode] Blank = no patches. Duplicate = copy of the currently open setlist. Color: see [SetlistsLogic.autoColor]. */
    fun onCreateSetlist(name: String, mode: CreateMode) {}
    fun onRenameSetlist(id: String, name: String) {}
    fun onChangeColor(id: String, color: SetlistColor) {}
    fun onDuplicateSetlist(id: String) {}
    fun onTogglePin(id: String) {}
    /** Delete immediately; the host must keep the last deleted setlist so that [onUndoDelete] can restore it. */
    fun onDeleteSetlist(id: String) {}
    fun onUndoDelete() {}
    fun onQueryChange(query: String) {}

    /** "All app settings" link inside the page settings panel. */
    fun onOpenAppSettings() {}
}

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 2. PURE LOGIC (unit-testable, no Android dependency except java.time)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

object SetlistsLogic {
    const val MAX_NAME = 40
    const val TOP_CARDS = 4

    fun patchLabel(n: Int) = if (n == 1) "patch" else "patches"

    /** "Setlist N" with the first free N. */
    fun nextDefaultName(existing: List<Setlist>): String {
        var n = existing.size + 1
        while (existing.any { it.name == "Setlist $n" }) n++
        return "Setlist $n"
    }

    fun isNameValid(name: String) = name.trim().isNotEmpty() && name.length <= MAX_NAME

    /**
     * Automatic color on creation: the least used color (ties: palette order).
     * For a duplicate pass the source color: the copy takes the next one in the palette.
     */
    fun autoColor(existing: List<Setlist>, after: SetlistColor? = null): SetlistColor {
        val all = SetlistColor.values()
        if (after != null) return all[(after.ordinal + 1) % all.size]
        val counts = all.map { c -> existing.count { it.color == c } }
        return all[counts.indexOf(counts.minOrNull() ?: 0)]
    }

    /** The 4 most recently used setlists. Fixed: not affected by search, sort or the Pinned filter. */
    fun topCards(all: List<Setlist>): List<Setlist> =
        all.sortedByDescending { it.lastUsedAt }.take(TOP_CARDS)

    /** Search + Pinned filter + sort. Pinned setlists stay on top when [pinnedOnTop] is true. */
    fun visibleList(
        all: List<Setlist>,
        query: String,
        sort: SetlistSort,
        onlyPinned: Boolean,
        pinnedOnTop: Boolean
    ): List<Setlist> {
        val q = query.trim().lowercase()
        val base: Comparator<Setlist> = when (sort) {
            SetlistSort.Recent -> compareByDescending<Setlist> { it.lastUsedAt }
            SetlistSort.Name -> compareBy<Setlist> { it.name.lowercase() }
            SetlistSort.Patches -> compareByDescending<Setlist> { it.patchCount }
        }
        val cmp = if (pinnedOnTop) compareByDescending<Setlist> { it.isPinned }.then(base) else base
        return all
            .filter { (q.isEmpty() || it.name.lowercase().contains(q)) && (!onlyPinned || it.isPinned) }
            .sortedWith(cmp)
    }

    /** "Today, 21:51" / "Yesterday, 18:20" / "Oct 6". */
    fun formatLastUsed(
        timestampMs: Long,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()
    ): String {
        val d = Instant.ofEpochMilli(timestampMs).atZone(zone)
        val today = Instant.ofEpochMilli(nowMs).atZone(zone).toLocalDate()
        val time = d.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HH:mm", Locale.ENGLISH))
        return when (d.toLocalDate()) {
            today -> "Today, $time"
            today.minusDays(1) -> "Yesterday, $time"
            else -> d.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MMM d", Locale.ENGLISH))
        }
    }
}
