    fun createBlankScene(name: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                val json = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
                    put("name", name)
                    put("bpm", 120)
                    put("transpose", 0)
                    put("octave", 0)
                    put("tonicBrightness", 0.70f)
                    put("tonicShimmer", 0.15f)
                    put("tonicOctaveRange", "C3 — C4")
                    put("drumVolume", 0.75f)
                    put("drumReverb", 0.20f)
                    put("tonicVolume", 0.80f)
                    put("tonicReverb", 0.25f)
                    put("masterVolume", 0.85f)

                    val tracksArray = org.json.JSONArray()
                    for (i in 1..8) {
                        val tObj = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
                            put("id", i)
                            put("name", "Track $i")
                            put("isEnabled", false)
                            put("volume", 0.0f)
                            put("pan", 0.0f)
                            put("soundfontName", "")
                            put("patchName", "")
                            put("bank", 0)
                            put("program", 0)
                            put("reverbPreset", "Concert Hall")
                            put("reverbMix", 0.25f)
                        }
                        tracksArray.put(tObj)
                    }
                    put("tracks", tracksArray)

                    val slotsArray = org.json.JSONArray()
                    for (i in 0..9) {
                        val sObj = org.json.JSONObject().apply {
                            put("slotId", i)
                            put("soundFontPath", "")
                            put("bank", 0)
                            put("preset", 0)
                            put("patchName", "")
                            put("volume", if (i == 0) 0.85f else 0.0f)
                            put("pan", 0.0f)
                        }
                        slotsArray.put(sObj)
                    }
                    put("audioSlots", slotsArray)
                }

                fileManager.saveSceneFile(name, json.toString())
                val sceneFiles = fileManager.getSceneFiles()
                val updatedScenes = sceneFiles.map { f ->
                    val savedColorName = appStatePersistence.getString("setlist_col_${f.name}", SetlistColor.Blue.name)
                    val savedColor = runCatching { SetlistColor.valueOf(savedColorName) }.getOrDefault(SetlistColor.Blue)
                    ScenePreset(id = f.name, name = f.name, timestamp = f.formattedSize, color = savedColor.base)
                }
                _uiState.update { it.copy(scenes = updatedScenes, activeSceneId = name) }
                // Appliquer immédiatement cette scène vierge
                selectScene(name)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
        }
    }

    fun setSoundGoodizer(v: Float) {
        val clamped = v.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        _uiState.update { state ->
            val curMasterFx = state.fxParameters[0] ?: FxParameters()
            val updatedMasterFx = curMasterFx.copy(
                isSgEnabled = clamped > 0.001f,
                sgAmount = clamped
            )
            val updatedMap = state.fxParameters.toMutableMap()
            updatedMap[0] = updatedMasterFx
            state.copy(
                soundGoodizer = clamped,
                fxParameters = updatedMap
            )
        }
        audioEngine.soundGoodizerAmount = clamped
        audioEngine.isSoundGoodizerEnabled = clamped > 0.001f
        val mode = _uiState.value.soundGoodizerMode
        NativeAudioBridge.safeSetSoundGoodizer(clamped > 0.001f, mode.ordinal, clamped)
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    // ================= FX PARAMETERS =================
    fun updateFxParameter(trackId: Int, transform: (FxParameters) -> FxParameters) {
        _uiState.update { state ->
            val current = state.fxParameters[trackId] ?: FxParameters()
            val newFx = transform(current)
            val updatedMap = state.fxParameters.toMutableMap()
            updatedMap[trackId] = newFx

            // If trackId == 0 (Master), update native master EQ, Reverb, Delay, SoundGoodizer
            if (trackId == 0) {
                val lowDb = (newFx.eqLow - 0.5f) * 24.0f
                val midDb = (newFx.eqMid - 0.5f) * 24.0f
                val highDb = (newFx.eqHigh - 0.5f) * 24.0f
                audioEngine.setMasterEq(lowDb, midDb, highDb)
                audioEngine.setMasterReverb(
                    enabled = newFx.isReverbEnabled,
                    size = newFx.reverbSize,
                    decay = newFx.reverbDecay,
                    damp = newFx.reverbDamp,
                    mix = newFx.reverbMix
                )
                val isDelayActive = newFx.isDelayEnabled && newFx.delayMix > 0.005f
                audioEngine.setMasterDelay(
                    enabled = isDelayActive,
                    timeSec = 0.05f + newFx.delayTime * 0.95f,
                    feedback = if (isDelayActive) newFx.delayFeedback else 0f,
                    mix = if (isDelayActive) newFx.delayMix else 0f,
                    pingPong = newFx.delayPingPong > 0.5f
                )
                val isChorusActive = newFx.isChorusEnabled && newFx.chorusMix > 0.005f
                audioEngine.setMasterChorus(
                    enabled = isChorusActive,
                    rateHz = 0.2f + newFx.chorusRate * 4.8f,
                    depthMs = 1.0f + newFx.chorusDepth * 14.0f,
                    mix = if (isChorusActive) newFx.chorusMix else 0f
                )
                val compThreshold = -36f + newFx.compThresh * 28f
                val compRatioVal = 1.5f + newFx.compRatio * 8.5f
                val makeupGain = if (newFx.isCompEnabled) {
                    val reductionEst = (-compThreshold) * (1f - 1f / compRatioVal)
                    (reductionEst * 0.75f).coerceIn(0f, 15f)
                } else 0f
                audioEngine.setMasterCompressor(
                    enabled = newFx.isCompEnabled,
                    thresholdDb = compThreshold,
                    ratio = compRatioVal,
                    attackMs = 1.0f + newFx.compAttack * 40f,
                    releaseMs = 20.0f + newFx.compRelease * 350f,
                    makeupGainDb = makeupGain
                )
                val modeStr = when (newFx.sgMode) {
                    0 -> "A"
                    1 -> "B"
                    2 -> "C"
                    3 -> "D"
                    else -> "A"
                }
                audioEngine.soundGoodizerMode = modeStr
                audioEngine.isSoundGoodizerEnabled = newFx.isSgEnabled
                audioEngine.soundGoodizerAmount = newFx.sgAmount
                NativeAudioBridge.safeSetSoundGoodizer(newFx.isSgEnabled, newFx.sgMode, newFx.sgAmount)
                val sgEnumMode = when (newFx.sgMode) {
                    0 -> SoundGoodizerMode.A
                    1 -> SoundGoodizerMode.B
                    2 -> SoundGoodizerMode.C
                    else -> SoundGoodizerMode.D
                }
                state.copy(
                    fxParameters = updatedMap,
                    soundGoodizer = newFx.sgAmount,
                    soundGoodizerMode = sgEnumMode
                )
            } else {
                if (trackId in 1..8) {
                    val channel = trackId - 1
                    audioEngine.setChannelReverb(channel, if (newFx.isReverbEnabled) newFx.reverbMix else 0f)
                    audioEngine.setChannelChorus(channel, if (newFx.isChorusEnabled) newFx.chorusMix else 0f)
                }
                state.copy(fxParameters = updatedMap)
            }
        }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    fun setTrackReverbPreset(trackId: Int, preset: String) {
        val presetParams = when (preset) {
            "Concert Hall" -> Quad(0.42f, 0.85f, 0.70f, 0.30f)
            "Warm Room" -> Quad(0.35f, 0.40f, 0.30f, 0.60f)
            "Plate 80s" -> Quad(0.48f, 0.70f, 0.55f, 0.20f)
            "Cathedral" -> Quad(0.65f, 0.95f, 0.90f, 0.15f)
            "Ambient Shimmer" -> Quad(0.60f, 0.90f, 0.85f, 0.10f)
            "Vocal Chamber" -> Quad(0.30f, 0.50f, 0.40f, 0.45f)
            "Studio Room" -> Quad(0.25f, 0.30f, 0.20f, 0.50f)
            else -> Quad(0.24f, 0.60f, 0.45f, 0.30f)
        }
        _uiState.update { state ->
            val currentFx = state.fxParameters[trackId] ?: FxParameters()
            val isCurrentPreset = (currentFx.reverbPreset == preset && currentFx.isReverbEnabled)
            val isDeselecting = isCurrentPreset
            val nextPreset = if (isDeselecting) "None" else preset
            val nextEnabled = !isDeselecting
            val nextMix = if (isDeselecting) 0f else presetParams.a

            val updatedFxMap = state.fxParameters.toMutableMap()
            if (!isDeselecting) {
                updatedFxMap[trackId] = currentFx.copy(
                    isReverbEnabled = true,
                    reverbPreset = nextPreset,
                    reverbMix = presetParams.a,
                    reverbSize = presetParams.b,
                    reverbDecay = presetParams.c,
                    reverbDamp = presetParams.d
                )
            } else {
                updatedFxMap[trackId] = currentFx.copy(
                    isReverbEnabled = false,
                    reverbPreset = "None",
                    reverbMix = 0f
                )
            }

            if (trackId in 1..8) {
                audioEngine.setChannelReverb(trackId - 1, if (nextEnabled) nextMix else 0f)
            } else if (trackId == 0) {
                val size = if (!isDeselecting) presetParams.b else currentFx.reverbSize
                val decay = if (!isDeselecting) presetParams.c else currentFx.reverbDecay
                val damp = if (!isDeselecting) presetParams.d else currentFx.reverbDamp
                audioEngine.setMasterReverb(nextEnabled, size, decay, damp, if (nextEnabled) nextMix else 0f)
            }

            if (trackId == 0) {
                state.copy(
                    masterTrack = state.masterTrack.copy(
                        reverbPreset = nextPreset,
                        reverbMix = nextMix,
                        reverbSize = if (!isDeselecting) presetParams.b else state.masterTrack.reverbSize,
                        reverbDecay = if (!isDeselecting) presetParams.c else state.masterTrack.reverbDecay
                    ),
                    fxParameters = updatedFxMap
                )
            } else {
                val updated = state.tracks.map { track ->
                    if (track.id == trackId) {
                        track.copy(
                            reverbPreset = nextPreset,
                            reverbMix = nextMix,
                            reverbSize = if (!isDeselecting) presetParams.b else track.reverbSize,
                            reverbDecay = if (!isDeselecting) presetParams.c else track.reverbDecay
                        )
                    } else track
                }
                state.copy(tracks = updated, fxParameters = updatedFxMap)
            }
        }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    fun toggleTrackReverb(trackId: Int) {
        _uiState.update { state ->
            val current = state.fxParameters[trackId] ?: FxParameters()
            val newEnabled = !current.isReverbEnabled
            val updatedMap = state.fxParameters.toMutableMap()
            val newMix = if (newEnabled) (if (current.reverbMix <= 0.01f) 0.35f else current.reverbMix) else 0f
            updatedMap[trackId] = current.copy(isReverbEnabled = newEnabled, reverbMix = newMix)
            if (trackId in 1..8) {
                audioEngine.setChannelReverb(trackId - 1, if (newEnabled) newMix else 0f)
            } else if (trackId == 0) {
                audioEngine.setMasterReverb(newEnabled, current.reverbSize, current.reverbDecay, current.reverbDamp, if (newEnabled) newMix else 0f)
            }
            if (trackId == 0) {
                state.copy(
                    masterTrack = state.masterTrack.copy(reverbMix = newMix),
                    fxParameters = updatedMap
                )
            } else {
                val updated = state.tracks.map { track ->
                    if (track.id == trackId) track.copy(reverbMix = newMix) else track
                }
                state.copy(tracks = updated, fxParameters = updatedMap)
            }
        }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    private data class Quad(val a: Float, val b: Float, val c: Float, val d: Float)

    fun updateTrackVelocityConfig(trackId: Int, config: VelocityConfig) {
        _uiState.update { state ->
            val updated = state.tracks.map { track ->
                if (track.id == trackId) track.copy(velocityConfig = config) else track
            }
            state.copy(tracks = updated)
        }
        val processor = VelocityProcessor(config)
        audioEngine.setTrackVelocityProcessor(trackId - 1, processor)
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    /** Pushes the per-track playback settings to the audio engine (transpose, bend range, ...). */
    private fun applyTrackPlaybackSettings(track: TrackChannel) {
        val ch = track.id - 1
        // Native transpose is expressed in semitones; the octave setting is folded in (1 octave = 12 st).
        NativeAudioBridge.safeSetTrackTranspose(ch, track.transpose + track.octave * 12)
        NativeAudioBridge.safeSetPitchBendRange(ch, track.pitchBendRange)
    }

    fun setTrackTranspose(trackId: Int, semitones: Int) {
        val v = semitones.coerceIn(-12, 12)
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(transpose = v) }
        pushTranspose(trackId)
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    fun setTrackOctave(trackId: Int, octave: Int) {
        val v = octave.coerceIn(-3, 3)
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(octave = v) }
        pushTranspose(trackId)
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    private fun pushTranspose(trackId: Int) {
        val track = _uiState.value.tracks.getOrNull(trackId - 1) ?: return
        NativeAudioBridge.safeSetTrackTranspose(trackId - 1, track.transpose + track.octave * 12)
    }

    fun setTrackPitchBendRange(trackId: Int, semitones: Int) {
        val v = semitones.coerceIn(1, 12)
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(pitchBendRange = v) }
        NativeAudioBridge.safeSetPitchBendRange(trackId - 1, v)
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    fun setTrackDefaultVolume(trackId: Int, volume: Int) {
        val v = volume.coerceIn(0, 127)
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(defaultVolume = v) }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    fun setTrackDefaultPan(trackId: Int, pan: Int) {
        val v = pan.coerceIn(-64, 63)
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(defaultPan = v) }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    fun setTrackSustain(trackId: Int, enabled: Boolean) {
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(sustain = enabled) }
        if (!enabled) {
            // The Playback switch only gated the *next* note, so turning Sustain off
            // while the pedal was down left the held notes ringing and the switch
            // looked inert. Release the pedal and the sustained voices now.
            val ch = trackId - 1
            NativeAudioBridge.safeControlChange(channel = ch, cc = 64, value = 0)
            NativeAudioBridge.safeControlChange(channel = ch, cc = 123, value = 0)
        }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    fun setTrackAftertouch(trackId: Int, enabled: Boolean) {
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(aftertouch = enabled) }
        if (!enabled) {
            // Drop any pressure already applied so the switch has a visible effect
            // instead of waiting for the controller's next message.
            NativeAudioBridge.safeChannelPressure(trackId - 1, 0)
        }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    fun setTrackProgramChange(trackId: Int, enabled: Boolean) {
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(programChange = enabled) }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

    /** Sets a per-track colour override; pass null to fall back to the default palette colour. */
    fun setTrackColor(trackId: Int, argb: Int?) {
        updateTrack(trackId) { it.copy(customColorArgb = argb) }
        persistCurrentStateDebounced()
    }

        _uiState.update { state ->
            state.copy(tracks = state.tracks.map { if (it.id == trackId) transform(it) else it })
        }
    }

    fun selectPrevPatch() {
        val state = _uiState.value
        val patches = state.patches
        if (patches.isEmpty()) return
        val currentIdx = patches.indexOfFirst { it.id == state.activePatchId }
        val prevIdx = if (currentIdx <= 0) patches.size - 1 else currentIdx - 1
        selectPatch(patches[prevIdx].id)
    }

    fun selectNextPatch() {
        val state = _uiState.value
        val patches = state.patches
        if (patches.isEmpty()) return
        val currentIdx = patches.indexOfFirst { it.id == state.activePatchId }
        val nextIdx = if (currentIdx < 0 || currentIdx >= patches.size - 1) 0 else currentIdx + 1
        selectPatch(patches[nextIdx].id)
    }

        val state = _uiState.value
        val slots = state.configuredSnapshotSlots
        if (slots.isEmpty()) return
        val currentIdx = slots.indexOf(state.activeSnapshotSlot)

    private var tapTempoTimes = mutableListOf<Long>()
    fun handleTapTempo() {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        tapTempoTimes.add(now)
        if (tapTempoTimes.size > 4) {
            tapTempoTimes.removeAt(0)
        }
        if (tapTempoTimes.size >= 2) {
            val intervals = mutableListOf<Long>()
            for (i in 1 until tapTempoTimes.size) {
                val diff = tapTempoTimes[i] - tapTempoTimes[i - 1]
                if (diff in 200..3000) {
                    intervals.add(diff)
                }
            }
            if (intervals.isNotEmpty()) {
                val avgMs = intervals.average()
                val calculatedBpm = (60000.0 / avgMs).toInt().coerceIn(30, 280)
                setGlobalBpm(calculatedBpm)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleMidiMappingEvent(channel: Int, command: Int, data1: Int, data2: Int) {
        val statusCmd = if (command >= 0x80) (command and 0xF0) else command
        val midiType = when (statusCmd) {
            0x90, 0x80 -> MidiControlType.NOTE
            0xB0 -> MidiControlType.CC
            0xC0 -> MidiControlType.PROGRAM_CHANGE
            0xD0 -> MidiControlType.AFTERTOUCH
            0xE0 -> MidiControlType.PITCH_BEND
            else -> return
        }
        // A Program Change and a Channel Aftertouch carry ONE data byte: the value lives in
        // data1, and data2 is the channel byte. Reading data2 there would always give 0.
        // Pitch Bend carries LSB then MSB, so the 14-bit value is (MSB << 7) or LSB.
        val ctrlNumber = if (midiType == MidiControlType.PITCH_BEND) 0 else data1
        val value = when (statusCmd) {
            0x80 -> 0
            0xC0, 0xD0 -> data1
            0xE0 -> ((data2 shl 7) or data1) shr 6
            else -> data2
        }

        val learningType = _uiState.value.learningActionType
        if (learningType != null) {
            // Arm on ANY signal. A worn/at-rest controller can send value 0 (a CC whose
            // fader sits at the bottom, a Note Off); rejecting those made learn look dead.
            // Only ignore an explicit release we can identify as such.
            if (statusCmd == 0x80) return
            _uiState.update { state ->
                val updated = state.midiMappings.map { m ->
                    if (m.actionType == learningType) {
                        m.copy(
                            midiType = midiType,
                            channel = channel,
                            controlNumber = ctrlNumber,
                            isEnabled = true
                        )
                    } else m
                }
                state.copy(
                    midiMappings = updated,
                    learningActionType = null,
                    lastMidiSummary = "Assigned: ${learningType.title} ➔ ${midiType.name} #$ctrlNumber (Ch. ${channel + 1})",
                    lastMidiTriggerTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
                )
            }
            persistCurrentStateDebounced()
            return
        }

        // Live execution
        val summary = when (midiType) {
            MidiControlType.CC -> "CC #$ctrlNumber (Ch. ${channel + 1}, Val $value)"
            MidiControlType.NOTE -> "Note #$ctrlNumber (Ch. ${channel + 1}, Vel $value)"
            MidiControlType.AFTERTOUCH -> "Aftertouch (Ch. ${channel + 1}, Val $value)"
            MidiControlType.PITCH_BEND -> "Pitch Bend (Ch. ${channel + 1}, Val $value)"
            MidiControlType.PROGRAM_CHANGE -> "PC #$ctrlNumber (Ch. ${channel + 1})"
        }
        _uiState.update { it.copy(lastMidiSummary = summary, lastMidiTriggerTime = System.currentTimeMillis()) }

        val activeMappings = _uiState.value.midiMappings.filter { m ->
            m.isEnabled && m.isAssigned && m.midiType == midiType && m.controlNumber == ctrlNumber &&
                (m.channel < 0 || m.channel == channel)
        }

        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        // Single jitter filter. `antiJitter` / `jitterWindowMs` are the only knobs:
        // the old `midiDebounce*` pair was a second, hidden control for the same job.
        val debounceActive = _uiState.value.antiJitter
        val debounceMs = _uiState.value.jitterWindowMs.toLong()

        for (m in activeMappings) {
            if (debounceActive && debounceMs > 0) {
                // Precise jitter filter per control identity: prevents mechanical bounce bursts
                val controlKey = "${channel}_${midiType.name}_$ctrlNumber"
                val lastTime = midiControlLastTriggerTime[controlKey] ?: 0L
                val elapsed = now - lastTime
                if (elapsed < debounceMs) {
                    continue
                }
                midiControlLastTriggerTime[controlKey] = now
            }
            executeMidiAction(m.actionType, value, isProgramChange = (midiType == MidiControlType.PROGRAM_CHANGE))
        }
    }

    private val midiControlLastTriggerTime = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Long>()

    fun recallSnapshotDirect(slotName: String) {
        val currentState = _uiState.value
        snapshotTransitionJob?.cancel()

        val activePatch = currentState.patches.find { it.id == currentState.activePatchId }
        val targetSnapshot = currentState.snapshots[slotName]
            ?: activePatch?.snapshots?.get(slotName)
            ?: if (slotName == "slot_default") {
                activePatch?.snapshots?.get("slot_default") ?: SubSceneSnapshot(
                    slotName = "Default",
                    tracks = (activePatch?.tracks ?: currentState.tracks).map { t ->
                        TrackSnapshot(
                            id = t.id,
                            volume = t.volume,
                            pan = t.pan,
                            isMuted = t.isMuted,
                            isSolo = t.isSolo,
                            isEnabled = t.isEnabled,
                            soundfontName = t.soundfontName,
                            patchName = t.patchName,
                            bank = t.bank,
                            program = t.program,
                            reverbSend = t.reverbMix,
                            splitNoteMin = t.splitNoteMin,
                            splitNoteMax = t.splitNoteMax,
                            velocityCurve = t.velocityCurve
                        )
                    },
                    globalTranspose = activePatch?.transpose ?: currentState.transpose,
                    globalOctaveShift = activePatch?.octave ?: currentState.octave,
                    masterVolume = activePatch?.masterVolume ?: currentState.masterTrack.volume,
                    visibleTracksCount = activePatch?.visibleTracksCount ?: currentState.visibleTracksCount
                )
            } else null

        if (targetSnapshot != null) {
            val targetTracks = currentState.tracks.map { tr ->
                val snap = targetSnapshot.tracks.find { it.id == tr.id }
                if (snap != null) {
                    val sfName = if (snap.soundfontName.isNotEmpty()) snap.soundfontName else tr.soundfontName
                    val patchName = if (snap.soundfontName.isNotEmpty()) snap.patchName else tr.patchName
                    tr.copy(
                        volume = snap.volume,
                        pan = snap.pan,
                        isMuted = snap.isMuted,
                        isSolo = snap.isSolo,
                        isEnabled = snap.isEnabled,
                        soundfontName = sfName,
                        patchName = patchName,
                        bank = snap.bank,
                        program = snap.program,
                        splitNoteMin = snap.splitNoteMin,
                        splitNoteMax = snap.splitNoteMax,
                        velocityCurve = snap.velocityCurve
                    )
                } else {
                    tr.copy(isEnabled = false, isMuted = true)
                }
            }

            targetTracks.forEachIndexed { idx, track ->
                if (!track.isEnabled || track.isMuted) {
                    audioEngine.setChannelEnabled(idx, false)
                    if (idx in 0..7) {
                        NativeAudioBridge.safeAllNotesOff(idx)
                    }
                }
                if (track.soundfontName.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val candidate = File(fileManager.soundfontsDir, track.soundfontName)
                    val currentSlot = currentState.audioSlots.getOrNull(idx)
                    if (currentSlot != null && currentSlot.soundFontId > 0 &&
                        (currentSlot.soundFontPath == candidate.absolutePath || currentSlot.soundFontPath?.endsWith(track.soundfontName) == true)
                    ) {
                        audioEngine.setChannelProgram(idx, track.program, track.bank)
                        NativeAudioBridge.safeSelectProgram(
                            engineIndex = NativeAudioBridge.ENGINE_FADER,
                            channel = idx,
                            soundFontId = currentSlot.soundFontId,
                            bank = track.bank,
                            preset = track.program
                        )
                        val effectiveVol = if (track.isMuted || !track.isEnabled) 0f else track.volume
                        NativeAudioBridge.safeSetTrackVolume(idx, effectiveVol)
                    } else if (candidate.exists()) {
                        loadSoundFontForSlot(idx, candidate.absolutePath, track.bank, track.program, track.patchName, saveAfterLoad = false)
                    }
                }
            }

            audioEngine.globalOctaveShift = targetSnapshot.globalOctaveShift
            audioEngine.globalTranspose = targetSnapshot.globalTranspose

            targetTracks.forEachIndexed { idx, track ->
                val effectiveVol = if (track.isMuted || !track.isEnabled) 0f else track.volume
                NativeAudioBridge.safeSetTrackVolume(idx, effectiveVol)
                NativeAudioBridge.safeSetTrackPan(idx, track.pan)
            }

            _uiState.update { state ->
                state.copy(
                    activeSnapshotSlot = slotName,
                    tracks = targetTracks,
                    transpose = targetSnapshot.globalTranspose,
                    octave = targetSnapshot.globalOctaveShift,
                    visibleTracksCount = targetSnapshot.visibleTracksCount,
                    snapshotTransitionProgress = 1.0f
                )
            }
            persistCurrentStateDebounced()
        }
    }

    }

    private fun executeMidiAction(action: MidiActionType, value: Int, isProgramChange: Boolean = false) {
        val isContinuous = action.name.endsWith("_VOL") || action.name.endsWith("_PUNCH") ||
            action.name.endsWith("_GOODIZER") || action.name.endsWith("_PARAM")
        val isDrumPad = action.name.startsWith("DRUMPAD_PAD_")

        // For button actions (toggles, triggers, snapshots, patches), trigger on positive press (> 0),
        // or also support toggle controllers when configured.
        // Program Changes (PC) carry program number without velocity byte and must always trigger.
        val isButtonAction = !isContinuous && !isDrumPad
        if (isButtonAction && !isProgramChange) {
            val mapping = _uiState.value.midiMappings.find { it.actionType == action }
            val isToggle = mapping?.mode == MidiControlMode.TOGGLE
            if (value <= 0 && !isToggle) {
                return
            }
        }

        when (action) {
            MidiActionType.SNAPSHOT_DEFAULT -> onSnapshotSlotClick("slot_default")
            MidiActionType.SNAPSHOT_1 -> {
                val slot = _uiState.value.configuredSnapshotSlots.getOrNull(0) ?: "slot_1"
                onSnapshotSlotClick(slot)
            }
            MidiActionType.SNAPSHOT_2 -> {
                val slot = _uiState.value.configuredSnapshotSlots.getOrNull(1) ?: "slot_2"
                onSnapshotSlotClick(slot)
            }
            MidiActionType.SNAPSHOT_3 -> {
                val slot = _uiState.value.configuredSnapshotSlots.getOrNull(2) ?: "slot_3"
                onSnapshotSlotClick(slot)
            }
            MidiActionType.SNAPSHOT_4 -> {
                val slot = _uiState.value.configuredSnapshotSlots.getOrNull(3) ?: "slot_4"
                onSnapshotSlotClick(slot)
            }
            MidiActionType.SNAPSHOT_PREV -> selectPrevSnapshot()
            MidiActionType.SNAPSHOT_NEXT -> selectNextSnapshot()

            MidiActionType.PATCH_PREV -> selectPrevPatch()
            MidiActionType.PATCH_NEXT -> selectNextPatch()

            MidiActionType.TRACK_1_MUTE -> toggleMuteTrackByIndex(0)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_1_SOLO -> toggleSoloTrackByIndex(0)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_1_VOL -> setTrackVolume(1, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))

            MidiActionType.TRACK_2_MUTE -> toggleMuteTrackByIndex(1)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_2_SOLO -> toggleSoloTrackByIndex(1)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_2_VOL -> setTrackVolume(2, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))

            MidiActionType.TRACK_3_MUTE -> toggleMuteTrackByIndex(2)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_3_SOLO -> toggleSoloTrackByIndex(2)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_3_VOL -> setTrackVolume(3, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))

            MidiActionType.TRACK_4_MUTE -> toggleMuteTrackByIndex(3)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_4_SOLO -> toggleSoloTrackByIndex(3)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_4_VOL -> setTrackVolume(4, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))

            MidiActionType.TRACK_5_MUTE -> toggleMuteTrackByIndex(4)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_5_SOLO -> toggleSoloTrackByIndex(4)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_5_VOL -> setTrackVolume(5, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))

            MidiActionType.TRACK_6_MUTE -> toggleMuteTrackByIndex(5)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_6_SOLO -> toggleSoloTrackByIndex(5)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_6_VOL -> setTrackVolume(6, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))

            MidiActionType.TRACK_7_MUTE -> toggleMuteTrackByIndex(6)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_7_SOLO -> toggleSoloTrackByIndex(6)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_7_VOL -> setTrackVolume(7, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))

            MidiActionType.TRACK_8_MUTE -> toggleMuteTrackByIndex(7)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_8_SOLO -> toggleSoloTrackByIndex(7)
            MidiActionType.TRACK_8_VOL -> setTrackVolume(8, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))

            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_PAD_1 -> if (value > 0) onDrumPadPressed(1) else onDrumPadReleased(1)
            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_PAD_2 -> if (value > 0) onDrumPadPressed(2) else onDrumPadReleased(2)
            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_PAD_3 -> if (value > 0) onDrumPadPressed(3) else onDrumPadReleased(3)
            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_PAD_4 -> if (value > 0) onDrumPadPressed(4) else onDrumPadReleased(4)
            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_PAD_5 -> if (value > 0) onDrumPadPressed(5) else onDrumPadReleased(5)
            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_PAD_6 -> if (value > 0) onDrumPadPressed(6) else onDrumPadReleased(6)
            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_PAD_7 -> if (value > 0) onDrumPadPressed(7) else onDrumPadReleased(7)
            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_PAD_8 -> if (value > 0) onDrumPadPressed(8) else onDrumPadReleased(8)
            MidiActionType.DRUMPAD_STOP_ALL -> stopDrumPlayback()

            MidiActionType.MASTER_VOLUME -> setTrackVolume(0, (value / 127f).coerceIn(0f, 1f))
            MidiActionType.PANIC_ALL_NOTES_OFF -> panicAllNotesOff()
            MidiActionType.TAP_TEMPO -> handleTapTempo()
            MidiActionType.METRONOME_TOGGLE -> toggleMetronome()
            MidiActionType.TRANSPOSE_UP -> updateTranspose(_uiState.value.transpose + 1)
            MidiActionType.TRANSPOSE_DOWN -> updateTranspose(_uiState.value.transpose - 1)
            MidiActionType.OCTAVE_UP -> updateOctave(1)
            MidiActionType.OCTAVE_DOWN -> updateOctave(-1)
            MidiActionType.OPEN_PATCHES -> openPopup(ActivePopup.SCENE)
            MidiActionType.OPEN_SETTINGS -> openSettings()
        }
    }

}

// Aether Amp: electric-guitar amplifier. Pre-gain -> 2x oversampled tube-style stages -> tone stack -> power stage -> speaker cabinet + mic.
// Params (normalised): 0 Gain 1 Bass 2 Mid 3 Treble 4 Presence 5 Master 6 Channel(0 Clean,.5 Crunch,1 Lead) 7 MicPos 8 MicDist 9 Boost(on>.5) 10 Tremolo(on>.5) 11 Level(-24..+6 dB)
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class AmpFx : public Effect {
 public:
  int paramCount() const override { return 12; }
  void prepare(double sr, int) override {
    sr_ = sr; const double s2 = 2 * sr;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) { up_[i].setLowpass(s2, 0.42 * sr, i ? 1.3066 : 0.5412); dn_[i].setLowpass(s2, 0.42 * sr, i ? 1.3066 : 0.5412); }
    preHp_.setHighpass(sr, 90, 0.7); inter_.setHighpass(s2, 240, 0.7);
    cabHp_.setHighpass(sr, 85, 0.7);
    reset();
  }
  void reset() override {
    for (auto& b : up_) b.reset(); for (auto& b : dn_) b.reset();
    preHp_.reset(); inter_.reset(); cabHp_.reset(); for (auto& b : ts_) b.reset(); for (auto& b : cab_) b.reset();
    for (auto& s : sm_) s.init = false; lfo_ = 0; dirty_ = true; lpF_ = -1;
  }
  void process(float* io, int n) override {
    NoDenormals nd;
    const float cf = smoothCoef(n, sr_, 0.02);
    const float gain = sm_[0].step(p(0), cf), bass = sm_[1].step(p(1), cf), mid = sm_[2].step(p(2), cf), treb = sm_[3].step(p(3), cf), pres = sm_[4].step(p(4), cf);
    const float master = sm_[5].step(p(5), cf), mpos = sm_[6].step(p(7), cf), mdist = sm_[7].step(p(8), cf), lvl = sm_[8].step(p(11), cf);
    const int chan = static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(6) * 2.f));
    const bool boost = p(9) > 0.5f, trem = p(10) > 0.5f;
    if (std::fabs(bass - cB_[0]) > 0.002f || std::fabs(mid - cB_[1]) > 0.002f || std::fabs(treb - cB_[2]) > 0.002f || std::fabs(pres - cB_[3]) > 0.002f || dirty_) {
      cB_[0] = bass; cB_[1] = mid; cB_[2] = treb; cB_[3] = pres;
      ts_[0].setLowShelf(sr_, 120, (bass - 0.5f) * 24.f); ts_[1].setPeaking(sr_, 700, 0.7, (mid - 0.5f) * 20.f);
      ts_[2].setHighShelf(sr_, 3200, (treb - 0.5f) * 24.f); ts_[3].setHighShelf(sr_, 5500, (pres - 0.5f) * 16.f);
    }
    if (std::fabs(mpos - cM_[0]) > 0.002f || std::fabs(mdist - cM_[1]) > 0.002f || dirty_) {
      cM_[0] = mpos; cM_[1] = mdist;
      cab_[0].setPeaking(sr_, 110, 1.0, 3.0); cab_[1].setPeaking(sr_, 450, 1.0, -3.0);
      cab_[2].setPeaking(sr_, 2800, 1.2, 4.0 * (1.0f - mpos)); cab_[3].setLowpass(sr_, 6500.0 - 3300.0 * mpos, 0.707);
      cab_[4].setLowShelf(sr_, 180, 6.0 * (1.0f - mdist)); cab_[5].setLowpass(sr_, 7800.0 - 1500.0 * mpos, 0.6);
    }
    dirty_ = false;
    const float inG = dbToLin(boost ? 9.f : 0.f), outLvl = dbToLin(-24.f + 30.f * lvl);
    float g1, g2 = 1.f, bias = 0.f, comp;
    if (chan == 0) { g1 = 1.f + gain * 5.f; comp = 1.f / (1.f + 0.38f * (g1 - 1.f)); }
    else if (chan == 1) { g1 = 3.f + gain * 22.f; bias = 0.15f; comp = 1.f / (0.9f + 0.1f * g1); }
    else { g1 = 6.f + gain * 38.f; g2 = 3.f + gain * 10.f; bias = 0.15f; comp = 1.f / (0.8f + 0.08f * g1); }
    const float dp = 0.6f + master * 2.5f, pwr = 0.5f + master * 1.5f, trInc = static_cast<float>(5.0 / sr_);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
      const float tg = trem ? 1.f - 0.5f * (0.5f + 0.5f * sineTable().at(lfo_)) : 1.f;
      lfo_ += trInc; if (lfo_ >= 1.f) lfo_ -= 1.f;
      for (int ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {
        float x = preHp_.process(ch, io[2 * i + ch]) * inG, out = 0.f;
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
          float s = k == 0 ? 2.f * x : 0.f;
          s = up_[1].process(ch, up_[0].process(ch, s));
          float y = std::tanh(g1 * s + bias) - std::tanh(bias);
          if (chan == 2) { y = inter_.process(ch, y); y = std::tanh(g2 * y); }
          y = dn_[1].process(ch, dn_[0].process(ch, y));
          if (k == 1) out = y;
        }
        out *= comp * 1.4f;
        for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) out = ts_[b].process(ch, out);
        out = std::tanh(dp * out) / dp * pwr;
        out = cabHp_.process(ch, out);
        for (int b = 0; b < 6; ++b) out = cab_[b].process(ch, out);
        out *= tg * outLvl;
        io[2 * i + ch] = std::tanh(out * 0.9f) / 0.9f;
      }
    }
  }

 private:
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  Biquad up_[2], dn_[2], preHp_, inter_, cabHp_, ts_[4], cab_[6];
  BlockSmoother sm_[9];
  float cB_[4] = {-1, -1, -1, -1}, cM_[2] = {-1, -1}, lfo_ = 0.f, lpF_ = -1.f;
  bool dirty_ = true;
};

}  // namespace aetherfx

// Aether Bass: bass-amp head. Compressor -> (clean DI path + tube preamp + cabinet) blend -> 5-band graphic EQ.
// Params: 0 Drive 1 Comp 2 Blend(DI->amp) 3..7 EQ 63Hz/250Hz/1k/3k/8k (.5 = flat, +-12 dB) 8 Cab(0 1x15,.5 4x10,1 8x10) 9 Level(-24..+6 dB)
// Meters: 0 = gain reduction (dB), 1 = output peak (linear)
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class BassAmp : public Effect {
 public:
  int paramCount() const override { return 10; }
  void prepare(double sr, int) override { sr_ = sr; diHp_.setHighpass(sr, 30, 0.7); preHp_.setHighpass(sr, 40, 0.7); reset(); }
  void reset() override {
    diHp_.reset(); preHp_.reset(); for (auto& b : cab_) b.reset(); for (auto& b : eq_) b.reset();
    env_ = 0.f; gain_ = 1.f; for (auto& s : sm_) s.init = false; cabC_ = -1; eqC_[0] = -9; setMeter(0, 0.f); setMeter(1, 0.f);
  }
  void process(float* io, int n) override {
    NoDenormals nd;
    const float cf = smoothCoef(n, sr_, 0.02);
    const float drive = sm_[0].step(p(0), cf), comp = sm_[1].step(p(1), cf), blend = sm_[2].step(p(2), cf), lvl = sm_[8].step(p(9), cf);
    const int cab = static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(8) * 2.f));
    bool eqDirty = false;
    for (int b = 0; b < 5; ++b) { const float v = sm_[3 + b].step(p(3 + b), cf); if (std::fabs(v - eqC_[b]) > 0.002f) { eqC_[b] = v; eqDirty = true; } }
    if (eqDirty) {
      eq_[0].setLowShelf(sr_, 63, (eqC_[0] - 0.5f) * 24.f); eq_[1].setPeaking(sr_, 250, 1.0, (eqC_[1] - 0.5f) * 24.f);
      eq_[2].setPeaking(sr_, 1000, 1.0, (eqC_[2] - 0.5f) * 24.f); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 3000, 1.0, (eqC_[3] - 0.5f) * 24.f);
      eq_[4].setHighShelf(sr_, 8000, (eqC_[4] - 0.5f) * 24.f);
    }
    if (cab != cabC_) {
      cabC_ = cab;
      if (cab == 0) { cab_[0].setLowpass(sr_, 3800, 0.7); cab_[1].setPeaking(sr_, 70, 1.0, 3.0); cab_[2].setPeaking(sr_, 400, 1.0, -2.0); cab_[3].setHighpass(sr_, 45, 0.7); }
      else if (cab == 1) { cab_[0].setLowpass(sr_, 5500, 0.7); cab_[1].setPeaking(sr_, 90, 1.0, 1.5); cab_[2].setPeaking(sr_, 800, 1.0, 2.0); cab_[3].setHighpass(sr_, 50, 0.7); }
      else { cab_[0].setLowpass(sr_, 6500, 0.7); cab_[1].setPeaking(sr_, 100, 1.0, 2.0); cab_[2].setPeaking(sr_, 600, 0.8, 1.0); cab_[3].setHighpass(sr_, 40, 0.7); }
    }
    const float ratio = 1.5f + comp * 6.5f, thrDb = -18.f, makeup = dbToLin(0.45f * (-thrDb) * (1.f - 1.f / ratio) * comp);
    const float aA = 1.f - std::exp(static_cast<float>(-1.0 / (0.008 * sr_))), aR = 1.f - std::exp(static_cast<float>(-1.0 / (0.12 * sr_)));
    const float g1 = 1.f + drive * 9.f, outG = dbToLin(-24.f + 30.f * lvl), ampComp = 0.7f / (1.f + 0.25f * (g1 - 1.f));
    float grMax = 0.f, pk = 0.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
      const float l = io[2 * i], r = io[2 * i + 1], lv = std::max(std::fabs(l), std::fabs(r));
      env_ += (lv > env_ ? aA : aR) * (lv - env_);
      const float db = linToDb(env_), over = db - thrDb, grDb = over > 0.f ? over * (1.f - 1.f / ratio) * (0.4f + 0.6f * comp) : 0.f;
      const float tg = dbToLin(-grDb); gain_ += (tg - gain_) * 0.01f; grMax = std::max(grMax, grDb);
      for (int ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {
        const float x = io[2 * i + ch] * gain_ * (comp > 0.001f ? makeup : 1.f);
        const float di = diHp_.process(ch, x);
        float a = preHp_.process(ch, x);
        a = (std::tanh(g1 * a + 0.1f) - std::tanh(0.1f)) * ampComp;
        for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) a = cab_[b].process(ch, a);
        float y = di * (1.f - blend) + a * blend * 1.6f;
        for (int b = 0; b < 5; ++b) y = eq_[b].process(ch, y);
        y = std::tanh(y * outG * 0.9f) / 0.9f;
        io[2 * i + ch] = y; pk = std::max(pk, std::fabs(y));
      }
    }
    setMeter(0, grMax); setMeter(1, pk);
  }

 private:
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  Biquad diHp_, preHp_, cab_[4], eq_[5];
  BlockSmoother sm_[9];
  float env_ = 0.f, gain_ = 1.f, eqC_[5] = {-9, -9, -9, -9, -9};
  int cabC_ = -1;
};

}  // namespace aetherfx

### `aetherfx/fx_ceiling.h` — 94 lines

```cpp
// Solar Ceiling: maximizer = drive + lookahead limiter (min-filter then box average => ceiling is guaranteed) + gentle colour.
// lookaheadMs = 0 for tracks (zero latency), ~1 ms for the master (latency is reported).
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class CeilingMaximizer : public Effect {
 public:
  explicit CeilingMaximizer(float lookaheadMs = 0.f) : lookMs_(lookaheadMs) {}
  int paramCount() const override { return 6; }
  void prepare(double sr, int) override {
    sr_ = sr;
    L_ = static_cast<int>(std::lround(lookMs_ * 0.001 * sr));
    dly_[0].init(L_ + 8); dly_[1].init(L_ + 8);
    dryD_[0].init(L_ + 8); dryD_[1].init(L_ + 8);
    reqRing_.assign(L_ + 1, 1.f); minRing_.assign(L_ + 1, 1.f);
    reset();
  }
  void reset() override {
    dly_[0].clear(); dly_[1].clear(); dryD_[0].clear(); dryD_[1].clear();
    std::fill(reqRing_.begin(), reqRing_.end(), 1.f); std::fill(minRing_.begin(), minRing_.end(), 1.f);
    sumMin_ = static_cast<double>(L_ + 1); ri_ = 0; gRel_ = 1.f;
    for (auto& s : sm_) s.init = false;
    setMeter(0, 0.f); setMeter(1, -120.f);
  }
  int latencySamples() const override { return L_; }
  // meter(0): gain reduction dB, meter(1): output peak dB
  void process(float* io, int frames) override {
    const float c = smoothCoef(frames, sr_, 0.03);
    const float amount = sm_[0].step(p(0), c), ceilDb = -6.f * (1.f - sm_[1].step(p(1), c)) * 1.f;
    const float ceil = dbToLin(ceilDb), drive = dbToLin(amount * 18.f);
    const float relMs = 10.f + 490.f * p(2), width = sm_[3].step(p(3), c), mix = sm_[4].step(p(4), c);
    const float outG = dbToLin((p(5) - 0.5f) * 24.f);
    const float relC = std::exp(-1.0f / (0.001f * relMs * static_cast<float>(sr_)));
    const float color = amount * 0.35f, sideG = 1.f + width * 0.6f;
    const float theta = mix * 1.57079632679f, dryG = std::cos(theta), wetG = std::sin(theta);
    const float mixDry = (mix >= 0.999f) ? 0.f : dryG, mixWet = (mix >= 0.999f) ? 1.f : wetG;
    const float invTanh = 1.0f / std::tanh(1.2f);
    float outPk = 0.f, grMax = 0.f;
    for (int n = 0; n < frames; ++n) {
      const float inL = io[2 * n], inR = io[2 * n + 1];
      const float m = 0.5f * (inL + inR), s = 0.5f * (inL - inR) * sideG;
      const float xl = (m + s) * drive, xr = (m - s) * drive;
      const float pk = std::max(std::fabs(xl), std::fabs(xr));
      const float req = pk > ceil ? ceil / pk : 1.f;
      float mn;
      if (L_ == 0) { mn = req; }
      else {
        reqRing_[ri_] = req;
        mn = 1.f;
        for (int k = 0; k <= L_; ++k) mn = std::min(mn, reqRing_[k]);
      }
      float avg;
      if (L_ == 0) { avg = mn; }
      else {
        sumMin_ += mn - minRing_[ri_];
        minRing_[ri_] = mn;
        avg = static_cast<float>(sumMin_ / (L_ + 1));
        if (++ri_ > L_) ri_ = 0;
      }
      gRel_ = std::min(avg, gRel_ + (1.f - gRel_) * (1.f - relC));
      float yl, yr, dl, dr;
      if (L_ == 0) { yl = xl; yr = xr; dl = inL; dr = inR; }
      else {
        dly_[0].write(xl); dly_[1].write(xr); dryD_[0].write(inL); dryD_[1].write(inR);
        yl = dly_[0].readInt(L_ + 1); yr = dly_[1].readInt(L_ + 1); dl = dryD_[0].readInt(L_ + 1); dr = dryD_[1].readInt(L_ + 1);
      }
      yl *= gRel_; yr *= gRel_;
      if (color > 0.f) {
        yl = yl * (1.f - color) + color * ceil * std::tanh(1.2f * yl / ceil) * invTanh;
        yr = yr * (1.f - color) + color * ceil * std::tanh(1.2f * yr / ceil) * invTanh;
      }
      const float oL = (dl * mixDry + yl * mixWet) * outG, oR = (dr * mixDry + yr * mixWet) * outG;
      io[2 * n] = oL; io[2 * n + 1] = oR;
      outPk = std::max(outPk, std::max(std::fabs(oL), std::fabs(oR)));
      grMax = std::max(grMax, -linToDb(gRel_));
    }
    setMeter(0, grMax); setMeter(1, linToDb(outPk));
  }

 private:
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  float lookMs_;
  int L_ = 0, ri_ = 0;
  DelayLine dly_[2], dryD_[2];
  std::vector<float> reqRing_, minRing_;
  double sumMin_ = 1.0;
  float gRel_ = 1.f;
  BlockSmoother sm_[5];
};

}  // namespace aetherfx
```

### `aetherfx/fx_chain.h` — 252 lines

```cpp
// AetherFX chain + mixer strip.
// Threading contract:
//   control thread (UI/JNI): setEffect / clearSlot / setParam / setBypass / applyPreset / collectGarbage / meter*
//   audio thread:            process() only. No locks, no allocation, no logging.
#pragma once
#include <mutex>
#include "fx_amp.h"
#include "fx_bass.h"
#include "fx_ceiling.h"
#include "fx_core.h"
#include "fx_echo.h"
#include "fx_grip.h"
#include "fx_organ.h"
#include "fx_registry.h"
#include "fx_shaper.h"
#include "fx_synth.h"
#include "fx_voices.h"
#include "fx_space.h"
#include "fx_tone.h"

namespace aetherfx {

// Effects (track slots and master). Returns nullptr for ids that are not effects.
inline std::unique_ptr<Effect> makeEffect(int id, bool lookahead = false) {
  switch (id) {
    case FX_SPACE: return std::make_unique<SpaceReverb>();
    case FX_ECHO: return std::make_unique<EchoDelay>();
    case FX_TONE: return std::make_unique<ToneEq>();
    case FX_GRIP: return std::make_unique<GripCompressor>();
    case FX_CEILING: return std::make_unique<CeilingMaximizer>(lookahead ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
    case FX_AMP: return std::make_unique<AmpFx>();
    case FX_BASS: return std::make_unique<BassAmp>();
    case FX_VOICES: return std::make_unique<VoicesFx>();
    default: return nullptr;
  }
}
// Instruments (one per track): shapers modify the soundfont, sources replace it. Returns nullptr for other ids.
inline std::unique_ptr<Effect> makeInstrument(int id, bool = false) {
  switch (id) {
    case FX_PIANO: case FX_SAX: case FX_STRINGS: case FX_GUITAR: case FX_BRASS: return std::make_unique<ShaperFx>(id);
    case FX_ORGAN: return std::make_unique<OrganEngine>();
    case FX_SYNTH: return std::make_unique<SynthEngine>();
    default: return nullptr;
  }
}

class FxChain {
 public:
  static constexpr int kMaxSlots = 8;
  using Factory = std::unique_ptr<Effect> (*)(int, bool);

  explicit FxChain(int slots, bool lookaheadLimiter = false, Factory factory = &makeEffect) : n_(std::min(slots, kMaxSlots)), lookahead_(lookaheadLimiter), factory_(factory) {}
  ~FxChain() {
    for (int i = 0; i < n_; ++i) delete slot_[i].fx.load();
    for (auto& g : garbage_) delete g.fx;
  }
  FxChain(const FxChain&) = delete;
  FxChain& operator=(const FxChain&) = delete;

  // Call before audio starts (and again if the sample rate changes), from the control thread.
  void prepare(double sampleRate, int maxBlock) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(ctl_);
    sr_ = sampleRate; maxBlock_ = maxBlock;
    dry_.assign(static_cast<size_t>(maxBlock) * 2, 0.f);
    for (int i = 0; i < n_; ++i) if (Effect* e = slot_[i].fx.load()) { e->prepare(sr_, maxBlock_); e->reset(); }
  }

  // ---- control thread ----
  // fxId < 0 clears the slot. The new effect starts with its default parameters.
  bool setEffect(int slot, int fxId) {
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= n_) return false;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(ctl_);
    Effect* ne = nullptr;
    if (fxId >= 0) {
      auto e = factory_(fxId, lookahead_);
      if (!e) return false;
      e->prepare(sr_, maxBlock_);
      const auto& pi = info(fxId).params;
      for (size_t i = 0; i < pi.size(); ++i) e->setNorm(static_cast<int>(i), pi[i].def);
      ne = e.release();
    }
    Effect* old = slot_[slot].fx.exchange(ne, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    slot_[slot].id.store(fxId, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (old) garbage_.push_back({old, epoch_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) + 3});
    return true;
  }
  void clearSlot(int slot) { setEffect(slot, -1); }
  void setParam(int slot, int param, float norm) {
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= n_) return;
    if (Effect* e = slot_[slot].fx.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) e->setNorm(param, norm);
  }
  void setBypass(int slot, bool b) { if (slot >= 0 && slot < n_) slot_[slot].bypass.store(b, std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  bool applyPreset(int slot, int presetIdx) {
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= n_) return false;
    const int id = slot_[slot].id.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    Effect* e = slot_[slot].fx.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (id < 0 || !e) return false;
    const auto& ps = info(id).presets;
    if (presetIdx < 0 || presetIdx >= static_cast<int>(ps.size())) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ps[presetIdx].v.size(); ++i) e->setNorm(static_cast<int>(i), ps[presetIdx].v[i]);
    return true;
  }
  int effectId(int slot) const { return (slot >= 0 && slot < n_) ? slot_[slot].id.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) : -1; }
  bool bypassed(int slot) const { return slot_[slot].bypass.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  float meter(int slot, int i) const {
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= n_) return 0.f;
    Effect* e = slot_[slot].fx.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    return e ? e->meter(i) : 0.f;
  }
  // Retired effects are deleted only after the audio thread has run >= 3 more blocks.
  void collectGarbage() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(ctl_);
    const uint64_t now = epoch_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < garbage_.size();) {
      if (now >= garbage_[i].retireAt) { delete garbage_[i].fx; garbage_.erase(garbage_.begin() + i); } else ++i;
    }
  }
  int latencySamples() const {
    int l = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n_; ++i) if (Effect* e = slot_[i].fx.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) l += e->latencySamples();
    return l;
  }
  int slots() const { return n_; }
  Effect* peek(int slot) const { return (slot >= 0 && slot < n_) ? slot_[slot].fx.load(std::memory_order_acquire) : nullptr; }

  /** Ask the audio thread to clear every effect state on its next block. Control thread. */
  void requestPanic() { panic_.store(true, std::memory_order_release); }

  // ---- audio thread ----
  void process(float* io, int frames) {
    epoch_.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    if (panic_.exchange(false, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
      // Panic: drop every tail (delay/reverb loops, filter state) so a runaway
      // feedback cannot keep ringing after the notes are off. Done here, on the
      // audio thread, because reset() is not safe to call while process() runs.
      for (int i = 0; i < n_; ++i) if (Effect* e = slot_[i].fx.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) e->reset();
    }
    if (frames > maxBlock_) frames = maxBlock_;  // never exceed what prepare() sized
    NoDenormals nd;
    const float xfStep = 1.0f / std::max(1.f, 0.010f * static_cast<float>(sr_));
    for (int i = 0; i < n_; ++i) {
      Slot& s = slot_[i];
      Effect* e = s.fx.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
      if (!e) continue;
      const bool byp = s.bypass.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
      const float tgt = byp ? 0.f : 1.f;
      if (s.w <= 0.f && byp) { s.needReset = true; continue; }
      if (s.needReset) { e->reset(); s.needReset = false; }
      if (s.w >= 1.f && !byp) { e->process(io, frames); continue; }
      std::memcpy(dry_.data(), io, sizeof(float) * 2 * frames);
      e->process(io, frames);
      float w = s.w;
      for (int n = 0; n < frames; ++n) {
        w += (tgt > w) ? std::min(xfStep, tgt - w) : -std::min(xfStep, w - tgt);
        io[2 * n] = dry_[2 * n] + (io[2 * n] - dry_[2 * n]) * w;
        io[2 * n + 1] = dry_[2 * n + 1] + (io[2 * n + 1] - dry_[2 * n + 1]) * w;
      }
      s.w = w;
    }
  }

 private:
  struct Slot {
    std::atomic<Effect*> fx{nullptr};
    std::atomic<int> id{-1};
    std::atomic<bool> bypass{false};
    float w = 1.f;          // audio thread only
    bool needReset = false;  // audio thread only
  };
  struct Retired { Effect* fx; uint64_t retireAt; };
  int n_;
  bool lookahead_;
  Factory factory_;
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  int maxBlock_ = 1024;
  Slot slot_[kMaxSlots];
  std::vector<float> dry_;
  std::mutex ctl_;
  std::vector<Retired> garbage_;
  std::atomic<uint64_t> epoch_{0};
  std::atomic<bool> panic_{false};
};

// A mixer strip: FX chain -> fader -> balance -> mute. Gains are smoothed per sample. Used for every track and the master.
class FxStrip {
 public:
  FxStrip(int slots, bool master = false) : chain(slots, master), master_(master) {}
  FxChain chain;

  void prepare(double sr, int maxBlock) { sr_ = sr; chain.prepare(sr, maxBlock); }
  void setGain(float lin) { gain_.store(lin < 0.f ? 0.f : lin, std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  void setPan(float pan) { pan_.store(std::max(-1.f, std::min(1.f, pan)), std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  void setMute(bool m) { mute_.store(m, std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  float peakL() const { return pkL_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  float peakR() const { return pkR_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

  void process(float* io, int frames) {
    chain.process(io, frames);
    const float pan = pan_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const float g = mute_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) ? 0.f : gain_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const float th = (pan + 1.f) * 0.78539816339f;       // constant-power balance
    const float tl = g * std::cos(th) * 1.41421356f, tr = g * std::sin(th) * 1.41421356f;
    if (!init_) { gl_ = tl; gr_ = tr; init_ = true; }
    const float dl = (tl - gl_) / frames, dr = (tr - gr_) / frames;
    float pl = 0.f, pr = 0.f;
    for (int n = 0; n < frames; ++n) {
      gl_ += dl; gr_ += dr;
      float l = io[2 * n] * gl_, r = io[2 * n + 1] * gr_;
      if (master_) {  // final safety: never output NaN or beyond full scale
        if (!(l == l)) l = 0.f; if (!(r == r)) r = 0.f;
        l = std::max(-1.f, std::min(1.f, l)); r = std::max(-1.f, std::min(1.f, r));
      }
      io[2 * n] = l; io[2 * n + 1] = r;
      pl = std::max(pl, std::fabs(l)); pr = std::max(pr, std::fabs(r));
    }
    gl_ = tl; gr_ = tr;
    pkL_.store(pl, std::memory_order_relaxed); pkR_.store(pr, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  }

 private:
  bool master_;
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  std::atomic<float> gain_{1.f}, pan_{0.f}, pkL_{0.f}, pkR_{0.f};
  std::atomic<bool> mute_{false};
  float gl_ = 1.f, gr_ = 1.f;
  bool init_ = false;
};

// One mixer track: [instrument slot] -> [6 effects] -> fader/pan/mute. The track keeps its soundfont at all times:
// a SOURCE (Organ, Synth) only pauses it while selected; a SHAPER modifies it; no instrument = the soundfont as it is.
class TrackStrip {
 public:
  FxChain instrument{1, false, &makeInstrument};
  FxStrip strip{6, false};
  void prepare(double sr, int maxBlock) { instrument.prepare(sr, maxBlock); strip.prepare(sr, maxBlock); }
  bool setInstrument(int id) { return instrument.setEffect(0, id); }  // id < 0: back to the plain soundfont
  int instrumentId() const { return instrument.effectId(0); }
  bool hasSource() const { return kindOf(instrument.effectId(0)) == Kind::Source && !instrument.bypassed(0); }  // engine: skip FluidSynth rendering for this channel
  // note events forwarded to the active source (audio thread)
  void noteOn(int n, int v) { if (SourceFx* s = src()) s->noteOn(n, v); }
  void noteOff(int n) { if (SourceFx* s = src()) s->noteOff(n); }
  void allNotesOff() { if (SourceFx* s = src()) s->allNotesOff(); }
  void pitchBend(float b) { if (SourceFx* s = src()) s->pitchBend(b); }
  void process(float* io, int frames) { instrument.process(io, frames); strip.process(io, frames); }
  void collectGarbage() { instrument.collectGarbage(); strip.chain.collectGarbage(); }

 private:
  SourceFx* src() const { return kindOf(instrument.effectId(0)) == Kind::Source ? static_cast<SourceFx*>(instrument.peek(0)) : nullptr; }
};

}  // namespace aetherfx

// AetherFX core: types and DSP building blocks. Header-only, C++17, no allocation in process().
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
#include <xmmintrin.h>
#endif

namespace aetherfx {

constexpr int kMaxParams = 32;
constexpr double kPi = 3.14159265358979323846;

inline float clamp01(float v) { return v < 0.f ? 0.f : (v > 1.f ? 1.f : v); }
inline float dbToLin(float db) { return std::pow(10.0f, db * 0.05f); }
inline float linToDb(float x) { return 20.0f * std::log10(std::max(x, 1e-9f)); }

// Flush-to-zero / denormals-are-zero for the duration of a scope (audio thread).
class NoDenormals {
 public:
  NoDenormals() {
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
    old_ = _mm_getcsr();
    _mm_setcsr(static_cast<unsigned>(old_) | 0x8040u);
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
    uint64_t r;
    asm volatile("mrs %0, fpcr" : "=r"(r));
    old_ = r;
    asm volatile("msr fpcr, %0" ::"r"(r | (1ull << 24)));
#endif
  }
  ~NoDenormals() {
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
    _mm_setcsr(static_cast<unsigned>(old_));
#elif defined(__aarch64__)
    asm volatile("msr fpcr, %0" ::"r"(old_));
#endif
  }
  NoDenormals(const NoDenormals&) = delete;
  NoDenormals& operator=(const NoDenormals&) = delete;

 private:
  uint64_t old_ = 0;
};

// One-pole smoothing applied once per block (control rate).
struct BlockSmoother {
  float v = 0.f;
  bool init = false;
  float step(float target, float coef) {
    if (!init) { v = target; init = true; }
    v += (target - v) * coef;
    return v;
  }
  void snap(float t) { v = t; init = true; }
};
inline float smoothCoef(int frames, double sr, double tauSec) {
  return 1.0f - std::exp(-static_cast<float>(frames / (sr * tauSec)));
}

// Linear ramp helper for per-sample gains inside a block.
struct Ramp {
  float cur = 0.f;
  bool init = false;
  // returns step to add each sample so that after `frames` samples cur == target
  float begin(float target, int frames) {
    if (!init) { cur = target; init = true; }
    return frames > 0 ? (target - cur) / frames : 0.f;
  }
};

// One-pole low-pass (per channel state held by caller).
struct OnePole {
  float z = 0.f, a = 1.f;
  void setCutoff(double sr, double fc) {
    fc = std::min(fc, sr * 0.45);
    a = 1.0f - std::exp(static_cast<float>(-2.0 * kPi * fc / sr));
  }
  inline float process(float x) { z += a * (x - z); return z; }
  void reset() { z = 0.f; }
};

// RBJ biquad, double precision, transposed direct form II. Two channels share coefficients.
struct Biquad {
  double b0 = 1, b1 = 0, b2 = 0, a1 = 0, a2 = 0;
  double z1[2] = {0, 0}, z2[2] = {0, 0};
  void reset() { z1[0] = z1[1] = z2[0] = z2[1] = 0; }
  inline float process(int ch, float x) {
    double y = b0 * x + z1[ch];
    z1[ch] = b1 * x - a1 * y + z2[ch];
    z2[ch] = b2 * x - a2 * y;
    return static_cast<float>(y);
  }
  void norm(double a0, double nb0, double nb1, double nb2, double na1, double na2) {
    b0 = nb0 / a0; b1 = nb1 / a0; b2 = nb2 / a0; a1 = na1 / a0; a2 = na2 / a0;
  }
  void setPeaking(double sr, double f, double q, double gainDb) {
    f = std::min(f, sr * 0.45);
    double A = std::pow(10.0, gainDb / 40.0), w0 = 2 * kPi * f / sr, c = std::cos(w0), al = std::sin(w0) / (2 * q);
    norm(1 + al / A, 1 + al * A, -2 * c, 1 - al * A, -2 * c, 1 - al / A);
  }
  void setLowShelf(double sr, double f, double gainDb) {  // slope S = 1
    f = std::min(f, sr * 0.45);
    double A = std::pow(10.0, gainDb / 40.0), w0 = 2 * kPi * f / sr, c = std::cos(w0), sA = std::sqrt(A);
    double al = std::sin(w0) / 2 * std::sqrt(2.0);
    norm((A + 1) + (A - 1) * c + 2 * sA * al, A * ((A + 1) - (A - 1) * c + 2 * sA * al),
         2 * A * ((A - 1) - (A + 1) * c), A * ((A + 1) - (A - 1) * c - 2 * sA * al),
         -2 * ((A - 1) + (A + 1) * c), (A + 1) + (A - 1) * c - 2 * sA * al);
  }
  void setHighShelf(double sr, double f, double gainDb) {
    f = std::min(f, sr * 0.45);
    double A = std::pow(10.0, gainDb / 40.0), w0 = 2 * kPi * f / sr, c = std::cos(w0), sA = std::sqrt(A);
    double al = std::sin(w0) / 2 * std::sqrt(2.0);
    norm((A + 1) - (A - 1) * c + 2 * sA * al, A * ((A + 1) + (A - 1) * c + 2 * sA * al),
         -2 * A * ((A - 1) + (A + 1) * c), A * ((A + 1) + (A - 1) * c - 2 * sA * al),
         2 * ((A - 1) - (A + 1) * c), (A + 1) - (A - 1) * c - 2 * sA * al);
  }
  void setLowpass(double sr, double f, double q) {
    f = std::min(f, sr * 0.45); double w0 = 2 * kPi * f / sr, c = std::cos(w0), al = std::sin(w0) / (2 * q);
    norm(1 + al, (1 - c) / 2, 1 - c, (1 - c) / 2, -2 * c, 1 - al);
  }
  void setHighpass(double sr, double f, double q) {
    f = std::min(f, sr * 0.45); double w0 = 2 * kPi * f / sr, c = std::cos(w0), al = std::sin(w0) / (2 * q);
    norm(1 + al, (1 + c) / 2, -(1 + c), (1 + c) / 2, -2 * c, 1 - al);
  }
  void setBandpass(double sr, double f, double q) {  // constant 0 dB peak gain
    f = std::min(f, sr * 0.45); double w0 = 2 * kPi * f / sr, c = std::cos(w0), al = std::sin(w0) / (2 * q);
    norm(1 + al, al, 0, -al, -2 * c, 1 - al);
  }
  void setNotch(double sr, double f, double q) {
    f = std::min(f, sr * 0.45); double w0 = 2 * kPi * f / sr, c = std::cos(w0), al = std::sin(w0) / (2 * q);
    norm(1 + al, 1, -2 * c, 1, -2 * c, 1 - al);
  }
  // magnitude response in dB at frequency f (analytic, for UI curves and tests)
  double magDb(double sr, double f) const {
    double w = 2 * kPi * f / sr, c1 = std::cos(w), s1 = std::sin(w), c2 = std::cos(2 * w), s2 = std::sin(2 * w);
    double nr = b0 + b1 * c1 + b2 * c2, ni = -(b1 * s1 + b2 * s2);
    double dr = 1 + a1 * c1 + a2 * c2, di = -(a1 * s1 + a2 * s2);
    return 10.0 * std::log10((nr * nr + ni * ni) / (dr * dr + di * di));
  }
};

// Circular delay line with linear interpolation. d is in samples (>= 1).
struct DelayLine {
  std::vector<float> buf;
  int mask = 0, w = 0;
  void init(int maxSamples) {
    int n = 1;
    while (n < maxSamples + 4) n <<= 1;
    buf.assign(n, 0.f);
    mask = n - 1;
    w = 0;
  }
  void clear() { std::fill(buf.begin(), buf.end(), 0.f); w = 0; }
  inline void write(float x) { buf[w] = x; w = (w + 1) & mask; }
  inline float read(float d) const {
    float pos = static_cast<float>(w) - d;
    int i0 = static_cast<int>(std::floor(pos));
    float fr = pos - static_cast<float>(i0);
    float a = buf[(i0 - 1) & mask], b = buf[i0 & mask];
    return a + (b - a) * fr;
  }
  inline float readInt(int d) const { return buf[(w - d) & mask]; }
};

// Base class of every effect. Parameters are normalised 0..1 (the same values the UI uses).
class Effect {
 public:
  Effect() { for (auto& t : target_) t.store(0.5f, std::memory_order_relaxed); for (auto& m : meters_) m.store(0.f, std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  virtual ~Effect() = default;
  virtual void prepare(double sampleRate, int maxBlock) = 0;
  virtual void reset() = 0;
  virtual void process(float* interleavedStereo, int frames) = 0;
  virtual int latencySamples() const { return 0; }
  virtual int paramCount() const = 0;

  void setNorm(int i, float v) { if (i >= 0 && i < kMaxParams) target_[i].store(clamp01(v), std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  float getNorm(int i) const { return target_[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  float meter(int i) const { return meters_[i & 3].load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

 protected:
  float p(int i) const { return target_[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
  void setMeter(int i, float v) { meters_[i & 3].store(v, std::memory_order_relaxed); }

 private:
  std::atomic<float> target_[kMaxParams];
  std::atomic<float> meters_[4];
};


// Small deterministic noise source (xorshift32), audio-thread safe.
struct Noise {
  uint32_t s = 0x9E3779B9u;
  inline float next() { s ^= s << 13; s ^= s >> 17; s ^= s << 5; return static_cast<float>(static_cast<int32_t>(s)) * (1.0f / 2147483648.0f); }
};
// Sine table (2048 + 1 entries) for cheap oscillators; phase in [0,1).
struct SineTable {
  float t[2049];
  SineTable() { for (int i = 0; i <= 2048; ++i) t[i] = static_cast<float>(std::sin(2.0 * kPi * i / 2048.0)); }
  inline float at(float ph) const { float x = ph * 2048.0f; int i = static_cast<int>(x); float f = x - i; return t[i] + (t[i + 1] - t[i]) * f; }
};
inline const SineTable& sineTable() { static const SineTable st; return st; }

// Aether Echo: four independent taps (time/level each), cross-fed ping-pong, feedback with tone filter, tape wow.
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class EchoDelay : public Effect {
 public:
  int paramCount() const override { return 12; }
  void prepare(double sr, int) override {
    sr_ = sr;
    for (auto& d : dl_) d.init(static_cast<int>(1.15 * sr) + 16);
    reset();
  }
  void reset() override {
    for (auto& d : dl_) d.clear();
    for (auto& f : fbLp_) f.reset();
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) { tapT_[k] = -1.f; }
    lfo1_ = lfo2_ = 0.f;
    mix_.init = false;
    setMeter(0, 0.f);
  }
  void process(float* io, int frames) override {
    float tgt[4], lvl[4], sumLvl = 0.f;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
      tgt[k] = (10.f + 990.f * p(2 * k)) * 0.001f * static_cast<float>(sr_);
      lvl[k] = p(2 * k + 1);
      sumLvl += lvl[k];
      if (tapT_[k] < 0.f) tapT_[k] = tgt[k];
    }
    const float fb = p(8) * 0.95f / std::max(1.f, sumLvl);
    const float cutoff = 1000.f + 11000.f * p(9);
    for (auto& f : fbLp_) f.setCutoff(sr_, cutoff);
    const float wow = p(10), theta = p(11) * 1.57079632679f;
    const float dryG = std::cos(theta), wetEnd = std::sin(theta);
    const float wetStart = mix_.init ? mix_.cur : wetEnd, wetStep = (wetEnd - wetStart) / frames;
    float wg = wetStart; mix_.cur = wetEnd; mix_.init = true;
    const float w1 = 6.2831853f * 0.6f / static_cast<float>(sr_), w2 = 6.2831853f * 6.3f / static_cast<float>(sr_);
    float peak = 0.f;
    for (int n = 0; n < frames; ++n) {
      wg += wetStep;
      const float inL = io[2 * n], inR = io[2 * n + 1];
      lfo1_ += w1; lfo2_ += w2;
      if (lfo1_ > 6.2831853f) lfo1_ -= 6.2831853f;
      if (lfo2_ > 6.2831853f) lfo2_ -= 6.2831853f;
      const float mod = wow * (std::sin(lfo1_) * 0.0022f + std::sin(lfo2_) * 0.0003f) * static_cast<float>(sr_);
      float oL = 0.f, oR = 0.f;
      for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
        tapT_[k] += std::max(-0.05f, std::min(0.05f, tgt[k] - tapT_[k]));
        const float d = std::max(1.f, tapT_[k] + mod + 3.f);
        const float yl = dl_[0].read(d), yr = dl_[1].read(d);
        if (k & 1) { oL += lvl[k] * yr; oR += lvl[k] * yl; } else { oL += lvl[k] * yl; oR += lvl[k] * yr; }
      }
      const float fL = fbLp_[0].process(oL) * fb, fR = fbLp_[1].process(oR) * fb;
      dl_[0].write(inL + fR);
      dl_[1].write(inR + fL);
      const float outL = inL * dryG + oL * wg, outR = inR * dryG + oR * wg;
      io[2 * n] = outL; io[2 * n + 1] = outR;
      peak = std::max(peak, std::max(std::fabs(outL), std::fabs(outR)));
    }
    setMeter(0, peak);
  }

 private:
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  DelayLine dl_[2];
  OnePole fbLp_[2];
  float tapT_[4] = {-1, -1, -1, -1};
  float lfo1_ = 0.f, lfo2_ = 0.f;
  Ramp mix_;
};

}  // namespace aetherfx

// Iron Grip: feed-forward stereo-linked compressor with soft knee, log-domain smoothing, zero latency.
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"
#include "fx_registry.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class GripCompressor : public Effect {
 public:
  int paramCount() const override { return 6; }
  void prepare(double sr, int) override { sr_ = sr; reset(); }
  void reset() override { env_ = 0.f; setMeter(0, 0.f); setMeter(1, -120.f); setMeter(2, -120.f); }
  // meter(0): gain reduction in dB (>= 0), meter(1): input peak dB, meter(2): output peak dB
  void process(float* io, int frames) override {
    const float thr = -60.f + 60.f * p(0);
    const float ratio = kRatios[static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(1) * 5.f))];
    const float atkMs = 0.1f + 99.9f * p(2), relMs = 10.f + 990.f * p(3);
    const float knee = 24.f * p(4), makeup = 24.f * p(5);
    const float aA = std::exp(-1.0f / (0.001f * atkMs * static_cast<float>(sr_)));
    const float aR = std::exp(-1.0f / (0.001f * relMs * static_cast<float>(sr_)));
    const float slope = 1.0f / ratio - 1.0f;
    float inPk = 0.f, outPk = 0.f, grMax = 0.f;
    for (int n = 0; n < frames; ++n) {
      float l = io[2 * n], r = io[2 * n + 1];
      const float pk = std::max(std::fabs(l), std::fabs(r));
      inPk = std::max(inPk, pk);
      const float x = linToDb(pk);
      const float over = x - thr;
      float gr;  // negative or zero
      if (2.f * over < -knee) gr = 0.f;
      else if (2.f * std::fabs(over) <= knee && knee > 0.f) { const float t = over + knee * 0.5f; gr = slope * t * t / (2.f * knee); }
      else gr = slope * over;
      if (gr < env_) env_ = aA * env_ + (1.f - aA) * gr; else env_ = aR * env_ + (1.f - aR) * gr;
      grMax = std::max(grMax, -env_);
      const float g = std::pow(10.0f, (env_ + makeup) * 0.05f);
      l *= g; r *= g;
      io[2 * n] = l; io[2 * n + 1] = r;
      outPk = std::max(outPk, std::max(std::fabs(l), std::fabs(r)));
    }
    setMeter(0, grMax); setMeter(1, linToDb(inPk)); setMeter(2, linToDb(outPk));
  }

 private:
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  float env_ = 0.f;
};

}  // namespace aetherfx
```

// Soundfont / instrument compatibility. Used to show the big "this doesn't look like a saxophone" warning. Never blocks.
#pragma once
#include <cctype>
#include <string>

namespace aetherfx {

enum class Match { Ok, Weak, Mismatch };

inline bool containsAny(const std::string& hay, const char* const* words, int n) {
  std::string h; for (char c : hay) h.push_back(static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))));
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) if (h.find(words[i]) != std::string::npos) return true;
  return false;
}
// fxId: 5 Piano, 7 Sax, 8 Strings, 9 Guitar, 12 Brass. gmProgram: 0..127 (-1 unknown). bank: 128 = drum kit (-1 unknown).
// The preset NAME is checked first (most reliable), then the General MIDI program family, then the played key range.
inline Match matchShaper(int fxId, const std::string& presetName, int gmProgram, int bank, int keyLow = -1, int keyHigh = -1) {
  static const char* kPiano[] = {"piano", "keys", "clav", "harpsichord", "rhodes", "wurli", "epiano", "e.piano"};
  static const char* kSax[] = {"sax", "reed", "clarinet", "oboe", "bassoon"};
  static const char* kStr[] = {"violin", "viola", "cello", "string", "orchestra", "fiddle", "bass section", "ensemble"};
  static const char* kGtr[] = {"guitar", "gtr", "strat", "telecaster", "les paul", "nylon", "banjo", "ukulele", "mandolin"};
  static const char* kBrass[] = {"trumpet", "trombone", "horn", "brass", "tuba", "cornet", "flugel", "bugle"};
  static const char* kOther[][9] = {{"drum", "kit", "percussion", "perc", "snare", "kick"}, {}};
  const char* const* words = kPiano; int nw = 8; int lo[2] = {0, 7}, lo2[2] = {16, 23};
  switch (fxId) {
    case 7: words = kSax; nw = 5; lo[0] = 64; lo[1] = 71; lo2[0] = lo2[1] = -1; break;
    case 8: words = kStr; nw = 8; lo[0] = 40; lo[1] = 51; lo2[0] = lo2[1] = -1; break;
    case 9: words = kGtr; nw = 9; lo[0] = 24; lo[1] = 31; lo2[0] = lo2[1] = -1; break;
    case 12: words = kBrass; nw = 8; lo[0] = 56; lo[1] = 63; lo2[0] = lo2[1] = -1; break;
    default: break;
  }
  if (bank == 128 || containsAny(presetName, kOther[0], 6)) return Match::Mismatch;
  if (containsAny(presetName, words, nw)) return Match::Ok;
  if (gmProgram >= 0) {
    if ((gmProgram >= lo[0] && gmProgram <= lo[1]) || (lo2[0] >= 0 && gmProgram >= lo2[0] && gmProgram <= lo2[1])) return Match::Ok;
    return Match::Mismatch;
  }
  if (keyLow >= 0 && keyHigh >= 0 && keyHigh - keyLow < 12) return Match::Mismatch;  // a one-octave sound is not an instrument range
  return Match::Weak;
}

}  // namespace aetherfx
