```cpp
// FxMixer: everything the audio engine needs, in one object. Control thread: set*/apply* calls. Audio thread: process*/note*.
// Strips: 0..7 soundfont tracks, 8 drum channel (soundfont ch 8), 9 tonic pad (soundfont ch 9), 10 drum-pad sampler, kMaster.
// Instruments (shapers and sources) are allowed on strips 0..7 only. Effects: 6 slots per strip, 8 on the master. No instrument on the master.
#pragma once
#include "fx_chain.h"

namespace aetherfx {

struct GenUpdate { GenSet gens; PerfSet perf; bool valid = false; };

class FxMixer {
 public:
  static constexpr int kStrips = 11, kMaster = 15;
  static bool instrumentAllowed(int strip) { return strip >= 0 && strip <= 7; }

  void prepare(double sr, int maxBlock) { for (auto& t : tracks_) t.prepare(sr, maxBlock); master_.prepare(sr, maxBlock); }

  // ---- control thread ----
  bool setInstrument(int strip, int id) {
    if (!instrumentAllowed(strip)) return false;
    if (id >= 0 && kindOf(id) == Kind::Effect) return false;
    const bool ok = tracks_[strip].setInstrument(id);
    if (ok) recount();
    return ok;
  }
  bool setEffect(int strip, int slot, int id) {
    if (id >= 0 && kindOf(id) != Kind::Effect) return false;
    FxChain* c = chain(strip);
    if (!c) return false;
    const bool ok = c->setEffect(slot, id);
    if (ok) recount();
    return ok;
  }

  /**
   * True as soon as one strip carries an instrument or an effect. The engine uses
   * it to keep the (much heavier) multi-channel FX render dormant until the user
   * actually places something: until then the legacy stereo mix is audibly
   * equivalent and far cheaper, and the FX path also skips the surface FX chains.
   * Without this gate every note paid for 16 output groups and 11 strip chains,
   * which is what made the audio stutter continuously once the engine started.
   */
  bool hasActiveWork() const { return active_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) > 0; }

  /**
   * True when the strip carries an instrument or at least one effect. A strip with
   * neither is a straight pass-through: the render folds its input directly into
   * the mix instead of copying it into a strip buffer, running an empty chain and
   * adding it back. That extra round trip per channel was what made the FX path
   * cost scale with the channel count rather than with the work actually placed,
   * so the audio got heavier as soon as one effect existed anywhere.
   */
  bool stripActive(int strip) const {
    if (strip >= 0 && strip < 8) {
      if (tracks_[strip].instrumentId() >= 0) return true;
    } else if (!(strip >= 8 && strip < kStrips)) {
      return true;  // master and out-of-range strips are always processed
    }
    const FxChain& c = tracks_[strip].strip.chain;
    for (int s = 0; s < c.slots(); ++s) if (c.effectId(s) >= 0) return true;
    return false;
  }
  void setParam(int strip, int slot, int param, float norm) { if (FxChain* c = chain(strip)) c->setParam(slot, param, norm); }
  void setBypass(int strip, int slot, bool b) { if (FxChain* c = chain(strip)) c->setBypass(slot, b); }
  bool applyPreset(int strip, int slot, int preset) { FxChain* c = chain(strip); return c ? c->applyPreset(slot, preset) : false; }
  void setInstrumentParam(int strip, int param, float norm) { if (instrumentAllowed(strip)) tracks_[strip].instrument.setParam(0, param, norm); }
  bool applyInstrumentPreset(int strip, int preset) { return instrumentAllowed(strip) ? tracks_[strip].instrument.applyPreset(0, preset) : false; }
  void setInstrumentBypass(int strip, bool b) { if (instrumentAllowed(strip)) tracks_[strip].instrument.setBypass(0, b); }
  void setGain(int strip, float lin) { if (FxStrip* s = fxStrip(strip)) s->setGain(lin); }
  void setPan(int strip, float pan) { if (FxStrip* s = fxStrip(strip)) s->setPan(pan); }
  void setMute(int strip, bool m) { if (FxStrip* s = fxStrip(strip)) s->setMute(m); }
  // Generator offsets for a SHAPER on this strip, computed from its current parameters. Apply with fluid_synth_set_gen(synth, channel, gen, value)
  // on the control thread after every parameter or preset change (diff against the last applied values), and perf options in the note handler.
  GenUpdate instrumentGens(int strip) const {
    GenUpdate u;
    if (!instrumentAllowed(strip)) return u;
    const int id = tracks_[strip].instrumentId();
    if (id < 0 || kindOf(id) != Kind::Shaper) return u;
    Effect* e = tracks_[strip].instrument.peek(0); if (!e) return u;
    float v[kMaxParams]; for (int i = 0; i < kMaxParams; ++i) v[i] = e->getNorm(i);
    computeGens(id, v, u.gens, u.perf); u.valid = true; return u;
  }
  int instrumentId(int strip) const { return instrumentAllowed(strip) ? tracks_[strip].instrumentId() : -1; }
  int effectId(int strip, int slot) const { const FxChain* c = chainC(strip); return c ? c->effectId(slot) : -1; }
  float meter(int strip, int slot, int i) const { const FxChain* c = chainC(strip); return c ? c->meter(slot, i) : 0.f; }
  float peakL(int strip) const { const FxStrip* s = fxStripC(strip); return s ? s->peakL() : 0.f; }
  float peakR(int strip) const { const FxStrip* s = fxStripC(strip); return s ? s->peakR() : 0.f; }
  void collectGarbage() { for (auto& t : tracks_) t.collectGarbage(); master_.chain.collectGarbage(); }

  /** Panic: clears every effect tail (delay/reverb loops, filter state) on all strips. */
  void requestPanic() {
    for (auto& t : tracks_) { t.instrument.requestPanic(); t.strip.chain.requestPanic(); }
    master_.chain.requestPanic();
  }
  // true when the track's soundfont channel can be skipped in the render loop (a source is selected)
  bool soundfontPaused(int strip) const { return instrumentAllowed(strip) && tracks_[strip].hasSource(); }

  // ---- audio thread ----
  void noteOn(int strip, int note, int vel) { if (instrumentAllowed(strip)) tracks_[strip].noteOn(note, vel); }
  void noteOff(int strip, int note) { if (instrumentAllowed(strip)) tracks_[strip].noteOff(note); }
  void allNotesOff(int strip) { if (instrumentAllowed(strip)) tracks_[strip].allNotesOff(); }
  void pitchBend(int strip, float b) { if (instrumentAllowed(strip)) tracks_[strip].pitchBend(b); }
  // Interleaved stereo. For a source track the input (soundfont) is ignored and replaced by the source.
  void processStrip(int strip, float* io, int frames) {
    if (strip >= 0 && strip <= 7) tracks_[strip].process(io, frames);
    else if (strip >= 8 && strip < kStrips) tracks_[strip].strip.process(io, frames);
  }
  void processMaster(float* io, int frames) { master_.process(io, frames); }

 private:
  FxChain* chain(int s) { return s == kMaster ? &master_.chain : (s >= 0 && s < kStrips ? &tracks_[s].strip.chain : nullptr); }
  const FxChain* chainC(int s) const { return s == kMaster ? &master_.chain : (s >= 0 && s < kStrips ? &tracks_[s].strip.chain : nullptr); }
  FxStrip* fxStrip(int s) { return s == kMaster ? &master_ : (s >= 0 && s < kStrips ? &tracks_[s].strip : nullptr); }
  const FxStrip* fxStripC(int s) const { return s == kMaster ? &master_ : (s >= 0 && s < kStrips ? &tracks_[s].strip : nullptr); }
  /** Recounts every occupied slot after a placement. Control thread only, cheap. */
  void recount() {
    int n = 0;
    for (auto& t : tracks_) {
      if (t.instrumentId() >= 0) n++;
      for (int s = 0; s < t.strip.chain.slots(); ++s) if (t.strip.chain.effectId(s) >= 0) n++;
    }
    for (int s = 0; s < master_.chain.slots(); ++s) if (master_.chain.effectId(s) >= 0) n++;
    active_.store(n, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  }
  TrackStrip tracks_[kStrips];
  FxStrip master_{8, true};
  std::atomic<int> active_{0};
};

}  // namespace aetherfx
```

```cpp
// Aether Organ: tonewheel organ engine (additive, 91-wheel style), two drawbar manuals, percussion, key click, vibrato/chorus, rotary speaker, drive.
// Params (31): 0..8 Upper drawbars 16' 5 1/3' 8' 4' 2 2/3' 2' 1 3/5' 1 1/3' 1' (0..8 steps) | 9..17 Lower | 18 PercOn 19 PercSoft 20 PercFast 21 Perc3rd
// 22 VibType (0..5 = V1 V2 V3 C1 C2 C3, value*5) 23 VibUpper 24 VibLower | 25 Rotary (0 Stop, .5 Slow, 1 Fast) | 26 Click 27 Tone 28 Drive 29 Space 30 Level
// Keys below the split (MIDI 60) play the LOWER manual, the others the UPPER manual.
#pragma once
#include "fx_source.h"
#include "fx_space.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class OrganEngine : public SourceFx {
 public:
  static constexpr int kSplit = 60;
  int paramCount() const override { return 31; }
  void prepare(double sr, int maxBlock) override {
    sr_ = sr;
    for (int w = 0; w < 128; ++w) inc_[w] = static_cast<float>(440.0 * std::pow(2.0, (w - 69) / 12.0) / sr);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) { dlH_[i].init(static_cast<int>(0.01 * sr) + 8); dlD_[i].init(static_cast<int>(0.01 * sr) + 8); }
    dlV_.init(static_cast<int>(0.02 * sr) + 8);
    rev_.prepare(sr, maxBlock); for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) rev_.setNorm(i, kRevDef[i]);
    xo_[0].setLowpass(sr, 800, 0.5); xo_[1].setLowpass(sr, 800, 0.5);
    reset();
  }
  void reset() override {
    std::memset(amp_, 0, sizeof(amp_)); std::memset(ph_, 0, sizeof(ph_)); std::memset(held_, 0, sizeof(held_)); heldCount_ = 0;
    percEnv_ = 0.f; clickEnv_ = 0.f; hornSp_ = drumSp_ = 0.f; hornPh_ = drumPh_ = 0.f; vibPh_ = 0.f;
    for (auto& d : dlH_) d.clear(); for (auto& d : dlD_) d.clear(); dlV_.clear(); rev_.reset(); for (auto& b : xo_) b.reset(); tone_.reset();
    for (auto& s : sm_) s.init = false;
  }
  void noteOn(int note, int vel) override {
    if (note < 0 || note > 127) return;
    if (vel <= 0) { noteOff(note); return; }
    if (heldCount_ == 0) percEnv_ = 1.f;  // single trigger, like the hardware
    if (!held_[note]) { held_[note] = true; ++heldCount_; }
    clickEnv_ = 1.f;
  }
  void noteOff(int note) override { if (note >= 0 && note < 128 && held_[note]) { held_[note] = false; --heldCount_; } }
  void allNotesOff() override { std::memset(held_, 0, sizeof(held_)); heldCount_ = 0; }

  void process(float* io, int n) override {
    NoDenormals nd;
    const float cf = smoothCoef(n, sr_, 0.02);
    const float click = sm_[0].step(p(26), cf), tone = sm_[1].step(p(27), cf), drive = sm_[2].step(p(28), cf), space = sm_[3].step(p(29), cf), lvl = sm_[4].step(p(30), cf);
    int dbU[9], dbL[9];
    for (int j = 0; j < 9; ++j) { dbU[j] = static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(j) * 8.f)); dbL[j] = static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(9 + j) * 8.f)); }
    const bool percOn = p(18) > 0.5f, percSoft = p(19) > 0.5f, percFast = p(20) > 0.5f, perc3 = p(21) > 0.5f;
    const int vibType = static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(22) * 5.f)), vibOn = (p(23) > 0.5f || p(24) > 0.5f) ? 1 : 0;
    const int rot = static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(25) * 2.f));
    static const int kOff[9] = {-12, 7, 0, 12, 19, 24, 28, 31, 36};
    // target amplitude per wheel from the held keys (recomputed per block)
    std::memset(tw_, 0, sizeof(tw_)); std::memset(pw_, 0, sizeof(pw_));
    for (int k = 0; k < 128; ++k) {
      if (!held_[k]) continue;
      const bool upper = k >= kSplit; const int* db = upper ? dbU : dbL;
      for (int j = 0; j < 9; ++j) {
        if (upper && percOn && j == 8) continue;  // percussion cuts the 1' drawbar
        if (db[j] <= 0) continue;
        tw_[fold(k + kOff[j])] += drawAmp(db[j]);
      }
      if (upper && percOn) pw_[fold(k + (perc3 ? 19 : 12))] += percSoft ? 0.03f : 0.06f;
    }
    int na = 0;
    for (int w = 0; w < 128; ++w) if (amp_[w] > 1e-6f || tw_[w] > 0.f || pw_[w] > 0.f) act_[na++] = w;
    const float aC = 1.f - std::exp(static_cast<float>(-1.0 / (0.004 * sr_)));
    const float percDec = std::exp(static_cast<float>(-1.0 / ((percFast ? 0.18 : 0.6) * sr_))), clickDec = std::exp(static_cast<float>(-1.0 / (0.003 * sr_)));
    const float g = 1.f + drive * 5.f, post = 1.f + drive * 0.5f;
    static const float vdepth[3] = {0.25f, 0.5f, 0.9f};
    const float vd = vdepth[vibType % 3] * 0.001f * static_cast<float>(sr_);
    const float hornT = rot == 0 ? 0.f : (rot == 1 ? 0.8f : 6.7f), drumT = rot == 0 ? 0.f : (rot == 1 ? 0.7f : 5.9f);
    const float aH = 1.f - std::exp(static_cast<float>(-1.0 / (0.7 * sr_))), aD = 1.f - std::exp(static_cast<float>(-1.0 / (2.5 * sr_)));

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
      float s = 0.f;
      for (int q = 0; q < na; ++q) {
        const int w = act_[q];
        amp_[w] += (tw_[w] - amp_[w]) * aC;
        s += (amp_[w] + pw_[w] * percEnv_) * sineTable().at(ph_[w]);
        ph_[w] += inc_[w]; if (ph_[w] >= 1.f) ph_[w] -= 1.f;
      }
      percEnv_ *= percDec;
      if (clickEnv_ > 1e-4f) { s += noise_.next() * clickEnv_ * click * 0.25f; clickEnv_ *= clickDec; }
      s = std::tanh(g * s) / g * post;
      if (vibOn) {  // scanner vibrato (V) / chorus (C)
        dlV_.write(s);
        const float d = 2.f + vd * (0.5f + 0.5f * sineTable().at(vibPh_)); vibPh_ += static_cast<float>(6.8 / sr_); if (vibPh_ >= 1.f) vibPh_ -= 1.f;
        const float v = dlV_.read(d); s = vibType >= 3 ? 0.5f * (s + v) : v;
      }
      hornSp_ += (hornT - hornSp_) * aH; drumSp_ += (drumT - drumSp_) * aD;
      hornPh_ += hornSp_ / static_cast<float>(sr_); if (hornPh_ >= 1.f) hornPh_ -= 1.f;
      drumPh_ += drumSp_ / static_cast<float>(sr_); if (drumPh_ >= 1.f) drumPh_ -= 1.f;
      const float lo = xo_[1].process(0, xo_[0].process(0, s)), hi = s - lo;
      const float dsH = std::min(1.f, hornSp_ * 2.f), dsD = std::min(1.f, drumSp_ * 2.f);
      float out[2];
      for (int ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {
        const float sh = sineTable().at(std::fmod(hornPh_ + 0.25f * ch, 1.f)), sd = sineTable().at(std::fmod(drumPh_ + 0.5f * ch, 1.f));
        dlH_[ch].write(hi); dlD_[ch].write(lo);

        const float d = dlD_[ch].read(2.f + dsD * 0.0004f * static_cast<float>(sr_) * (0.5f + 0.5f * sd)) * (1.f + 0.25f * dsD * sd);

      io[2 * i] = out[0]; io[2 * i + 1] = out[1];
    }
    if (space > 0.01f) rev_.process(io, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) io[i] = std::tanh(io[i] * 0.9f) / 0.9f;

  }
  int activeWheels() const { return static_cast<int>(meter(0)); }

 private:
  static int fold(int idx) { while (idx > 108) idx -= 12; while (idx < 0) idx += 12; return idx; }
  static float drawAmp(int d) { return 0.035f * std::pow(10.f, -3.f * (8 - d) / 20.f); }  // 3 dB per drawbar step
  static constexpr float kRevDef[7] = {0.55f, 0.45f, 0.12f, 0.45f, 0.8f, 0.3f, 0.5f};
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  float inc_[128], amp_[128], ph_[128], tw_[128], pw_[128]; int act_[128]; bool held_[128]; int heldCount_ = 0;
  float percEnv_ = 0.f, clickEnv_ = 0.f, hornSp_ = 0.f, drumSp_ = 0.f, hornPh_ = 0.f, drumPh_ = 0.f, vibPh_ = 0.f;
  DelayLine dlH_[2], dlD_[2], dlV_; SpaceReverb rev_; Biquad xo_[2], tone_; Noise noise_; BlockSmoother sm_[5];
};

}  // namespace aetherfx
```

```cpp
// AetherFX registry: ids, parameter descriptors (units, ranges) and presets. Values mirror the UI mock-up.
#pragma once
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

namespace aetherfx {

enum FxId { FX_SPACE = 0, FX_ECHO = 1, FX_TONE = 2, FX_GRIP = 3, FX_CEILING = 4,
  FX_PIANO = 5, FX_ORGAN = 6, FX_SAX = 7, FX_STRINGS = 8, FX_GUITAR = 9, FX_AMP = 10, FX_BASS = 11, FX_BRASS = 12, FX_VOICES = 13, FX_SYNTH = 14, FX_COUNT = 15 };
// Effects live in the 6 track slots (8 on the master). Shapers modify the track's soundfont. Sources replace the soundfont. One instrument (shaper or source) per track; none on the master.
enum class Kind { Effect, Shaper, Source };
inline Kind kindOf(int id) { return (id == FX_ORGAN || id == FX_SYNTH) ? Kind::Source : (id == FX_PIANO || id == FX_SAX || id == FX_STRINGS || id == FX_GUITAR || id == FX_BRASS) ? Kind::Shaper : Kind::Effect; }
enum class Curve { Linear, FreqLog, RatioStep };

struct ParamDesc { const char* name; float min, max; const char* unit; int decimals; float def; Curve curve; bool ui = false; };  // ui = visual only, not sent to the audio engine
struct Preset { const char* name; std::vector<float> v; };
struct EffectInfo { const char* name; const char* type; std::vector<ParamDesc> params; std::vector<Preset> presets; };

constexpr float kRatios[6] = {1.5f, 2.f, 3.f, 4.f, 8.f, 20.f};

inline float toReal(const ParamDesc& d, float norm) {
  switch (d.curve) {
    case Curve::FreqLog: return 20.f * std::pow(1000.f, norm);
    case Curve::RatioStep: return kRatios[static_cast<int>(std::lround(norm * 5.f))];
    default: return d.min + (d.max - d.min) * norm;
  }
}

inline const EffectInfo& info(int id) {
  static const std::vector<EffectInfo> all = [] {
    std::vector<EffectInfo> v(FX_COUNT);
    using C = Curve;
    v[FX_SPACE] = {"Aether Space", "Reverb",
      {{"Size", 0, 100, "%", 0, .62f, C::Linear}, {"Decay", .4f, 8, "s", 1, .7f, C::Linear}, {"Pre-delay", 0, 120, "ms", 0, .2f, C::Linear},
       {"Damp", 1, 12, "kHz", 1, .45f, C::Linear}, {"Width", 0, 100, "%", 0, .8f, C::Linear}, {"Mix", 0, 100, "%", 0, .35f, C::Linear},
       {"Diffuse", 0, 100, "%", 0, .5f, C::Linear}},
      {{"Hall", {.62f, .7f, .2f, .45f, .8f, .35f, .5f}}, {"Plate", {.4f, .5f, .1f, .7f, .9f, .3f, .7f}}, {"Room", {.25f, .3f, .05f, .5f, .6f, .25f, .3f}},
       {"Cathedral", {.95f, .95f, .35f, .3f, 1, .45f, .8f}}, {"Shimmer", {.7f, .85f, .25f, .2f, 1, .5f, .9f}}, {"Chamber", {.35f, .4f, .08f, .55f, .7f, .28f, .45f}},
       {"Bloom", {.8f, .8f, .3f, .35f, .95f, .42f, 1}}, {"Infinite", {1, 1, .4f, .25f, 1, .6f, .95f}}}};
    const float dt[8] = {.15f, .9f, .3f, .7f, .45f, .5f, .6f, .3f};
    std::vector<ParamDesc> ep;
    static const char* tn[4] = {"Time 1", "Time 2", "Time 3", "Time 4"}; static const char* ln[4] = {"Level 1", "Level 2", "Level 3", "Level 4"};
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) { ep.push_back({tn[k], 10, 1000, "ms", 0, dt[2 * k], C::Linear}); ep.push_back({ln[k], 0, 100, "%", 0, dt[2 * k + 1], C::Linear}); }
    ep.push_back({"Feedback", 0, 95, "%", 0, .42f, C::Linear}); ep.push_back({"Tone", 1, 12, "kHz", 1, .6f, C::Linear});
    ep.push_back({"Wow", 0, 100, "%", 0, .2f, C::Linear}); ep.push_back({"Mix", 0, 100, "%", 0, .28f, C::Linear});
```

```cpp
// Aether instrument shapers: Piano(5) Sax(7) Strings(8) Guitar(9) Brass(12). They SHAPE the soundfont loaded on the track:
//  - computeGens(): SoundFont generator offsets to apply on the track's MIDI channel (control thread, fluid_synth_set_gen) + note-level options.
//  - ShaperFx::process(): the internal audio part (tone, body, ensemble, saturation, mutes, reverb, level).
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"
#include "fx_space.h"

namespace aetherfx {

enum SfGen { GEN_VIBLFOTOPITCH = 6, GEN_FILTERFC = 8, GEN_FILTERQ = 9, GEN_VIBLFOFREQ = 24, GEN_VOLENVATTACK = 34, GEN_VOLENVDECAY = 36, GEN_VOLENVRELEASE = 38 };
struct GenSet { int n = 0; int gen[12]; float val[12]; void add(int g, float v) { if (n < 12) { gen[n] = g; val[n] = v; ++n; } } };
struct PerfSet { float strumSpreadMs = 0.f; int bendSemis = 2; };  // note-level options handled by the audio engine

enum ShaperId { SH_PIANO = 5, SH_SAX = 7, SH_STRINGS = 8, SH_GUITAR = 9, SH_BRASS = 12 };
struct ShaperMap { int count, tone, body, space, level; };
inline ShaperMap shaperMap(int id) {
  switch (id) {
    case SH_PIANO: return {9, 5, 6, 7, 8};
    case SH_SAX: return {9, 5, 6, 7, 8};
    case SH_STRINGS: return {10, 6, 7, 8, 9};
    case SH_GUITAR: return {11, 7, 8, 9, 10};
    default: return {9, 5, 6, 7, 8};  // brass
  }
}
inline float clampf(float v, float lo, float hi) { return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v); }

inline void computeGens(int id, const float* v, GenSet& g, PerfSet& perf) {
  g.n = 0; perf = PerfSet();
  auto fc = [&](float cents) { g.add(GEN_FILTERFC, clampf(cents, -3600.f, 3600.f)); };
  switch (id) {
    case SH_PIANO:  // Felt Lid Pedal Room Width Tone Body Space Level
      fc((0.5f - v[0]) * 1800.f + (v[1] - 0.5f) * 1200.f + (v[5] - 0.5f) * 1800.f);
      g.add(GEN_VOLENVRELEASE, v[2] * 1200.f); g.add(GEN_VOLENVDECAY, v[2] * 600.f);
      break;
    case SH_SAX:  // Breath Reed Growl Vibrato Rate Tone Body Space Level
      fc((v[1] - 0.5f) * 2400.f + (v[5] - 0.5f) * 1800.f); g.add(GEN_FILTERQ, v[1] * 40.f);
      g.add(GEN_VOLENVATTACK, -(v[0] - 0.5f) * 400.f); g.add(GEN_VIBLFOTOPITCH, v[3] * 60.f);
      g.add(GEN_VIBLFOFREQ, 1200.f * std::log2((3.f + v[4] * 5.f) / 8.176f));
      break;
    case SH_STRINGS:  // Pressure Speed Motion Morph Time Color(UI only) Tone Body Space Level
      fc((v[0] - 0.5f) * 1800.f + (v[6] - 0.5f) * 1800.f);
      g.add(GEN_VOLENVATTACK, (0.5f - v[1]) * 1500.f + (v[4] - 0.5f) * 1500.f); g.add(GEN_VOLENVRELEASE, (v[4] - 0.5f) * 2000.f);
      g.add(GEN_VIBLFOTOPITCH, v[2] * 40.f);
      break;
    case SH_GUITAR:  // Body Pick Strum Mute Bend Pickup Finish(UI only) Tone Resonance Space Level
      fc((v[1] - 0.5f) * 1500.f + (v[5] - 0.5f) * 1500.f + (v[7] - 0.5f) * 1800.f - v[3] * 2000.f);
      g.add(GEN_VOLENVATTACK, -(v[1] - 0.5f) * 400.f); g.add(GEN_VOLENVDECAY, -v[3] * 1200.f); g.add(GEN_VOLENVRELEASE, -v[3] * 1800.f);
      perf.strumSpreadMs = v[2] * 60.f; perf.bendSemis = 2 + static_cast<int>(std::lround(v[4] * 10.f));
      break;
    default:  // Brass: Lips Bite Vibrato Section Mute Tone Body Space Level
      fc((v[0] - 0.5f) * 2400.f + (v[5] - 0.5f) * 1800.f);
      g.add(GEN_VOLENVATTACK, -(v[1] - 0.5f) * 500.f); g.add(GEN_VIBLFOTOPITCH, v[2] * 50.f);
      break;
  }
}

class ShaperFx : public Effect {
 public:
  explicit ShaperFx(int id) : id_(id), map_(shaperMap(id)) {}
  int paramCount() const override { return map_.count; }
  void prepare(double sr, int maxBlock) override {
    sr_ = sr; for (auto& d : dl_) d.init(static_cast<int>(0.06 * sr) + 8);
    rev_.prepare(sr, maxBlock); for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) rev_.setNorm(i, kRevDef[i]); reset();
  }
  void reset() override {
    for (auto& b : eq_) b.reset(); for (auto& d : dl_) d.clear(); rev_.reset(); for (auto& s : sm_) s.init = false;
    env_ = 0.f; ph_ = 0.f; for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) lfo_[k] = k / 6.f; cfgKey_ = -1;
  }
  void process(float* io, int n) override {
    NoDenormals nd;
    const float cf = smoothCoef(n, sr_, 0.03);
    const float tone = sm_[0].step(p(map_.tone), cf), body = sm_[1].step(p(map_.body), cf), space = sm_[2].step(p(map_.space), cf), lvl = sm_[3].step(p(map_.level), cf);
    float sat = 0.f, flutter = 0.f, breath = 0.f, wide = 1.f, ensMix = 0.f; int ensN = 0, mute = 0, gtrBody = 0;
    float roomAdd = 0.f;
    switch (id_) {
      case SH_PIANO: wide = 0.4f + 1.2f * p(4); roomAdd = 0.3f * p(3); break;
      case SH_SAX: sat = p(2); flutter = p(2) * 0.3f; breath = p(0); break;
      case SH_STRINGS: ensN = 1 + static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(3) * 5.f)); ensMix = std::min(1.f, p(3) * 1.4f); break;
      case SH_GUITAR: gtrBody = static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(0) * 3.f)); break;
      default: sat = p(1) * 0.8f; ensN = 1 + static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(3) * 4.f)); ensMix = std::min(1.f, p(3) * 1.2f); mute = static_cast<int>(std::lround(p(4) * 4.f)); break;
    }
    const int key = gtrBody * 8 + mute;
    float tiltDb = (tone - 0.5f) * 16.f;
    if (id_ == SH_GUITAR) tiltDb += (p(5) - 0.5f) * 8.f;
    eq_[0].setHighShelf(sr_, 3000, tiltDb);
    const float bodyHz = id_ == SH_PIANO ? 250.f : id_ == SH_SAX ? 350.f : id_ == SH_STRINGS ? 300.f : id_ == SH_GUITAR ? 100.f : 500.f;
    eq_[1].setPeaking(sr_, bodyHz, 0.9, (body - 0.5f) * 12.f);
    if (key != cfgKey_ || id_ == SH_GUITAR || id_ == SH_BRASS) {
      cfgKey_ = key;
      if (id_ == SH_GUITAR) {
        if (gtrBody == 0) { eq_[2].setPeaking(sr_, 100, 1.0, 3.0); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 3000, 1.0, 2.0); }
        else if (gtrBody == 1) { eq_[2].setLowpass(sr_, 4500, 0.7); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 200, 1.0, 2.0); }
        else if (gtrBody == 2) { eq_[2].setHighpass(sr_, 80, 0.7); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 2500, 1.0, 3.0); }
        else { eq_[2].setLowpass(sr_, 7000, 0.7); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 400, 1.0, 3.0); }
      } else if (id_ == SH_BRASS) {
        switch (mute) {
          case 1: eq_[2].setHighpass(sr_, 500, 0.7); eq_[3].setLowpass(sr_, 6500, 0.7); break;
          case 2: eq_[2].setLowpass(sr_, 2400, 0.7); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 800, 1.0, 0.0); break;
          case 3: eq_[2].setHighpass(sr_, 450, 0.7); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 1400, 2.0, 9.0); break;
          case 4: eq_[2].setLowpass(sr_, 1700, 0.7); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 700, 1.0, 4.0); break;
          default: eq_[2].setPeaking(sr_, 1000, 1.0, 0.0); eq_[3].setPeaking(sr_, 1000, 1.0, 0.0); break;
        }
      }
    }
    const bool useCfg = id_ == SH_GUITAR || id_ == SH_BRASS;
    rev_.setNorm(5, std::min(1.f, 0.5f * space + roomAdd));
    const float outG = dbToLin(-24.f + 30.f * lvl), aE = 1.f - std::exp(static_cast<float>(-1.0 / (0.02 * sr_)));
    static const float base[6] = {0.012f, 0.016f, 0.020f, 0.024f, 0.028f, 0.032f}, rate[6] = {0.27f, 0.33f, 0.41f, 0.49f, 0.57f, 0.65f};
    const float g = 1.f + sat * 5.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
      float xl = io[2 * i], xr = io[2 * i + 1];
      const float mono = 0.5f * (xl + xr);
      env_ += aE * (std::fabs(mono) - env_);
      const float fl = flutter > 0.f ? 1.f - flutter * (0.5f + 0.5f * sineTable().at(ph_)) : 1.f; ph_ += static_cast<float>(7.0 / sr_); if (ph_ >= 1.f) ph_ -= 1.f;
      const float nz = breath > 0.f ? noise_.next() * env_ * breath * 0.5f : 0.f;
      for (int ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {
        float y = (ch ? xr : xl) + nz;
        if (sat > 0.f) { const float s = std::tanh(g * y) / g * (1.f + 0.6f * sat); y = y * (1.f - 0.5f * sat) + s * 0.5f * sat * 2.f; }
        y = eq_[0].process(ch, y); y = eq_[1].process(ch, y);
        if (useCfg) { y = eq_[2].process(ch, y); y = eq_[3].process(ch, y); }
        if (ensN > 0) {
          dl_[ch].write(y); float ens = 0.f;
          for (int k = 0; k < ensN && k < 6; ++k) { const float d = (base[k] + 0.0010f * sineTable().at(lfo_[k])) * static_cast<float>(sr_); ens += dl_[ch].read(std::max(d, 2.f)) * (((k + ch) & 1) ? 0.9f : 0.4f); }
          y = y * (1.f - 0.4f * ensMix) + ens * (1.2f / static_cast<float>(ensN)) * ensMix;
        }
        io[2 * i + ch] = y * fl;
      }
      if (id_ == SH_PIANO && wide != 1.f) { const float m = 0.5f * (io[2 * i] + io[2 * i + 1]), s = 0.5f * (io[2 * i] - io[2 * i + 1]) * wide; io[2 * i] = m + s; io[2 * i + 1] = m - s; }
      for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) { lfo_[k] += static_cast<float>(rate[k] / sr_); if (lfo_[k] >= 1.f) lfo_[k] -= 1.f; }
    }
    if (space > 0.01f || roomAdd > 0.01f) rev_.process(io, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) io[i] = std::tanh(io[i] * outG * 0.9f) / 0.9f;
  }

 private:
  static constexpr float kRevDef[7] = {0.55f, 0.45f, 0.12f, 0.45f, 0.8f, 0.3f, 0.5f};
  int id_; ShaperMap map_; double sr_ = 48000.0;
  Biquad eq_[4]; DelayLine dl_[2]; SpaceReverb rev_; Noise noise_; BlockSmoother sm_[4];
  float env_ = 0.f, ph_ = 0.f, lfo_[6] = {0, .17f, .33f, .5f, .67f, .83f}; int cfgKey_ = -1;
};

}  // namespace aetherfx
```

```cpp
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class SourceFx : public Effect {

  virtual void noteOff(int note) = 0;
  virtual void allNotesOff() = 0;
  virtual void pitchBend(float /*minus1..plus1*/) {}

};
```

```cpp
// Aether Space: 8-line feedback delay network reverb (Householder matrix), input diffusion, pre-delay, damping, modulation.
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class SpaceReverb : public Effect {
  static constexpr int N = 8;
  struct Allpass {
    std::vector<float> b; int i = 0;
    void init(int n) { b.assign(std::max(n, 1), 0.f); i = 0; }
    inline float process(float x, float g) { float d = b[i]; float v = x + g * d; b[i] = v; if (++i >= (int)b.size()) i = 0; return d - g * v; }
    void clear() { std::fill(b.begin(), b.end(), 0.f); i = 0; }
  };

 public:
  int paramCount() const override { return 7; }
  void prepare(double sr, int) override {
    sr_ = sr;
    const double sc = sr / 48000.0;
    static const int base[N] = {1117, 1319, 1553, 1801, 2083, 2389, 2713, 3079};
    static const int apl[4] = {142, 107, 379, 277};
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
      base_[i] = static_cast<float>(base[i] * sc); line_[i].init(static_cast<int>(base[i] * sc * 1.9) + 64);
      const double w = 2.0 * kPi * (0.1 + 0.035 * i) / sr; rotC_[i] = static_cast<float>(std::cos(w)); rotS_[i] = static_cast<float>(std::sin(w));
    }
    for (int c = 0; c < 2; ++c) {
      pre_[c].init(static_cast<int>(0.13 * sr) + 8);
      for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) ap_[c][k].init(static_cast<int>(apl[k] * sc));
    }
    reset();
  }
  void reset() override {
    for (auto& l : line_) l.clear();
    for (int c = 0; c < 2; ++c) { pre_[c].clear(); for (auto& a : ap_[c]) a.clear(); }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) { lp_[i] = 0.f; len_[i] = base_[i] * 1.2f; osS_[i] = std::sin(i * 0.37f); osC_[i] = std::cos(i * 0.37f); }
```

```cpp
// Prism Tone: 3-band EQ (low shelf, parametric mid, high shelf) + output trim. Minimum phase, zero latency.
#pragma once
#include "fx_core.h"

namespace aetherfx {

class ToneEq : public Effect {
 public:
  int paramCount() const override { return 8; }
  void prepare(double sr, int) override { sr_ = sr; reset(); }
  void reset() override {
    for (auto& b : bq_) b.reset();
    for (auto& s : sm_) s.init = false;
    outRamp_.init = false;
    updateCoefs(32);
  }
  // analytic response of the current smoothed filters, for UI curve drawing
  double responseDb(double f) const { return bq_[0].magDb(sr_, f) + bq_[1].magDb(sr_, f) + bq_[2].magDb(sr_, f); }

  void process(float* io, int frames) override {
    const float outT = dbToLin((p(7) - 0.5f) * 24.f);
    float outStep = outRamp_.begin(outT, frames);
    float og = outRamp_.cur;
    outRamp_.cur = outT;
    for (int pos = 0; pos < frames; pos += 32) {
      const int n = std::min(32, frames - pos);
      updateCoefs(n);
      for (int i = pos; i < pos + n; ++i) {
        og += outStep;
        float l = io[2 * i], r = io[2 * i + 1];
        l = bq_[2].process(0, bq_[1].process(0, bq_[0].process(0, l)));
        r = bq_[2].process(1, bq_[1].process(1, bq_[0].process(1, r)));
        io[2 * i] = l * og; io[2 * i + 1] = r * og;
      }
    }
  }

 private:
  void updateCoefs(int chunk) {
    const float c = smoothCoef(chunk, sr_, 0.03);
    const double lf = 20.0 * std::pow(1000.0, sm_[0].step(p(0), c)), lg = (sm_[1].step(p(1), c) - 0.5) * 24.0;
    const double mf = 20.0 * std::pow(1000.0, sm_[2].step(p(2), c)), mg = (sm_[3].step(p(3), c) - 0.5) * 24.0, mq = 0.3 + 3.7 * sm_[4].step(p(4), c);
    const double hf = 20.0 * std::pow(1000.0, sm_[5].step(p(5), c)), hg = (sm_[6].step(p(6), c) - 0.5) * 24.0;
    bq_[0].setLowShelf(sr_, lf, lg);
    bq_[1].setPeaking(sr_, mf, mq, mg);
    bq_[2].setHighShelf(sr_, hf, hg);
  }
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  Biquad bq_[3];
  BlockSmoother sm_[7];
  Ramp outRamp_;
};

}  // namespace aetherfx
```

```cpp
      const float nz = noise_.next() * env_ * breath * 2.0f;
      const float vibMod = vibDepth * sineTable().at(ph_); ph_ += static_cast<float>(5.5 / sr_); if (ph_ >= 1.f) ph_ -= 1.f;
      for (int ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {
        const float x = ch ? dry1 : dry0, nIn = nz;
        float fo = 0.f, no = 0.f;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { fo += bp_[k].process(ch, x) * kG[k]; no += nbp_[k].process(ch, nIn) * kG[k]; }
        float y = (fo * 2.4f + no * 2.0f) + x * body * 0.8f;
        dl_[ch].write(y);
        float ens = 0.f;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) { const float d = (base[k] + 0.0012f * sineTable().at(lfo_[k])) * static_cast<float>(sr_) + vibMod; ens += dl_[ch].read(std::max(d, 2.f)) * (ch ? wr[k] : wl[k]); }
        y = y * (1.f - 0.5f * choir) + ens * 0.55f * choir;
        io[2 * i + ch] = tone_.process(ch, y) * outG;
      }
      for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) { lfo_[k] += static_cast<float>(rate[k] / sr_); if (lfo_[k] >= 1.f) lfo_[k] -= 1.f; }
    }
    if (space > 0.01f) rev_.process(io, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; ++i) io[i] = std::tanh(io[i] * 0.9f) / 0.9f;
  }
  // vowel map -> F1,F2,F3 (Hz): inverse-distance weighting of five vowels
  static void formants(float x, float y, float* out) {
    static const float pos[5][2] = {{0.1f, 0.9f}, {0.9f, 0.9f}, {0.25f, 0.55f}, {0.75f, 0.55f}, {0.5f, 0.1f}};
    static const float fm[5][3] = {{270, 2290, 3010}, {300, 870, 2240}, {530, 1840, 2480}, {570, 840, 2410}, {800, 1150, 2900}};
    float w[5], sw = 0.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) { const float dx = x - pos[i][0], dy = y - pos[i][1], d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + 1e-4f; w[i] = 1.f / (d2 * std::sqrt(d2)); sw += w[i]; }
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) { float v = 0.f; for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) v += w[i] * fm[i][k]; out[k] = v / sw; }
  }

 private:
  static constexpr float kQ[3] = {8.f, 11.f, 14.f}, kG[3] = {1.f, 0.7f, 0.45f};
  static constexpr float kRevDef[7] = {0.62f, 0.5f, 0.15f, 0.45f, 0.8f, 0.3f, 0.5f};
  double sr_ = 48000.0;
  Biquad bp_[3], nbp_[3], tone_;
  DelayLine dl_[2];
  SpaceReverb rev_;
  Noise noise_;
  BlockSmoother sm_[9];
  float env_ = 0.f, ph_ = 0.f, fx_[3] = {-1, -1, -1}, lfo_[4] = {0, 0.25f, 0.5f, 0.75f};
};

}  // namespace aetherfx
```

```cpp
#include "audio_engine.h"

AudioEngine::AudioEngine() {
    int sampleRate = 48000;
    mSampleRate = sampleRate;
    mFloatRenderBuffer.resize(2048, 0.0f);
    // One stereo output group per MIDI channel: renderFxPath() needs each track's
    // soundfont render in its own group, and FluidSynth only honours
    // synth.audio-groups at init time. Without this renderChannels() returns false
    // and the whole Æther FX path silently falls back to the legacy stereo mix.
    mSynthEngine.setMultiChannelEnabled(true);
    mSynthEngine.init(sampleRate);
    mMasterDelay.init(sampleRate);
    mMasterReverb.init(sampleRate);
    mSoundGoodizer.init(sampleRate);
    mMasterPunch.init(sampleRate);
    mPadFilter.setLowPass(static_cast<float>(sampleRate), 400.0f * std::pow(45.0f, mPadBrightness), 0.707f);
    mTonicFxDelay.init(sampleRate);
    mPadsFxDelay.init(sampleRate);
    mTonicFxReverb.init(sampleRate);
    mPadsFxReverb.init(sampleRate);
    mDrumSampler.init(sampleRate);
    mMasterCompressor.init(sampleRate, -15.0f, 1.6f, 12.0f, 120.0f, 4.0f);
    mMasterCompressor.setParams(false, -15.0f, 1.6f, 12.0f, 120.0f, 0.0f);
    mSoftClipper.init(sampleRate);
    mSpatialWidener.setAmount(0.0f);
}

AudioEngine::~AudioEngine() {
    stop();
}

bool AudioEngine::start(int driverType) {
    mDriverType = driverType;
    return openAndStartStream();
}

bool AudioEngine::openAndStartStream() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mStreamMutex);
    mOboeActive.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (mStream) {
        mStream->stop();
        mStream->close();
        mStream.reset();
    }

    oboe::AudioStreamBuilder builder;
    builder.setDirection(oboe::Direction::Output)
        ->setPerformanceMode(oboe::PerformanceMode::LowLatency)
        ->setSharingMode(oboe::SharingMode::Exclusive)
        ->setFormat(oboe::AudioFormat::Float)
        ->setChannelCount(oboe::ChannelCount::Stereo)
        ->setSampleRate(oboe::kUnspecified)
        ->setDataCallback(this)
        ->setErrorCallback(this)
        ->setUsage(oboe::Usage::Media)
        ->setContentType(oboe::ContentType::Music);

    if (mDriverType == 1) {
        LOGI("Requesting OpenSL ES audio backend...");
        builder.setAudioApi(oboe::AudioApi::OpenSLES);
    } else {
        LOGI("Requesting Oboe High-Performance (AAudio Exclusive) backend...");
        builder.setAudioApi(oboe::AudioApi::AAudio);
    }

    oboe::Result result = builder.openStream(mStream);
    if (result != oboe::Result::OK) {
        LOGW("Failed to open Exclusive Float audio stream (%s). Retrying with SharingMode::Shared...", oboe::convertToText(result));
        builder.setSharingMode(oboe::SharingMode::Shared);
        result = builder.openStream(mStream);
    }

    if (result != oboe::Result::OK) {
        LOGW("Failed to open Float audio stream (%s). Retrying with I16 format...", oboe::convertToText(result));
        builder.setFormat(oboe::AudioFormat::I16);
        builder.setAudioApi(oboe::AudioApi::OpenSLES);
        builder.setSharingMode(oboe::SharingMode::Shared);
        result = builder.openStream(mStream);
        if (result != oboe::Result::OK) {
            LOGW("Retrying with Unspecified API and Unspecified format...");
            builder.setAudioApi(oboe::AudioApi::Unspecified);
            builder.setFormat(oboe::AudioFormat::Unspecified);
            builder.setPerformanceMode(oboe::PerformanceMode::None);
            result = builder.openStream(mStream);
            if (result != oboe::Result::OK) {
                LOGE("Failed to open audio stream fallback: %s", oboe::convertToText(result));
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    int burst = mStream->getFramesPerBurst();
    int reqBuffer = mConfiguredBufferSize.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    int targetBuffer = (burst > 0) ? std::max(reqBuffer, burst * 2) : reqBuffer;
    mStream->setBufferSizeInFrames(targetBuffer);
    int sampleRate = mStream->getSampleRate();
    mSampleRate = sampleRate;

    // Size the Æther FX scratch on the control thread before the stream runs. The
    // capacity is the max Oboe burst the stream can hand us; FxMixer gets the same
    // number so its internal blocks are never reallocated mid-callback.
    {
        int capacity = std::max({burst * 4, reqBuffer, targetBuffer, 2048});
        mFxChannelBuffer.assign(static_cast<size_t>(capacity) * 2 * 16, 0.0f);
        mFxStripBuffer.assign(static_cast<size_t>(capacity) * 2, 0.0f);
        mFxMixBuffer.assign(static_cast<size_t>(capacity) * 2, 0.0f);
        mFx.prepare(sampleRate, capacity);
    }

    // Note routing must be installed before the stream runs: it is a plain
    // function pointer read on the audio thread, never mutated while running.
    mSynthEngine.setSourceRouter(&AudioEngine::sourceRouterTrampoline, this);
    mSynthEngine.setAllNotesOffHook(&AudioEngine::allNotesOffTrampoline, this);

    LOGI("Audio stream opened: %d Hz, %d frames/burst, buffer set to %d frames (requested: %d).", 
        sampleRate, burst, targetBuffer, reqBuffer);

    // Initialize all DSP blocks with active sample rate
    mMasterDelay.init(sampleRate);
    mMasterChorus.init(sampleRate);
    mMasterReverb.init(sampleRate);
    mSoundGoodizer.init(sampleRate);
    mMasterPunch.init(sampleRate);
    mPadFilter.setLowPass(static_cast<float>(sampleRate), 400.0f * std::pow(45.0f, mPadBrightness), 0.707f);
    mTonicFxDelay.init(sampleRate);
    mPadsFxDelay.init(sampleRate);
    mTonicFxReverb.init(sampleRate);
    mPadsFxReverb.init(sampleRate);
    mDrumSampler.init(sampleRate);
    mMasterCompressor.init(sampleRate, mMasterCompressorThreshDb, mMasterCompressorRatio, mMasterCompressorAttackMs, mMasterCompressorReleaseMs, mMasterCompressorMakeupDb);
    mSoftClipper.init(sampleRate);

    // Immediately re-apply all preserved DSP, Gain and Volume parameters
    // This ensures that when plugging in or unplugging a 3.5mm jack or BT device,
    // the audio output retains full power, master gain, punch, and dynamics without ducking!
    mMasterDelay.setParams(mMasterDelayEnabled, mMasterDelayTime, mMasterDelayFeedback, mMasterDelayMix, mMasterDelayPingPong);
    mMasterChorus.setParams(mMasterChorusEnabled, mMasterChorusRateHz, mMasterChorusDepthMs, mMasterChorusMix);
    mMasterCompressor.setParams(mMasterCompressorEnabled, mMasterCompressorThreshDb, mMasterCompressorRatio, mMasterCompressorAttackMs, mMasterCompressorReleaseMs, mMasterCompressorMakeupDb);
    mMasterReverb.setParams(mMasterReverbEnabled, mMasterReverbSize, mMasterReverbDecay, mMasterReverbDamp, mMasterReverbMix);
    mSoundGoodizer.setParams(mSoundGoodizerEnabled, mSoundGoodizerMode, mSoundGoodizerAmount);
    mSpatialWidener.setAmount(mSpatialWidenerAmount);
    mMasterPunch.setAmount(mMasterPunchAmount);
    setMasterEq(mEqLowDb, mEqMidDb, mEqHighDb);
    mDrumSampler.setMasterVolume(mDrumMasterVolume);

    // Initialize unified FluidSynth engine (16 MIDI channels covering Tracks 1..8, Drum 8, TonicPad 9)
    if (!mSynthEngine.isInitialized()) {
        mSynthEngine.setMultiChannelEnabled(true);
        mSynthEngine.init(sampleRate, kFaderPolyphony, "UnifiedSynthEngine");
    }
    mSynthEngine.setGain(mMasterGain);

    result = mStream->requestStart();
    if (result != oboe::Result::OK) {
        LOGE("Failed to start Oboe audio stream: %s", oboe::convertToText(result));
        return false;
    }

    mOboeActive.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    LOGI("Oboe audio engine running with driver mode: %d and realtime DSP active", mDriverType);
    return true;
}

void AudioEngine::onErrorBeforeClose(oboe::AudioStream *audioStream, oboe::Result error) {
    LOGW("Oboe onErrorBeforeClose: %s", oboe::convertToText(error));
}

void AudioEngine::onErrorAfterClose(oboe::AudioStream *audioStream, oboe::Result error) {
    LOGI("Oboe stream error/disconnected: %s. Reopening stream asynchronously...", 
        oboe::convertToText(error));
    if (mIsReconnecting.exchange(true)) {
        LOGI("Reconnection already pending or in progress, skipping duplicate request");
        return;
    }
    std::thread([this]() {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(250));
        openAndStartStream();
        mIsReconnecting.store(false);
    }).detach();
}

void AudioEngine::stop() {
    mOboeActive.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mStreamMutex);
        if (mStream) {
            mStream->stop();
            mStream->close();
            mStream.reset();
        }
    }
    mSynthEngine.destroy();
    LOGI("Audio engine stopped and unified synth instance destroyed");
}

void AudioEngine::setDriver(int driverType) {
    if (mDriverType != driverType) {
        LOGI("Switching audio driver from %d to %d", mDriverType, driverType);
        mDriverType = driverType;
        openAndStartStream();
    }
}

void AudioEngine::setBufferSize(int bufferSizeInFrames) {
    int clampedReq = std::clamp(bufferSizeInFrames, 64, 4096);
    mConfiguredBufferSize.store(clampedReq, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> streamLock(mStreamMutex);
    if (mStream) {
        int32_t burst = mStream->getFramesPerBurst();
        int32_t targetFrames = clampedReq;
        if (burst > 0) {
            int32_t numBursts = std::max(2, (targetFrames + burst - 1) / burst);
            targetFrames = numBursts * burst;
        }
        int clamped = std::clamp(targetFrames, 64, 4096);
        auto res = mStream->setBufferSizeInFrames(clamped);
        if (res) {
            LOGI("Oboe buffer size set to %d frames (burst: %d, actual: %d, requested: %d)", clamped, burst, res.value(), clampedReq);
        } else {
            LOGE("Failed to set Oboe buffer size: %s", oboe::convertToText(res.error()));
        }
    }
}

void AudioEngine::processSurfaceFx(float *buf, int32_t numFrames, const SurfaceFxChainState &fx,
                                   StereoBiquad &filter, StereoDelay &delay, StereoReverb &reverb,
                                   bool withShimmer, StereoBiquad *brightness) {
    if (numFrames <= 0) return;
    float sr = static_cast<float>(mSampleRate > 0 ? mSampleRate : 48000);

    // Filter: low-pass whose cutoff opens with the amount (dark -> open).
    if (fx.filterOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        float amt = std::clamp(fx.filterAmt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        float f0 = 180.0f * std::pow(120.0f, amt); // 180 Hz .. 21.6 kHz
        filter.setLowPass(sr, f0, 0.707f);
        filter.process(buf, numFrames);
    }

    // Brightness: high shelf. Shimmer doubles as a long bright tail on the same chain.
    if (brightness != nullptr && fx.brightnessOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        float amt = std::clamp(fx.brightnessAmt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        brightness->setHighShelf(sr, 3500.0f, (amt - 0.5f) * 18.0f, 0.707f);
        brightness->process(buf, numFrames);
    }

    if (fx.delayOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        float amt = std::clamp(fx.delayAmt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        delay.setParams(true, 0.16f + amt * 0.34f, 0.18f + amt * 0.42f, amt * 0.55f, false);
        delay.process(buf, numFrames);
    } else {
        delay.setParams(false, 0.3f, 0.3f, 0.0f, false);
    }

    if (fx.reverbOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) || (withShimmer && fx.shimmerOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))) {
        float revAmt = fx.reverbOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)
                       ? std::clamp(fx.reverbAmt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
        float shimAmt = (withShimmer && fx.shimmerOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
                        ? std::clamp(fx.shimmerAmt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
        float size = std::clamp(0.42f + revAmt * 0.5f + shimAmt * 0.08f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        float decay = std::clamp(0.5f + revAmt * 0.42f + shimAmt * 0.06f, 0.0f, 0.98f);
        float mix = std::clamp(std::max(revAmt * 0.6f, shimAmt * 0.7f), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        if (mix > 0.001f) {
            reverb.setParams(true, size, decay, 0.45f, mix);
            reverb.process(buf, numFrames);
        }
    }
}

void AudioEngine::applySurfaceFx(float *mixedBuf, const float *preDrumBuf, float *drumBuf,
                                 int32_t numFrames, bool padsAudible) {
    if (numFrames <= 0) return;
    size_t totalSamples = static_cast<size_t>(numFrames * 2);

    // ── DrumPad chain: the sampler owns its own buffer, so we can process it in
    //    isolation and add it back. This is a real, audible per-surface chain. ──
    bool padsFxOn =
        g_padsFx.filterOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) ||
        g_padsFx.brightnessOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) ||
        g_padsFx.delayOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) ||
        g_padsFx.reverbOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (padsFxOn) {
        if (mSurfaceFxBuffer.size() < totalSamples) mSurfaceFxBuffer.resize(totalSamples, 0.0f);
        if (padsAudible && drumBuf != nullptr) {
            std::copy(drumBuf, drumBuf + totalSamples, mSurfaceFxBuffer.data());
            processSurfaceFx(mSurfaceFxBuffer.data(), numFrames, g_padsFx,
                             mPadsFxFilter, mPadsFxDelay, mPadsFxReverb, false, &mPadsFxBrightness);
            // mixedBuf currently holds preDrum + dry drums: swap the dry drums for the wet ones.
            for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) {
                mixedBuf[i] += mSurfaceFxBuffer[i] - drumBuf[i];
            }
        } else {
            // Voices are silent: feed silence so reverb/delay tails decay naturally.
            std::fill(mSurfaceFxBuffer.begin(), mSurfaceFxBuffer.begin() + totalSamples, 0.0f);
            processSurfaceFx(mSurfaceFxBuffer.data(), numFrames, g_padsFx,
                             mPadsFxFilter, mPadsFxDelay, mPadsFxReverb, false, &mPadsFxBrightness);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) mixedBuf[i] += mSurfaceFxBuffer[i];
        }
    }

    // ── TonicPad chain: channel 9 lives inside the shared synth bus and cannot be
    //    isolated per block, so it is driven through per-channel MIDI CCs, which
    //    fluidsynth applies to that channel only. Audible, and correctly scoped. ──
    bool tonicActive = false;
    float rev = 0.0f, cutoff = 1.0f;
    if (g_tonicFx.reverbOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        rev = std::clamp(g_tonicFx.reverbAmt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        tonicActive = true;
    }
    if (g_tonicFx.shimmerOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        rev = std::clamp(std::max(rev, g_tonicFx.shimmerAmt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        tonicActive = true;
    }
    if (g_tonicFx.filterOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        cutoff = std::clamp(g_tonicFx.filterAmt.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        tonicActive = true;
    }
    if (tonicActive) {
        if (std::abs(rev - mTonicCcReverb) > 0.004f) {
            mTonicCcReverb = rev;
            mSynthEngine.setChannelReverb(9, rev);
        }
        if (std::abs(cutoff - mTonicCcCutoff) > 0.004f) {
            mTonicCcCutoff = cutoff;
            mSynthEngine.sendCC(9, 74, static_cast<int>(cutoff * 127.0f));
        }
    }
    (void)preDrumBuf;
}

int AudioEngine::renderDirect(int16_t *outputBuffer16, int32_t numFrames) {
    if (!this || !outputBuffer16 || numFrames <= 0) return 0;

    // If Oboe is actively running, let Oboe handle audio directly to hardware
    if (isOboeActive()) {
        return 0;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mRenderMutex);

    // Ensure sample rate and DSP are initialized
    int sampleRate = mSampleRate > 0 ? mSampleRate : 48000;
    if (!mSynthEngine.isInitialized()) {
        mSynthEngine.init(sampleRate);
    }

    size_t totalSamples = static_cast<size_t>(numFrames * 2);
    if (mFloatRenderBuffer.size() < totalSamples) {
        mFloatRenderBuffer.resize(totalSamples, 0.0f);
    }
    float *floatBuf = mFloatRenderBuffer.data();
    if (!floatBuf) {
        std::fill_n(outputBuffer16, totalSamples, static_cast<int16_t>(0));
        return 0;
    }

    // 1. Render unified 16-channel SoundFont engine (Faders 0..7, Drum 8, TonicPad 9)
    mSynthEngine.renderStereo(floatBuf, numFrames, false);

    // 2. Mix Dedicated SamplePlaybackEngine (DrumPad PCM WAVs)
    // Always render the sampler so queued triggers are drained this block; the
    // voice count is only known after rendering.
    if (mPadsIsolateBuffer.size() < totalSamples) mPadsIsolateBuffer.resize(totalSamples, 0.0f);
    mDrumSampler.renderStereo(mPadsIsolateBuffer.data(), numFrames, false);
    bool padsAudible = mDrumSampler.getActiveVoiceCount() > 0;
    if (padsAudible) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) floatBuf[i] += mPadsIsolateBuffer[i];
    }
    applySurfaceFx(floatBuf, nullptr, padsAudible ? mPadsIsolateBuffer.data() : nullptr, numFrames, padsAudible);

    if (!mBypassMasterFX.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        float maxAbs = 0.0f;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) {
            float absVal = std::abs(floatBuf[i]);
            if (absVal > maxAbs) maxAbs = absVal;
        }

        // 3. Apply Master Delay
        mMasterDelay.process(floatBuf, numFrames);

        // 4. Apply Master Reverb, SoundGoodizer & Punch (bypassed if silent to save CPU)
        if (maxAbs > 0.0001f) {
            mMasterReverb.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
            mSoundGoodizer.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
            mMasterPunch.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
        }

        // 5. Apply Spatial Stereo Widener
        mSpatialWidener.process(floatBuf, numFrames);

        // 6. Apply Master 3-Band Biquad EQ
        mEqLow.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
        mEqMid.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
        mEqHigh.process(floatBuf, numFrames);

        // 7. Master Studio Peak Limiter, Parallel Compressor & Sub-Bass Cut HPF
        processMasterChain(floatBuf, numFrames);
    }

    // Convert Float to PCM 16-bit
    for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) {
        float s = std::clamp(floatBuf[i], -1.0f, 1.0f);
        outputBuffer16[i] = static_cast<int16_t>(s * 32767.0f);
    }

    return numFrames;
}

bool AudioEngine::sourceRouterTrampoline(void *ctx, int channel, int type, int note,
                                         int velocity, int param1, int param2) {
    return static_cast<AudioEngine *>(ctx)->routeEventToSource(channel, type, note, velocity, param1, param2);
}

void AudioEngine::allNotesOffTrampoline(void *ctx, int channel) {
    AudioEngine *e = static_cast<AudioEngine *>(ctx);
    if (channel >= 0 && channel < 10) {
        e->mFx.allNotesOff(channel);
    } else {
        for (int s = 0; s < 10; ++s) e->mFx.allNotesOff(s);
    }
}

// Pushes the generator offsets of a track's shaper to its soundfont channel. The
// values are diffed against the last applied set so a slider drag does not flood
// the MIDI queue. Control thread only.
void AudioEngine::refreshTrackGens(int track) {
    if (track < 0 || track >= 8) return;
    aetherfx::GenUpdate u = mFx.instrumentGens(track);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mGenMutex);
    GenCache &c = mGenCache[track];
    if (!u.valid) {
        if (c.n > 0) {
            // Instrument removed: release the offsets back to the soundfont defaults.
            for (int i = 0; i < c.n; ++i) mSynthEngine.setGen(track, c.gen[i], 0.0f);
            c.n = 0;
        }
        if (c.pitchSens != -1) { mSynthEngine.setPitchBendSensitivity(track, 2); c.pitchSens = -1; }
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < u.gens.n; ++i) {
        bool known = false;
        for (int k = 0; k < c.n; ++k) {
            if (c.gen[k] == u.gens.gen[i]) {
                known = true;
                if (c.val[k] != u.gens.val[i]) { c.val[k] = u.gens.val[i]; mSynthEngine.setGen(track, c.gen[k], c.val[k]); }
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!known && c.n < 16) { c.gen[c.n] = u.gens.gen[i]; c.val[c.n] = u.gens.val[i]; ++c.n; mSynthEngine.setGen(track, u.gens.gen[i], u.gens.val[i]); }
    }
    if (c.pitchSens != u.perf.bendSemis) { c.pitchSens = u.perf.bendSemis; mSynthEngine.setPitchBendSensitivity(track, c.pitchSens); }
}

void AudioEngine::setTrackInstrument(int track, int fxId) {
    if (!mFx.setInstrument(track, fxId)) return;
    if (fxId < 0) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mGenMutex);
        GenCache &c = mGenCache[track];
        for (int i = 0; i < c.n; ++i) mSynthEngine.setGen(track, c.gen[i], 0.0f);
        c.n = 0;
        if (c.pitchSens != -1) { mSynthEngine.setPitchBendSensitivity(track, 2); c.pitchSens = -1; }
        return;
    }
    refreshTrackGens(track);
}

void AudioEngine::setTrackInstrumentParam(int track, int param, float norm) {
    mFx.setInstrumentParam(track, param, norm);
    refreshTrackGens(track);
}

bool AudioEngine::routeEventToSource(int channel, int type, int note, int velocity, int param1, int param2) {
    if (!mFx.soundfontPaused(channel)) return false;
    switch (type) {
        case EngineMidiEvent::NOTE_ON:
            mFx.noteOn(channel, note, velocity);
            return true;
        case EngineMidiEvent::NOTE_OFF:
            mFx.noteOff(channel, note);
            return true;
        case EngineMidiEvent::PITCH_BEND:
            // FluidSynth uses 14-bit 0..16383 with 8192 as centre; the source API
            // expects -1..1.
            mFx.pitchBend(channel, (static_cast<float>(param1) - 8192.0f) / 8192.0f);
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

// Æther FX render path. Returns false when the FX path is off or its buffers are
// not ready, so the caller falls back to the legacy mix unchanged.
bool AudioEngine::renderFxPath(float *outputBuffer, int32_t numFrames) {
    if (!mFxEnabled.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) return false;
    // Dormant until an effect or an instrument is actually placed. The FX path is a
    // 16-output-group render plus 11 strip chains; running it with nothing loaded
    // costs several times the legacy mix for no audible benefit and was the source
    // of the continuous stutter. It also bypasses applySurfaceFx(), so staying on
    // the legacy path keeps the Tonic/DrumPad FX sheets working.
    if (!mFx.hasActiveWork()) return false;
    if (numFrames <= 0 || mFxChannelBuffer.empty() || mFxStripBuffer.empty() || mFxMixBuffer.empty()) return false;

    const int channelCount = 10;  // 0..7 tracks, 8 Drum, 9 TonicPad
    size_t channelSamples = static_cast<size_t>(numFrames) * 2 * channelCount;
    size_t stripSamples = static_cast<size_t>(numFrames) * 2;
    if (channelSamples > mFxChannelBuffer.size() || stripSamples > mFxStripBuffer.size()) {
        std::fill(outputBuffer, outputBuffer + stripSamples, 0.0f);
        return true;
    }

    // 1. Per-channel render of the soundfont engine.
    if (!mSynthEngine.renderChannels(mFxChannelBuffer.data(), numFrames, channelCount)) {
        return false;  // multi-channel not armed: let the caller use renderStereo
    }

    std::fill(mFxMixBuffer.begin(), mFxMixBuffer.begin() + stripSamples, 0.0f);

    // 2. Each synth channel is a strip: a Source replaces the soundfont, every
    //    strip then runs its own effect chain before being summed into the mix.
    //    The render is channel-major, so both the copy and the sum walk memory
    //    in order instead of striding by 2 * channelCount.
    const size_t perChannel = static_cast<size_t>(numFrames) * 2;
    float *strip = mFxStripBuffer.data();
    for (int s = 0; s < channelCount; ++s) {
        const float *src = mFxChannelBuffer.data() + static_cast<size_t>(s) * perChannel;
        // A source strip replaces the soundfont, so its channel input is dropped and
        // the source effect fills the strip itself.
        if (mFx.soundfontPaused(s)) {
            std::fill(strip, strip + stripSamples, 0.0f);
            mFx.processStrip(s, strip, numFrames);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < stripSamples; ++i) mFxMixBuffer[i] += strip[i];
            continue;
        }
        // A strip with no instrument and no effect is a pass-through: fold its
        // channel straight into the mix. Copying it into the strip buffer, running
        // an empty chain and adding it back was pure overhead on every block, so the
        // FX path cost grew with the channel count instead of with the work placed.
        if (!mFx.stripActive(s)) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < stripSamples; ++i) mFxMixBuffer[i] += src[i];
            continue;
        }
        std::copy(src, src + stripSamples, strip);
        mFx.processStrip(s, strip, numFrames);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < stripSamples; ++i) mFxMixBuffer[i] += strip[i];
    }

    // 3. DrumPad sampler is strip 10.
    mDrumSampler.renderStereo(mFxStripBuffer.data(), numFrames, false);
    if (mFx.stripActive(10)) mFx.processStrip(10, mFxStripBuffer.data(), numFrames);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < stripSamples; ++i) mFxMixBuffer[i] += mFxStripBuffer[i];

    // 4. Master chain, then the single conversion to the stream format.
    mFx.processMaster(mFxMixBuffer.data(), numFrames);

    // 5. The legacy master bus stays on the FX path. Switching the render over to the
    //    FX path used to drop it entirely: no glue compressor, no soft clipper and,
    //    worst of all, no limiter — so a hot preset clipped and cracked instead of
    //    being tamed, and the mix lost the character it had before the FX window.
    if (!mBypassMasterFX.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        float *mix = mFxMixBuffer.data();
        mMasterChorus.process(mix, numFrames);
        mMasterDelay.process(mix, numFrames);
        mMasterReverb.process(mix, numFrames);
        mSoundGoodizer.process(mix, numFrames);
        mMasterPunch.process(mix, numFrames);
        mSpatialWidener.process(mix, numFrames);
        mEqLow.process(mix, numFrames);
        mEqMid.process(mix, numFrames);
        mEqHigh.process(mix, numFrames);
        processMasterChain(mix, numFrames);
    }

    std::copy(mFxMixBuffer.begin(), mFxMixBuffer.begin() + stripSamples, outputBuffer);
    return true;
}

oboe::DataCallbackResult AudioEngine::onAudioReady(
    oboe::AudioStream *audioStream,
    void *audioData,
    int32_t numFrames) {

    // Set real-time thread priority on first callback frame to prevent Android Linux kernel from parking on LITTLE cores
    static std::atomic<bool> sPriorityConfigured{false};
    if (!sPriorityConfigured.exchange(true, std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        struct sched_param param{};
        param.sched_priority = 90;
        if (pthread_setschedparam(pthread_self(), SCHED_FIFO, &param) != 0) {
            param.sched_priority = sched_get_priority_max(SCHED_RR);
            pthread_setschedparam(pthread_self(), SCHED_RR, &param);
            LOGI("Oboe audio thread realtime priority configured with policy SCHED_RR");
        } else {
            LOGI("Oboe audio thread realtime priority configured with policy SCHED_FIFO");
        }
    }

    auto startTime = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

    mOboeActive.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mRenderMutex);

    oboe::AudioFormat format = audioStream->getFormat();
    if (format == oboe::AudioFormat::I16) {
        auto *outputBuffer16 = static_cast<int16_t *>(audioData);
        size_t totalSamples = static_cast<size_t>(numFrames * 2);
        if (mFloatRenderBuffer.size() < totalSamples) {
            mFloatRenderBuffer.resize(totalSamples, 0.0f);
        }
        float *floatBuf = mFloatRenderBuffer.data();

        if (renderFxPath(floatBuf, numFrames)) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) {
                float s = std::clamp(floatBuf[i], -1.0f, 1.0f);
                outputBuffer16[i] = static_cast<int16_t>(s * 32767.0f);
            }
            return oboe::DataCallbackResult::Continue;
        }

        // 1. Render unified 16-channel Soundfont engine (tracks 0..7, Drum 8, TonicPad 9)
        mSynthEngine.renderStereo(floatBuf, numFrames, false);

        // 2. Mix Dedicated SamplePlaybackEngine (DrumPad PCM WAVs)
        // Always render the sampler so queued triggers are drained this block; the
        // voice count is only known after rendering.
        if (mPadsIsolateBuffer.size() < totalSamples) mPadsIsolateBuffer.resize(totalSamples, 0.0f);
        mDrumSampler.renderStereo(mPadsIsolateBuffer.data(), numFrames, false);
        bool padsAudible = mDrumSampler.getActiveVoiceCount() > 0;
        if (padsAudible) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) floatBuf[i] += mPadsIsolateBuffer[i];
        }
        // Surface FX chains (TonicPad CCs + isolated DrumPad DSP)
        applySurfaceFx(floatBuf, nullptr, padsAudible ? mPadsIsolateBuffer.data() : nullptr, numFrames, padsAudible);

        if (!mBypassMasterFX.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            float maxAbs = 0.0f;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) {
                float absVal = std::abs(floatBuf[i]);
                if (absVal > maxAbs) maxAbs = absVal;
            }

            // 3. Apply Master Delay & Chorus
            mMasterChorus.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
            mMasterDelay.process(floatBuf, numFrames);

            // 4. Apply Master Reverb, SoundGoodizer & Punch (bypassed if silent)
            if (maxAbs > 0.0001f) {
                mMasterReverb.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
                mSoundGoodizer.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
                mMasterPunch.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
            }

            // 5. Apply Spatial Stereo Widener
            mSpatialWidener.process(floatBuf, numFrames);

            // 6. Apply Master 3-Band Biquad EQ
            mEqLow.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
            mEqMid.process(floatBuf, numFrames);
            mEqHigh.process(floatBuf, numFrames);

            // 7. Master Studio Peak Limiter, Parallel Compressor & Sub-Bass Cut HPF
            processMasterChain(floatBuf, numFrames);
        }

        // Convert Float to PCM 16-bit
        for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) {
            float s = std::clamp(floatBuf[i], -1.0f, 1.0f);
            outputBuffer16[i] = static_cast<int16_t>(s * 32767.0f);
        }
    } else {
        auto *outputBuffer = static_cast<float *>(audioData);
        size_t totalSamples = static_cast<size_t>(numFrames * 2);

        if (renderFxPath(outputBuffer, numFrames)) {
            return oboe::DataCallbackResult::Continue;
        }

        // 1. Render unified 16-channel Soundfont engine (tracks 0..7, Drum 8, TonicPad 9)
        mSynthEngine.renderStereo(outputBuffer, numFrames, false);

        // 2. Mix Dedicated SamplePlaybackEngine (DrumPad PCM WAVs)
        // Always render the sampler so queued triggers are drained this block; the
        // voice count is only known after rendering.
        if (mPadsIsolateBuffer.size() < totalSamples) mPadsIsolateBuffer.resize(totalSamples, 0.0f);
        mDrumSampler.renderStereo(mPadsIsolateBuffer.data(), numFrames, false);
        bool padsAudible = mDrumSampler.getActiveVoiceCount() > 0;
        if (padsAudible) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) outputBuffer[i] += mPadsIsolateBuffer[i];
        }
        applySurfaceFx(outputBuffer, nullptr, padsAudible ? mPadsIsolateBuffer.data() : nullptr, numFrames, padsAudible);

        if (!mBypassMasterFX.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            float maxAbs = 0.0f;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < totalSamples; ++i) {
                float absVal = std::abs(outputBuffer[i]);
                if (absVal > maxAbs) maxAbs = absVal;
            }

            // 3. Apply Master Delay & Chorus
            mMasterChorus.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);
            mMasterDelay.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);

            // 4. Apply Master Reverb, SoundGoodizer & Punch (bypassed if silent)
            if (maxAbs > 0.0001f) {
                mMasterReverb.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);
                mSoundGoodizer.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);
                mMasterPunch.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);
            }

            // 5. Apply Spatial Stereo Widener
            mSpatialWidener.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);

            // 6. Apply Master 3-Band Biquad EQ (Low Shelf, Mid Peaking, High Shelf)
            mEqLow.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);
            mEqMid.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);
            mEqHigh.process(outputBuffer, numFrames);

            // 7. Master Studio Peak Limiter, Parallel Compressor & Sub-Bass Cut HPF
            processMasterChain(outputBuffer, numFrames);
        }
    }

    auto endTime = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto durationUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(endTime - startTime).count();

    static int sLogCounter = 0;
    if (++sLogCounter % 500 == 0 || durationUs > 3500) {
        int totalActiveVoices = mSynthEngine.getActiveVoiceCount();
        int sr = mSampleRate > 0 ? mSampleRate : 48000;
        LOGI("AudioCallback render duration: %ld us (budget: %d us, active voices: %d, frames: %d)",
             (long)durationUs, (numFrames * 1000000 / sr), totalActiveVoices, numFrames);
    }

    return oboe::DataCallbackResult::Continue;
}

void AudioEngine::processMasterChain(float *floatBuf, int32_t numFrames) {
    if (mBypassMasterFX.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) return;

    // 1. Smooth master bus compressor to glue tracks and elevate quiet details
    mMasterCompressor.process(floatBuf, numFrames);

    // 2. High-performance soft clipper to prevent saturation and boost perceived volume safely
    mSoftClipper.process(floatBuf, numFrames);

    // Safety peak clamp guard to prevent hardware out-of-range issues under extreme feedback/accidents
    for (int32_t i = 0; i < numFrames; ++i) {
        floatBuf[2 * i] = std::clamp(floatBuf[2 * i], -1.0f, 1.0f);
        floatBuf[2 * i + 1] = std::clamp(floatBuf[2 * i + 1], -1.0f, 1.0f);
    }
}

AudioEngine::~AudioEngine() = default;
bool AudioEngine::start(int driverType) { return true; }
void AudioEngine::stop() {}
#endif
```

```cpp
class StereoBiquad {
public:
    void reset() {
        x1_L = x2_L = y1_L = y2_L = 0.0f;
        x1_R = x2_R = y1_R = y2_R = 0.0f;

    void setLowShelf(float sampleRate, float f0, float gainDb, float Q = 0.707f) {
        if (std::abs(gainDb) < 0.05f) {
            bypass = true;
            return;
        }
        bypass = false;
        float A = std::pow(10.0f, gainDb / 40.0f);
        float w0 = 2.0f * 3.14159265f * f0 / sampleRate;
        float alpha = std::sin(w0) / (2.0f * Q);
        float cos_w0 = std::cos(w0);
        float sqrtA2alpha = 2.0f * std::sqrt(A) * alpha;

        float a0 = (A + 1.0f) + (A - 1.0f) * cos_w0 + sqrtA2alpha;
        coeffs.b0 = (A * ((A + 1.0f) - (A - 1.0f) * cos_w0 + sqrtA2alpha)) / a0;
        coeffs.b1 = (2.0f * A * ((A - 1.0f) - (A + 1.0f) * cos_w0)) / a0;
        coeffs.b2 = (A * ((A + 1.0f) - (A - 1.0f) * cos_w0 - sqrtA2alpha)) / a0;
        coeffs.a1 = (-2.0f * ((A - 1.0f) + (A + 1.0f) * cos_w0)) / a0;
        coeffs.a2 = ((A + 1.0f) + (A - 1.0f) * cos_w0 - sqrtA2alpha) / a0;
    }

    void setPeaking(float sampleRate, float f0, float gainDb, float Q = 1.0f) {
        if (std::abs(gainDb) < 0.05f) {
            bypass = true;
            return;
        }
        bypass = false;
        float A = std::pow(10.0f, gainDb / 40.0f);
        float w0 = 2.0f * 3.14159265f * f0 / sampleRate;
        float alpha = std::sin(w0) / (2.0f * Q);
        float cos_w0 = std::cos(w0);

        float a0 = 1.0f + alpha / A;
        coeffs.b0 = (1.0f + alpha * A) / a0;
        coeffs.b1 = (-2.0f * cos_w0) / a0;
        coeffs.b2 = (1.0f - alpha * A) / a0;
        coeffs.a1 = (-2.0f * cos_w0) / a0;
        coeffs.a2 = (1.0f - alpha / A) / a0;
    }

    void setHighShelf(float sampleRate, float f0, float gainDb, float Q = 0.707f) {
        if (std::abs(gainDb) < 0.05f) {
            bypass = true;
            return;
        }
        bypass = false;
        float A = std::pow(10.0f, gainDb / 40.0f);
        float w0 = 2.0f * 3.14159265f * f0 / sampleRate;
        float alpha = std::sin(w0) / (2.0f * Q);
        float cos_w0 = std::cos(w0);
        float sqrtA2alpha = 2.0f * std::sqrt(A) * alpha;

        float a0 = (A + 1.0f) - (A - 1.0f) * cos_w0 + sqrtA2alpha;
        coeffs.b0 = (A * ((A + 1.0f) + (A - 1.0f) * cos_w0 + sqrtA2alpha)) / a0;
        coeffs.b1 = (-2.0f * A * ((A - 1.0f) + (A + 1.0f) * cos_w0)) / a0;
        coeffs.b2 = (A * ((A + 1.0f) - (A - 1.0f) * cos_w0 - sqrtA2alpha)) / a0;
        coeffs.a1 = (2.0f * ((A - 1.0f) - (A + 1.0f) * cos_w0)) / a0;
        coeffs.a2 = ((A + 1.0f) - (A - 1.0f) * cos_w0 - sqrtA2alpha) / a0;
```
